jobs.title: (Senior/Junior AI Inference Reliability Engineer, Compute Infra
jobs.description:
About this role 
 We're looking for a software engineer, reliability-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero-model and LoRA-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page.
 The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands-on production-reliability experience on large-scale distributed or GPU-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA and Kubernetes controller/CRD-based platforms, and think about GPU infrastructure, and the tools that keep it reliable, as software to be engineered.
 A product mindset applies: the on-call experience, the clarity of an alert, and the judgment built into an automated remediation are things you ship and iterate on.
 Responsibilities 
 Operate the provisioning state machine in production: own the health of the host lifecycle pipeline, discovery, inference bring-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA, triaging stuck or failed state transitions at fleet scale and feeding real failure patterns back into how the states and transitions are designed.
 Triage and extend automated self-healing: when the node-scanning and remediation platform misses something, a new failure mode, an InfiniBand issue in disaggregated prefill/decode serving, a GPU Xid variant, a hero-model or LoRA-specific fault, diagnose it live, drive the fix to production, and turn it into a new detection/remediation plugin so it's automatic the next time.
 Own end-to-end reliability of the pipeline: hold the SLOs and error budgets for provisioning and fleet health, lead incident response when idempotency, retry, rollback, or drift assumptions break down in practice, and drive the systemic fix, not just the hotfix.
 Partner with the inference/ML platform team from the production side: be the one who knows how real cluster topologies, interconnects, and scheduling constraints actually fail in the field, and feed those failure modes back as first-class requirements into the platform's abstractions.
 Work alongside machine learning researchers, engineers, and product managers to bring our latest technologies into production, enabling advanced research through awesome engineering.
 Introduce new techniques, tools, and architecture that improve the performance, latency, throughput, and efficiency of our model inference stack.
 Build tools to give us visibility into our bottlenecks and sources of instability, then design and implement solutions to address the highest-priority issues.
 Lead reliability cross-functionally: build coalition across infra, ML platform, and product teams around shared reliability priorities, manage stakeholders through incidents and roadmap trade-offs, and represent the reliability point of view in planning so it shapes decisions before they ship, not after an outage.
 Requirements 
 Experience operating a provisioning or host-lifecycle pipeline in production, comfortable troubleshooting stuck or failed state transitions (discovery, bring-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA) at fleet scale, and translating real failure patterns back into improvements to the state machine’s design.
 Deep experience owning production reliability for large-scale distributed systems; GPU/ML-serving infrastructure experience is a strong plus.
 Hands-on experience troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA networking issues, ideally in a multi-node training or disaggregated-inference context — comfortable reading IB port counters and subnet manager logs, not just application metrics.
 Familiarity with the operational realities of multi-tenant model serving (LoRA/adapter-based serving) and with running differentiated SLOs across model pools of different priority.
 A demonstrated track record of eliminating operational toil through automation and tooling you built yourself, not just process or documentation.
 Hands-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, reconciliation loops, and node-level health/remediation systems.
 Comfort with event-driven architectures, backpressure/circuit-breaking design, and treating observability (metrics, logs, traces) as something built into a system, not added after an incident.
 A software-engineering mindset first: you write and ship production code, and you think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered, not a fleet to be manually operated.
 About Together AI 
 Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.
 Compensation 
 We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $160,000 - $280,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.
 Equal Opportunity 
 Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.
 Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy .

jobs.title: Claims Analyst
jobs.description:
Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.
 We’re hiring a Claims Analyst to own the day-to-day integrity of our claims and adjudication workflows and to help build the processes, controls, and reporting behind them. This is a hands-on role: you’ll personally work our hardest claims and denials while standing up the playbooks, benchmarks, and dashboards that let claims operations scale without breaking. Reporting to our Manager, RCM, you’ll sit at the intersection of our clearinghouse, prior-auth, and finance systems — and you’ll be the person who can explain exactly why a claim paid, denied, or landed where it did.
 What you'll do: 
 Own claims adjudication and QA. Review, validate, and adjudicate imaging claims against benefit designs, contracted rates, and our pass-through payment model; identify and resolve pricing, coding, and eligibility discrepancies before they become client or member issues.
 Lead denials management. Investigate root causes of denials and underpayments, drive appeals and resubmissions, and build recurring analysis that turns denial patterns into fixes upstream (prior auth, eligibility, EDI configuration).
 Manage EDI and clearinghouse workflows. Work hands-on in Waystar across 837P submissions, 835 remittances, and companion-guide requirements; troubleshoot rejections and payer-specific edits; partner with vendors to keep the pipes clean.
 Safeguard cost-share and accumulator accuracy. Ensure deductible, coinsurance, HDHP, and accumulator logic is applied correctly so members and clients are billed accurately and we stay compliant with cost-sharing rules.
 Own AR and aging. Monitor accounts receivable and claims aging, prioritize collectible balances, and maintain reporting that gives finance and leadership a real-time view of what’s outstanding and why.
 Build the reporting layer. Develop and maintain dashboards and KPIs (adjudication turnaround, denial rate, clean-claim rate, AR aging, recovery rate) from Waystar and adjacent claims data.
 Coordinate across the stack. Work closely with prior authorization (Infinx), finance, and client-facing teams to close the loop between authorization, exam, claim, and payment.
 Write the playbook. Document repeatable SOPs, edits, and escalation paths, and help train and mentor analysts as the team grows.
 About you: 
 Required 
 2+ years in healthcare claims, revenue cycle, or medical billing, with demonstrated ownership of complex adjudication and denials work
 Deep hands-on experience with EDI transactions (837/835) and a clearinghouse platform (Waystar strongly preferred)
 Strong command of CPT/HCPCS, ICD-10, place-of-service, and modifier logic — ideally in radiology/imaging
 Working knowledge of benefit structures, cost-sharing, deductibles, and accumulator/HDHP mechanics
 Advanced spreadsheet skills and comfort building reporting from raw claims data
 A meticulous, audit-minded approach: you can trace any dollar to its source and defend it
 Preferred 
 Experience at a TPA, benefits administrator, or payer, especially serving self-funded employers
 Familiarity with prior authorization workflows and tools (e.g., Infinx)
 Exposure to appeals, payer escalations, and underpayment recovery at scale
 Early-stage or high-growth environment experience — comfortable building process where none exists
 The salary range for this position is $50,000 - $65,000. This position is also bonus eligible. Individual compensation will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, location, and applicable laws. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans. 
 Fraud and Security Notice:  
 Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our team uses the oneimaging.com  email domain exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a OneImaging recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement here  and to  candidateprotection@oneimaging.com . 
 Equal Employment Opportunity: 
 OneImaging is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 
 OneImaging is committed to providing accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at talent@oneimaging.com .

jobs.description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
 For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  
 Job's mission 
 We are seeking a skilled Engineer II, Electrical Engineering to support the electrical design, integration, qualification, and continuous improvement of process modules used in advanced semiconductor equipment. This role is responsible for developing safe, reliable, and manufacturable electrical solutions for process-module subsystems, including power distribution, controls, sensors, interlocks, safety circuits, cable assemblies, and system-level interfaces. The engineer will work closely with mechanical, process, controls, software, manufacturing, supply chain, and service teams to deliver robust module architectures that meet performance, safety, compliance, and productization requirements. 
 Responsibilities 
 Own the electrical design of process-module subsystems from concept through release, including schematics, cable drawings, wiring diagrams, interconnects, power distribution, sensors, heaters, actuators, safety circuits, and control interfaces. 
 Translate process, system, safety, serviceability, and manufacturability requirements into electrical design solutions that support reliable tool operation. 
 Collaborate with mechanical, process, controls, software, safety, manufacturing, service, and supply chain teams to develop integrated process-module architectures. 
 Select and qualify electrical components based on performance, safety, reliability, availability, environmental conditions, and lifecycle considerations. 
 Design and review safety-related electrical systems, including interlocks, emergency-off circuits, protective devices, grounding, bonding, and safety-rated components. 
 Develop, review, and release engineering documentation, including schematics, cable assemblies, bills of materials, design specifications, test plans, and ECO packages. 
 Support prototype builds, system integration, design verification, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for electrical issues found during development, qualification, manufacturing, or field escalation. 
 Work closely with designers and drafters to ensure electrical documentation is accurate, complete, and aligned with company standards and release processes. 
 Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, failure analysis, and continuous improvement activities to improve module reliability, safety, cost, and manufacturability. 
 Maintain strong ownership of assigned tasks, manage priorities effectively, and communicate technical status, risks, and recommendations clearly to project stakeholders. 
 Required Qualifications and Skills 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree is a plus. 
 Experience designing and troubleshooting electrical systems for complex electromechanical equipment, preferably in semiconductor, vacuum, automation, industrial, or capital-equipment environments. 
 Strong understanding of electrical circuit design, power distribution, grounding, shielding, signal integrity, sensors, actuators, safety circuits, and cable assembly design. 
 Proficiency with electrical CAD tools for schematic capture and cable or harness design; AutoCAD Electrical or similar tools preferred. 
 Experience with component selection, design verification, prototype bring-up, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis. 
 Working knowledge of applicable electrical safety and machinery standards such as NEC, NFPA 79, UL 508A, FM 4910, ISO 13849, EN/IEC 60204-1, EN/IEC 60204-33, and relevant SEMI standards is preferred. 
 Ability to create clear technical documentation, including specifications, test plans, design notes, ECO packages, and release documentation. 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, service, and quality teams. 
 Ability to manage multiple priorities independently, drive closure on technical issues, and make sound engineering decisions in a fast-paced product-development environment. 
 Familiarity with process-module hardware, pneumatics, PCB interfaces, embedded controls, PLC-based systems, or semiconductor equipment architecture is a plus.

We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  
 【会社概要】
 ASMはオランダに本社を置く、半導体製造装置業界のリーディングカンパニーです。特にALD（Atomic Layer Deposition）・Epitaxy・CVDといった「原子レベルの薄膜形成技術」において世界トップクラスのシェアを誇り、AI、2nm世代の先端ロジック半導体、3Dメモリなど、最先端半導体の量産を支えています。
 仕事内容：
 最先端の半導体製造を支えるフィールドエンジニアとして、顧客先工場にて装置の設置・立ち上げから保守、トラブル対応、アップグレードまで幅広く担当いただきます。装置の安定稼働を通じて、お客様の生産性向上に直接貢献できるポジションです。開発部門やグローバルチームとの連携機会も多く、高度な技術力と問題解決力を身につけることができます。
 【具体的には】
 ・半導体製造装置（ALD、Epitaxy、PECVD等）の設置、立ち上げおよび導入支援
 ・定期メンテナンスや装置点検の実施による安定稼働の維持
 ・装置トラブル発生時の原因解析、修理および復旧対応
 ・装置性能向上や生産性改善に向けたアップグレード、改造作業
 ・顧客からの技術的な問い合わせ対応および運用サポート
 ・本社・開発部門と連携した技術課題の解決およびフィードバック
 ・作業報告書やサービスレポートの作成
 ・安全基準や品質基準に基づくフィールドサービス業務の遂行
 ・オンコール対応および緊急時のサポート対応（必要に応じて）
 応募資格：
 【必須（MUST）】
 ■高卒以上の学歴
 ■日本語：流暢
 ■英語：読み書きレベル以上（書類は英語になります。）
 ■２年以上のフィールドサービスの経験（大型装置、大型機械の経験、開発経験者も含む）
 【歓迎（WANT）】
 ■半導体の知識
 ■理工系学部の専攻者
 【ASM Japanの魅力】
 ASM Japanは、オランダ本社ASM Internationalの重要な研究開発拠点です。
 日本がグローバルR&Dの中核拠点となっており、PEALD・PECVDを中心としたプラズマ成膜技術の開発をリードし、世界中の半導体メーカー向け製品の開発に携わっています。
 東京（多摩）・神奈川（川崎）を中心とした7つの戦略拠点を展開。
 装置開発だけでなく、製品プラットフォーム設計やソフトウェア開発も日本チームが担当しており、日本発の技術が世界で採用されています。
 また、外資系では珍しく日本での研究開発は1982年にスタート。
 外資系企業でありながら40年以上にわたり日本で研究開発を継続しており、日本の技術者が中心となって製品開発を推進しています。

jobs.title: Principal Process Engineer - DRAM and Memory Applications
jobs.description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
 For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company.  As a  Principal Process Engineer at ASM, you will leverage semiconductor processing and analytical equipment to research, develop, and optimize advanced thin-film processes enabling next-generation DRAM and memory technologies . Your work will focus on Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD, PEALD), Epitaxy, PECVD, oxidation, annealing, and curing processes used in highly scaled memory structures, including capacitors, word lines, bit lines, storage nodes, and advanced memory integration schemes.   
 You will apply deep technical expertise in memory device fabrication to deliver innovative process solutions that address critical scaling, performance, reliability, and integration challenges. You will design and execute complex experiments, interpret advanced characterization data, and collaborate closely with customers and product teams to accelerate technology development. Technical publications, customer engagement, and the creation of Intellectual Property (IP) are key aspects of this role.   
 Key Responsibilities   
 Develop and optimize advanced deposition processes for DRAM and emerging memory applications utilizing ALD, PEALD, Epitaxy, and PECVD technologies.   
 Drive process innovation for memory-critical films, including high-k dielectrics, capacitor materials, metal electrodes, barrier layers, conductors, and emerging memory materials.   
 Support technology development focused on DRAM scaling challenges such as capacitor formation, buried word lines, advanced patterning, and high-aspect-ratio structures.   
 Remain at the forefront of memory technology trends and roadmaps to identify new process opportunities and technology requirements.   
 Serve as a technical consultant and subject matter expert for internal teams and leading memory manufacturers worldwide.   
 Lead technical problem-solving efforts using scientific methodologies, statistical analysis, and industry-standard tools.   
 Design and execute experiments utilizing Design of Experiments (DOE) and Response Surface Methodology (RSM) to optimize process performance.   
 Analyze electrical, physical, and materials characterization data to understand film properties and device performance.   
 Troubleshoot equipment and process issues through hands-on experimentation and root cause analysis.   
 Collaborate with customers to define requirements, execute demonstrations, and develop process solutions addressing critical memory integration challenges.   
 Develop methods and techniques for integrating advanced materials into future DRAM and memory device architectures.   
 Support product transfers, customer demonstrations, field training, and process documentation to ensure successful deployment of new technology.   
 Publish technical papers, present at industry conferences, and contribute to ASM’s patent portfolio.   
 Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across memory-focused development programs.   
 May provide supervisory direction to process engineering technicians and support personnel.   
 Qualifications   
 Master's or PhD degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.   
 7+ years of combined industry, research, and/or academic experience with:    
 Advanced thin-film deposition technologies including ALD, PEALD, CVD, PECVD, Epitaxy, oxidation, and annealing.   
 DRAM, NAND, or emerging memory device development and integration.   
 High-k dielectrics, metal electrodes, conductive films, barrier materials, and capacitor technologies.   
 Semiconductor process integration and materials engineering for advanced memory applications.   
 Materials characterization techniques including XPS, SIMS, RBS, AFM, XRR, XRD, TEM, SEM, and ellipsometry.   
 Strong understanding of electrical characterization techniques and memory device performance metrics.   
 Experience supporting advanced memory process development for high-volume manufacturing environments is highly preferred.   
 Training or experience with Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is preferred.   
 Skills   
 Deep understanding of DRAM and memory device architecture, fabrication flows, and scaling challenges.   
 Demonstrated expertise in thin-film deposition and integration for advanced memory structures.   
 Ability to independently lead complex process development projects, including technical direction, schedules, budgets, and resource planning.   
 Strong knowledge of the relationship between reactor design, process conditions, and film properties.   
 Experience integrating advanced dielectric, conductive, and metal films into memory device architectures.   
 Proven capability to develop and fully characterize deposition processes using first-principles understanding and advanced experimental methodologies.   
 Expertise in materials characterization techniques such as XPS, SIMS, RBS, AFM, XRD, HRTEM, FESEM, Auger, Raman, and ellipsometry.   
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly present complex technical concepts to customers, industry partners, and executive stakeholders.   
 Demonstrated track record of customer engagement, technology leadership, technical publications, and patent generation.   
 Nice-to-Have Memory-Specific Experience   
 DRAM capacitor development (high-k and metal electrode systems).   
 Buried word line (BWL) integration.   
 High aspect ratio deposition and gap-fill applications.   
 Capacitor dielectric materials such as ZrO₂, HfO₂, Al₂O₃, and related stacks.   
 Advanced patterning and self-aligned integration schemes.   
 Emerging memory technologies including MRAM, ReRAM, PCM, or 3D DRAM concepts.   
 Direct experience supporting memory manufacturers such as Micron, Samsung, SK hynix, Kioxia, Western Digital, YMTC, or CXMT.

 Digital Integration Engineer (Digital Mockup (DMU) Management)   
 Position Summary   
 Digital Integration Engineering team is part of the Global Product Operation (GPO) Organization. The Digital Integration Engineer manage and own the development, integration, governance, and validation of complex digital product models that enable virtual product development across the entire product lifecycle. This role partners closely with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, and other cross-functional teams, leveraging advanced CAD, PLM, and Model-Based Engineering methodologies to identify, analyze, and resolve design, integration, and manufacturability challenges early in the development process. Through digital product definition and validation, this role reduces program risk, improves product quality, lowers development costs, and accelerates time-to-market.   
 Key Responsibilities   
 Lead the creation, management, and validation of enterprise Digital Mockups (DMUs) and Master Assembly structures using Siemens NX, PTC Creo, or equivalent CAD/DMU platforms.   
 Develop and support digital product structures, subsystem architectures, graphical BOMs, configuration variants, and enterprise product definitions throughout the product lifecycle.   
 Manage Relational Layout Models (RLMs) and support the implementation of Knowledge-Based Engineering (KBE) methodologies to improve design efficiency and standardization.   
 Execute and lead virtual product validation activities, including:    
 Clash and interference analysis   
 Design for Manufacturability (DFM)   
 Design for Assembly (DFA)   
 Serviceability, maintainability, and installation reviews   
 Support Engineering Change Management (ECM) and Configuration Management processes, ensuring digital continuity and alignment across As-Designed, As-Planned, and As-Built product definitions.   
 Drive early identification and resolution of product integration, packaging, manufacturability, and serviceability issues across multidisciplinary engineering teams.   
 Present DMU maturity assessments, integration status, technical risks, mitigation strategies, and recommendations to program leadership and key stakeholders.   
 Support and enable Service, Safety, Training, and other functional organizations in effectively leveraging DMU structures to meet operational, maintenance, readiness, and business goals.   
 Contribute to Digital Twin, Model-Based Engineering, Virtual Reality (VR), and Augmented Reality (AR) initiatives that enhance product development and lifecycle support capabilities.   
 Required Qualifications   
 Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.   
 8+ years of experience working with complex mechanical and electromechanical systems, with significant ability in product configuration management, system integration, and Digital Mockup (DMU) environments.   
 Advanced ability with CAD/DMU platforms such as Siemens NX, PTC Creo, and associated PLM systems.   
 Strong knowledge and practical experience in:    
 Mechanical system design and integration   
 Product development processes   
 Configuration and BOM management   
 Manufacturing operations and readiness   
 Product packaging and accessory integration   
 Assembly, installation, and validation methodologies   
 Serviceability, maintainability, and lifecycle support planning   
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.   
 Experience applying Design for Six Sigma (DFSS) methodologies to product development and process improvement initiatives.   
 Expert knowledge of ASME Y14.5 GD&T standards with a minimum of seven years of practical application.   
 Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technical discussions, influence stakeholders, and drive resolution of complex engineering issues across multiple disciplines.   
 Working knowledge in Configuration Management (CMII) and enterprise change management practices.   
 Working knowledge of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) principles and methodologies.   
 Experience supporting and enabling Digital Twin, Virtual Reality (VR), and Augmented Reality (AR) technology initiatives.   
 Proven experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) programs within semiconductor, aerospace, automotive, or other advanced manufacturing industries.   
 Exceptional ability to decompose complex technical challenges into manageable and actionable solutions.   
 Highly effective at influencing across matrixed organizations, fostering stakeholder alignment, and driving execution through collaboration, credibility, and relationship-based leadership.   
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.   
 Business Impact   
 This role plays a critical role in advancing ASM's digital engineering strategy by:   
 Strengthening system integration and product development effectiveness.   
 Validating design, assembly, installation, operation, and maintenance requirements before physical builds.   
 Reducing engineering rework, development costs, prototype dependency, and program risk.   
 Accelerating New Product Introduction (NPI) and reducing time-to-market.   
 Enabling Digital Twin capabilities that support Engineering, Manufacturing, Sales, Service, and Operations.   
 Enhancing enterprise collaboration through a common digital product definition and integrated digital environment.   
 Improving product quality, reliability, manufacturability, and lifecycle readiness across the product development process.   
 Driving digital transformation initiatives that improve engineering efficiency, business performance, and operational excellence.

You will also ensure reliable tool operation and efficient lab performance while supporting continuous improvement in metrology capabilities.

 Solid understanding of semiconductor processing and device fabrication
 Hands-on experience with metrology techniques such as XRR, XRD, XRF, TXRF, FTIR, SPV, four-point probe, Hall effect, and defect inspection tools is a plus
 Strong data analysis and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex results

 Hands-on experience in TEM/FIB applications development and advanced characterization techniques
 Background in laboratory operations, tool maintenance, and equipment troubleshooting
 Experience supporting semiconductor process development (e.g., ALD, Epitaxy)Knowledge of optical and e-beam defect inspection methods
 Programming or scripting experience for automation of data acquisition or analysis
 Strong collaboration skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams

 Lead a small team of mechanical engineers, setting and communicating clear goals, priorities, and expectations that align with ASM's vision, strategy, and long-term objectives.

 Drive collaboration across teams and regions to ensure a unified, cross-functional response to organizational and customer-driven changes.

 Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field with 12+ years of relevant industry experience; or
Master's degree with 8+ years of experience; or
PhD with 4+ years of experience.
 2-3 years of people managing experience.
 Proven experience in equipment or complex machinery design, ideally in semiconductor capital equipment or closely related high-tech industries.

 What sets you apart 
 Direct experience in mechanical engineering for semiconductor process tools, vacuum systems, robotics, or other advanced capital equipment.
 Hands-on experience troubleshooting cross-module yield excursions and working with integration and process teams in a fab or equipment environment.
 Experience defining site control limits and auditing measurement capability at both customer and internal manufacturing or test sites.

 At ASM, we are shaping the future of semiconductor manufacturing through innovation and technology leadership. Our success depends on attracting and hiring exceptional talent across engineering, commercial, service, and leadership functions. We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our European Talent Acquisition team and serve as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders across Europe and North America.   
 The Role   
 As a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will lead the end-to-end recruitment of experienced professionals and senior leaders across multiple business functions and geographies. This is a highly visible role requiring exceptional stakeholder management, market intelligence, and proactive sourcing capabilities.   
 You will partner closely with senior leaders to identify, attract, and secure top talent in a highly competitive semiconductor market. Success in this role requires a strong executive presence, the ability to influence at all levels, and a proactive, data-driven approach to talent acquisition.   
 This role is based in Almere and will serve as a key Talent Acquisition partner supporting hiring across Europe and the United States.   
 Key Responsibilities   
 Lead end-to-end recruitment processes for experienced, senior, and executive-level positions across Europe and North America.   
 Develop and execute innovative sourcing strategies to identify and engage passive talent across highly competitive industries.   
 Enable ASM’s long-term business strategy by shaping future-focused talent pipelines, recruiting for emerging organizational capabilities, and partnering with leaders to anticipate workforce needs in a rapidly evolving industry   
 Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and hiring managers, providing market insights, talent intelligence, and strategic hiring recommendations.   
 Drive high-quality candidate experiences throughout the recruitment lifecycle.   
 Conduct in-depth candidate assessments, evaluating capability, leadership potential, and organizational fit.   
 Utilize market data and competitive intelligence to support hiring decisions and workforce planning discussions.   
 Influence stakeholders and challenge hiring assumptions where appropriate to improve hiring outcomes.   
 Partner closely with HR Business Partners and global Talent Acquisition colleagues to support organizational growth initiatives.   
 Represent ASM professionally in the external market, enhancing our employer brand and talent community presence.   
 Continuously identify opportunities to improve recruitment processes, tools, and hiring effectiveness.  
 What You'll Bring   
 Required Experience   
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.   
 8+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition experience, preferably in-house within technology, semiconductor, engineering, industrial, or advanced manufacturing environments.   
 Demonstrated success recruiting diverse experienced professionals and (senior) leadership talent   
 Proven experience supporting multiple geographic regions and working within complex international organizations.   
 Strong track record of direct sourcing and successfully hiring passive candidates.   
 Key Competencies   
 Exceptional sourcing, networking, and talent mapping capabilities.   
 Strong executive presence with the ability to partner credibly with senior and executive stakeholders.   
 Strategic, big-picture mindset combined with hands-on recruiting execution.   
 Excellent consultation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.   
 Strong understanding of total rewards principles and building competitive offers   
 Strong commercial awareness and understanding of talent market dynamics.   
 Ability to operate independently with minimal supervision.   
 Highly organized, resilient, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.   
 Data-driven approach to decision making and problem solving.   
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.  
 What Success Looks Like

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble! 
 Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.
 Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!
 O.N.E Purpose:
 Customer Obsession:  Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.
 Embracing New Ideas:  Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.
 Striving for Excellence:  Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.
 The Opportunity: 
 Position Overview    
 The Analytics Engineer plays a critical role in transforming curated data into clear, consistent, and analytics ready ‑ data models that power reporting, dashboards, and decision-making ‑ across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and the business—owning the semantic layer, partnering closely with stakeholders, and ensuring that metrics are trusted, well-defined ‑ , and easy to use.  
 The ideal candidate is deeply skilled in SQL based transformations and dimensional modeling, has strong business acumen, and is passionate about enabling analysts and leaders with high-quality, intuitive data.  
 Essential Job Functions    
 Design, build, and maintain analytics ready ‑ data models, including facts, dimensions, and data marts.  
 Develop and manage transformations primarily in the semantic and transformation layer using SQL based tooling   
 Define and maintain metrics, business logic, and calculations to ensure consistency across dashboards, reports, and analyses.  
 Apply dimensional modeling best practices optimized for BI and analytical consumption.  
 Partner closely with product, operations, finance, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into well-defined ‑ data models and metrics.  
 Act as a steward of business logic—ensuring definitions are clear, documented, and aligned across teams.  
 Proactively identify gaps, ambiguities, or inconsistencies in metrics and drive alignment toward standardized definitions.  
 Optimize data models for clarity, usability, and performance for downstream consumers, including analysts and self-service ‑ BI users.  
 Support analysts and BI developers by enabling faster, more reliable dashboard and report development.  
 Ensure analytics outputs are intuitive, discoverable, and trusted by decision ‑ makers.  
 Implement data quality checks and testing at the analytics layer to ensure accuracy and reliability.  
 Contribute to analytics engineering standards, conventions, and documentation.  
 Collaborate with data engineering partners to provide feedback on source data structure and readiness for analytics.  
 Qualifications    
 Required Skills & Experience    
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)   
 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, analytics, business intelligence, or a related role.  
 Advanced SQL expertise, with a strong track record of building complex, maintainable transformations.  
 Hands ‑ on dbt experience  
 Product or application engineering experience is a plus, with an understanding of both data and how it’s used in product and engineering applications.  
 Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, metrics design, and semantic layer concepts.  
 Experience supporting BI tools and downstream analytics use cases (dashboards, reporting, ad hoc analysis).  
 Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.  
 Experience in healthcare-related operations, with an understanding of industry processes and terminology.  
 This position pays between $84,000 - $126,000 based on experience  
 Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
 Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.  
 Travel platform pricing and monetization has critical impacts on the business health. The Machine Learning Science team is building a scalable and robust system to enable pricing as a lever to optimize business performance.  Apply solid scientific skills, strong analytical and innovative thinking to quickly learn new domains and turn innovative ideas into working solutions

jobs.description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR 
 Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com .
 JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY 
$1,000 Sign On!!!!
The Leasing / Sales Consultant is responsible for executing the property’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals. This role serves as a key point of contact for prospective residents, guiding them through the leasing process with professionalism and a deep understanding of the community’s lifestyle offering. The Sales Consultant supports resident satisfaction throughout the lease term and proactively manages lease renewals in alignment with Active Adult best practices. Responsibilities include lead management, CRM utilization, data analysis, event support, and collaboration with the Lifestyle Coordinator to enhance resident engagement. The Sales Consultant upholds Greystar’s professional standards and ethical expectations while delivering exceptional service to residents, prospects, and guests.
Prior multi-family leasing experience is preferred. 
*additional detail will be discussed during interview. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
1.    Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the property’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting property tours and showing apartments, continuing the relationship with prospects, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
2.    Collects all pertinent information from prospective residents at move-in and records as appropriate.
3.    Stays informed about and collaborates with teams/leadership on current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy, market rent, and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the property’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy. 
4.    Designs and executes marketing activities and events to create and drive traffic to the property, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools and following other property-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
5.    Uses the on-site property management software application to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents, and review and analyze data. 
6.    Ensures that the property and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the tour path and show ready units, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the property’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities. 
 7.    Follows-up with prospects and new residents within 24 hours to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew. Documents all follow up and classes leads during the lifecycle of the sales process.
8.    Executes and performs activities in support of the property’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time, following the AA renewal playbook. 
9.    Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).
10.    Demonstrates customer services skills by treating residents, prospects, guests, and others with respect, answering questions, and responding sensitively to complaints about maintenance services. Interacts with all residents and acknowledges them by name. 
11.    Attends community and networking events, aligns with local associations and community organizations, and participates in outreach marketing efforts to drive traffic to community and generate viable referral sources and new business leads, ensuring Greystar AA outreach expectations are consistently met. 
12.    Completes various financial, administrative, and other reports and analysis, and performs other duties as assigned or necessary.
13.    Assists Lifestyle Coordinator by attending and assisting with the setup of events as required.
 BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS: 
•    High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, hospitality, or related field preferred.
•    1-3 years minimum of relevant experience in the application and usage of a sales, marketing, internet and customer service background sufficient to resolve customer complaints and issues and complete financial records, documents, and reports.
•    Demonstrated ability to read, write, and communicate effectively to comprehend and complete legal documents, sell and explain apartment features, and answer questions. 
 •    Mathematical skills necessary to process sales conversions.
 •    Ability to apply sales skills, such as generating sales leads, conducting sales presentations, qualifying prospects, and closing.
 SPECIALIZED SKILLS: 
•    Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions.
 •    Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to drive a golf cart on property.
 •    Proficiency in word processing, spreadsheet, property management applications, and database management programs in order to complete required reports and documents. 
 •    Proficiency and fluency in using the internet for marketing, advertising, and sales-related circumstances.
 •    Ability to adapt to specific markets and professionals to ensure your sales message is received appropriately. 
 TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS: 
•    Team members work in an office environment but also may have frequent exposure to outside elements where temperature, weather, odors, and/or landscape may be unpleasant and/or hazardous. 
•    Incumbents must be able to physically access all exterior and interior parts of the property and amenities. 
•    Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance and be able to stand for extended periods of time.
•    Routine, local travel may be required to attend business meetings, conduct market research, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
•    Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which may include evenings, weekends and/or holidays.
COMPETENCIES:
 1.    Ensures Accountability – Holds self and others accountable to meet commitments.

FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR 
 Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com .
 JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY 
We are seeking an analytically strong Corporate FP&A Analyst to support Greystar’s C-Suite functions, including the Offices of the CEO (Chief Executive Officer), CFO (Chief Financial Officer), CIO (Chief Investment Officer), and CLO (Chief Legal Officer). The functions supported include, but are not limited to, Managed Capital, Investment Strategy & Research, Data & Technology, Legal, Risk Management, Treasury, and Tax. The Corporate FP&A team supports 40+ business leaders across these functions. 
Reporting to the Senior Director, Corporate FP&A, this individual will support the operating expense forecasts for each of these functions, including the annual business plan as well as monthly and quarterly forecasts, and prepare the consolidated reporting and analysis used to explain financial performance to senior leaders. The Analyst also supports cost allocation reporting for the C-Suite functions and will serve as a hands-on driver of the team’s use of AI, automation, and the systems tech stack. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 C-Suite Operating Expense Planning & Forecasting 
 Own operating expense (OpEx) and capital expense (CapEx) budgeting, forecasting, and variance tracking packages for each C-Suite function, partnering with function leaders to build forecasts that are well-supported and defensible.
 Own budget-to-actual variance explanations for monthly reporting deliverables, partnering with Accounting, Finance and function leaders to identify key drivers and provide clear, timely commentary.
 Prepare the annual business plan, quarterly reforecasts, and related presentation materials for senior leadership for the C-Suite functions, collaborating with Accounting, Finance, and business teams to collect, validate, and synthesize inputs.
 Perform ad hoc reporting and analytics, including what-if and scenario analyses, in response to requests from the CFO, CLO, CIO, and their leadership teams.
 Consolidated C-Suite Reporting & Analysis 
 Prepare each consolidated C-Suite management reporting package for senior leadership, pairing the numbers with a clear narrative — key drivers identified, variances explained, and leadership questions anticipated before they’re asked.
 Analyze monthly and quarterly financial performance for each C-Suite function against budget and forecast, identify key drivers and variances, investigate unexpected results, and communicate meaningful insights to Corporate Finance and senior leadership.
 Review work carefully for accuracy, completeness, and consistency before distribution, and take ownership of assigned deliverables from initial request through completion.
 Cost Allocation Ownership & Reporting 
 Partner with the functional leaders to understand the cost drivers across the C-Suite functions and help shape allocation methodologies that distribute those costs across the businesses, balancing accuracy, fairness, and practicality.
 Own the ongoing validation process that confirms allocated costs are posted correctly across every ledger in scope, maintaining clear documentation of how the process works.
 Assist in delivering proactive allocation variance summaries each financial review cycle, and document the reasoning behind the allocation methodology and any changes made during the year.
 Systems, Automation & AI-Driven Analysis 
 Serve as a hands-on driver of the team’s FP&A tech stack, using Anaplan, Claude, and Microsoft 365 (Copilot, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and related tools) as the core toolset for daily work.
 Actively participate in and advocate for the Anaplan roadmap on behalf of the C-Suite functions, and represent the team in relevant systems and technology planning forums.
 Identify and implement process and procedural improvements that streamline recurring work, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and improve the quality of financial reporting.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Exposure 
 Build and maintain proactive working relationships with the finance and operations leaders across the C-Suite functions.
 Partner regularly with Accounting, Corporate Finance, and the business-line FP&A teams to ensure cohesive, well-reconciled reporting across teams.
 BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS 
 Required: 
 Strong analytical rigor, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to translate complex analyses into clear, executive-ready narratives. The successful candidate must also be adaptable and responsive to evolving business needs.
 Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or another quantitative discipline required.
 1-2 years of relevant experience in FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, or financial analysis.
 Solid understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling.
 Demonstrated ability to interpret financial information and communicate insights clearly and concisely to senior leadership.
 Exceptional attention to detail, with a high degree of initiative and ownership and the ability to move work forward independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
 Resourceful problem-solving skills, including the ability to work through ambiguity, investigate questions, and develop solutions without requiring step-by-step instructions.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and quality.
 Demonstrated ability to prioritize effectively, anticipate needs, ask thoughtful questions, and escalate issues appropriately.
 Collaborative and dependable team member who is equally comfortable working independently and partnering across functions.
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
 Preferred: 
 MBA, CFA, or CPA designation preferred.
 Experience with Anaplan or a comparable FP&A planning tool is preferred but not required; candidates should be willing and able to learn the platform.
 Experience using generative AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot or Claude, to enhance analytical and reporting workflows.
 Experience supporting corporate or shared services functions, or working with cost allocation methodologies, is preferred but not required.
 Experience in real estate or investment management is preferred but not required.

1st shift (United States of America) 
 Please review the following job description: 
ROLE PURPOSE Own the product direction and delivery roadmap for Wealth Brokerage capabilities spanning client and teammate experiences, brokerage operations, workflow, data and analytics. Translate business outcomes, regulatory obligations and technology opportunities into prioritised epics, features and measurable releases.
This Product Manager balances business, technology, risk and design priorities to deliver secure, resilient and differentiated capabilities for Wealth Brokerage. The role works closely with Product Owners, engineering, architecture, operations, data, cyber security, risk, legal and compliance to convert strategic objectives into an executable product roadmap.
The role must operate effectively at both strategic and tactical levels. This includes defining product outcomes, analysing client and operational needs, shaping investment priorities, resolving delivery constraints and working directly with Agile teams through discovery, Planning Increment (PI) planning, build, testing, release and adoption.
The successful candidate will understand modern application delivery in a regulated financial-services environment. Relevant technology includes .NET and C# applications, SQL Server data platforms, Microsoft Azure services, Python-based data and automation solutions, low-code platforms and workflow/case-management capabilities.
Scope of responsibility
• Wealth Brokerage client, adviser, operations and supervisory experiences, including digital journeys and internal servicing tools.
• Product strategy and roadmaps for application modernisation, workflow automation, data integration, analytics and operational controls.
• Coordination across legacy and modern platforms, including on-premises applications, Azure-hosted services, vendor platforms and enterprise shared services.
• Business and technology outcomes such as improved client and teammate experience, straight-through processing, reduced manual effort, stronger controls, improved data quality and increased platform resilience. 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job.  Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below.  Specific activities may change from time to time.  
 1.   Develop and maintain a product vision and strategic roadmap for Wealth Brokerage capabilities, aligned to business objectives, client needs, operational priorities and technology strategy.
 2.   Research and analyse the needs of Wealth Brokerage clients, advisers, operations teams, supervisors and other target users. Translate findings into clear product outcomes and prioritised opportunities.
 3.   Assess market, competitor, regulatory and technology trends relevant to brokerage products and servicing. Convert analysis into practical recommendations, investment choices and roadmap decisions.
 4.   Partner with Product Owners and Agile delivery teams to define epics, features, acceptance outcomes and non-functional requirements. Maintain a healthy, prioritised backlog that is ready for delivery.
 5.   Set PI vision, objectives and priorities. Participate in PI planning, refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives and other Agile ceremonies as appropriate.
 6.   Lead cross-functional discovery across business, operations, user experience, architecture, engineering, data and risk partners. Use prototypes, process maps, data analysis and user feedback to validate solutions before significant investment.
 7.   Shape solutions implemented through .NET and C#, SQL Server, Azure services, Python, low-code platforms and workflow technologies. The Product Manager is not expected to be the primary developer, but must be sufficiently technically fluent to challenge assumptions, understand dependencies and make informed trade-offs.
 8.   Define product requirements for workflow and case-management solutions, including intake, routing, prioritisation, approvals, work queues, service-level tracking, exception handling, notifications, audit history and management reporting.
 9.   Ensure product design supports secure access, appropriate segregation of duties, data protection, records retention, traceability and evidence required in a regulated brokerage environment.
 10.   Collaborate with architecture and engineering to address modernisation, cloud migration, application rationalisation, integration, data lineage, observability, resiliency, disaster recovery and technical debt.
 11.   Coordinate dependencies across APIs, batch and file-based interfaces, event-driven integrations, enterprise data platforms, vendor solutions and downstream reporting consumers.
 12.   Obtain required alignment and approvals from legal, compliance, privacy, information security, fraud, model risk, operational risk, architecture and other governance partners.
 13.   Define measurable product outcomes and key performance indicators. Use telemetry, workflow metrics, operational data, client feedback, defect trends and adoption measures to adjust priorities and demonstrate value.
 14.   Plan releases and adoption with readiness, communications, training, support and operations partners. Ensure client-facing and teammate-facing content is accurate and usable.
 15.   Manage product risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies. Ensure Product Management Lifecycle processes are followed and that control, audit and remediation commitments are completed by agreed deadlines.
 16.   Communicate product strategy, roadmap, decisions, delivery status and risks clearly to executives, business stakeholders and technical teams.
 Technology and domain expectations 
 Area 
 Expected product fluency 
 Wealth Brokerage 
 Working knowledge of brokerage products, account servicing, adviser and operations workflows, supervisory controls, financial-services risk, or comparable regulated business processes.
 .NET / C# 
 Ability to work with engineering teams delivering web applications, APIs, background services, and integrations using the Microsoft application stack.
 SQL Server and data 
 Understanding of relational data, data quality, reporting needs, data movement, reconciliation, and the product implications of schema or integration changes.
 Microsoft Azure 
 Familiarity with cloud-native and PaaS concepts, identity, networking, security, monitoring, resiliency, deployment, and cost considerations.
 Python 
 Familiarity with Python uses in data processing, analytics, automation, controls, and integration. Ability to define business outcomes and governance expectations for such solutions.
 Low code 
 Experience shaping governed low-code solutions, including appropriate use cases, citizen-development boundaries, environment management, supportability, and transition to engineered solutions when scale or complexity requires it.
 Workflow 
 Experience defining end-to-end workflow, work queues, case management, business rules, human approvals, exception paths, controls, auditability, and operational metrics.
 Integration 
 Understanding of APIs, messaging, batch, SFTP/file transfer, vendor connectivity, and enterprise integration patterns sufficient to identify dependencies and delivery risk.
 QUALIFICATIONS

Who Are We? 
 Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.
 Job Category 
Marketing 
 Target Openings 
1 
 What Is the Opportunity? 
At Travelers, the Digital Marketing lead is responsible for raising relevant awareness with target audiences, deepening engagement with valuable content and increasing preference and demand for Travelers products and services using an appropriate mix of platforms, including social media and email. As a Senior Digital Marketing Consultant, you are responsible for executing marketing campaigns and/or social selling programs to carry out the team's strategies. Senior Digital Marketing Consultants who specialize in paid media and audience development support media planning and optimization across paid search, display and paid social to drive the most effective and efficient campaign performance. Senior Digital Marketing Consultants who specialize in social media execute organic and paid social campaigns, manage content calendars and publishing, and use audience and engagement insights to shape content and targeting. Senior Digital Marketing Consultants who specialize in email marketing support data and list management, segmentation, promotional messaging execution, template setup and adjustment, behavioural rules, and campaign setup and delivery within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Senior Digital Marketing Consultants who specialize in social selling help execute coaching programs to enable the field sales organization to build and strengthen relationships through LinkedIn and the company's social sharing program. Across all specializations, you will coordinate social and email efforts so the two channels reinforce each other.
Travelers Europe currently offers flexibility to employees who wish to work on a hybrid basis in accordance with our Hybrid Work Arrangements Policy. This entails full time employees working three days a week in the office and two days at home (or pro rata for part-time employees). This policy may be changed at the Company’s discretion. What Will You Do? 
 Execute digital and content marketing strategies to raise awareness among target audiences, deepen engagement with valuable content, and increase preference and demand for Travelers using digital platforms, including social media and email.
 Develop an understanding of key performance indicators (KPIs) and other performance measurement methods to support optimization strategies and tests, drive efficient results, and enhance engagement, acquisition and/or retention in support of the marketing strategy and business objectives.
 Deploy digital marketing, social media and paid advertising campaigns and/or social selling field activation programs using in-house and vendor-supplied tools, including trafficking, tracking, approvals and testing before launch.
 For paid media and audience, research daily and weekly media performance, including paid social, to recommend media optimization strategies and tests, including content, targeting and channel mix, to drive efficient campaign results in support of the content marketing strategy and business objectives.
 For social media, plan and publish organic and paid social content, research daily and weekly social performance, and recommend strategies and tests around content themes, posting cadence, targeting and platform mix. Share audience and engagement insights with the email team to inform segmentation and messaging.
 For email marketing, research daily and weekly email performance and recommend strategies and specific tests around topic flow and calendar/frequency, targeting/segmentation, personalization and/or Salesforce Marketing Cloud journeys to drive efficient campaign results in support of the overall email marketing strategy. Use social engagement insights to refine audiences and messaging.
 For social selling, support the execution of comprehensive coaching programs, including live training for Field Sales on LinkedIn Sales Navigator and social sharing tools, integration with the Field Marketing team’s Salesforce and Seismic activation efforts, and partnerships with other teams (for example, Communications and Talent Acquisition) on their social media initiatives.
 Leverage marketing technology tools to execute campaigns (for example, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and LiveRamp) while serving as a secondary point of contact for external vendors (agencies, marketing technology vendors and others).
 Participate in departmental projects and initiatives aimed at establishing top-tier digital marketing practices throughout the company.
 Perform other duties as assigned. 
 What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have? 
 For email marketing specialists, prior experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
 For social media specialists, prior experience managing organic and/or paid social campaigns.
 For social selling specialists, prior experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
 Reliable and collaborative approach that works effectively and positively with both internal departments and cross-functional teams.
 Experience reporting on campaign results and working with both analytical and creative teams.
 Experience working with marketing technology and data.
 Verbal and written communication skills.
 Time and project management skills.
 What is a Must Have? 
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
 Digital marketing experience, preferably in the relevant area of specialization.
 What Is in It for You? 
 Private Medical Insuran ce:  On commencement of employment, you are eligible for single cover provided by Travelers, with the option to add cover for your dependents, at your expense through payroll deduction.
 Retirement: Travelers will make a core contribution of a percentage of salary to your Pension Plan. Additionally, if you decide to contribute to the plan, you will receive an increased company contribution. 
 Holiday Entitlement:  Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 25 days holiday entitlement annually, plus the opportunity to purchase additional days to allow for up to a total of 35 holidays per year.
 Wellness Programme: The Travelers wellness programme is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health programme provides access to free professional counseling services and other resources that support your daily life needs. 
 Volunteer Encouragement:  We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards programme that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.
 Employment Practices 
 Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
Core Responsibilities 
 Serve as a senior technical leader for traditional and agentic AI/ML capabilities supporting enterprise conversational AI across voice, chat, and emerging agentic experiences while providing technical direction and guiding complex solutions from design through production.
 Drive Data Science across the full AI lifecycle, from problem formulation, research and experimentation through solution design, development, evaluation, deployment readiness, production measurement, and continuous optimization.
 Lead development and optimization of traditional and agentic AI/ML solutions, including supervised and unsupervised learning, NLP, Generative AI, LLM-based applications, agentic systems, classification models, and knowledge/retrieval-based solutions.
 Advance evaluation and production intelligence for conversational AI, establishing rigorous methods to assess functional accuracy, user-need fulfillment, reliability, and other system-level behaviors.
 Develop scalable evaluation approaches that enable teams to identify failure modes, compare solutions, establish benchmarks, and make evidence-based release decisions. 
 Apply strong analytical and statistical thinking to uncover patterns in large and complex datasets, diagnose model and system behavior, perform root-cause analysis, design experiments, quantify uncertainty, and translate findings into actionable product and engineering recommendations.
 Turn complex data into clear, cohesive stories and actionable insights, combining exploratory analysis, visualization, statistical reasoning, and business context to deliver diagnostic metrics and product improvements.
 Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, UX, Analytics, Risk and other stakeholders as an embedded technical leader, translating ambiguous business and client problems into measurable Data Science problems and scalable AI solutions
 Establish technical standards and best practices for model development, experimentation, evaluation, validation, observability, explainability, documentation, and responsible use of AI.
 Drive continuous improvement of conversational and agentic systems by converting evaluation and production signals into hypotheses, experiments, model/prompt/system improvements, and measurable outcomes.
 Communicate complex AI/ML concepts, findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and influence decisions across cross-functional teams.
 Stay current with advances in AI and Data Science and evaluate emerging methods, models, frameworks, and architectures.
 Qualifications 
 10+ years of relevant Data Science, Machine Learning, or applied AI experience, with demonstrated experience leading complex technical work; prior people leadership or technical team leadership strongly preferred. 
 Strong practical foundation in machine learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model development, validation, experimentation, and performance measurement.
 Demonstrated expertise in Natural Language Processing and Generative AI, with a strong understanding of transformer architectures, embeddings, LLMs, prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, and modern language-model development patterns.
 Hands-on experience designing, building, evaluating, or optimizing agentic AI systems, including areas such as orchestration/routing, tool use, knowledge retrieval, multi-turn conversational behavior, and agent evaluation.
 Strong Python and data-analysis skills, with experience working with large datasets and using modern ML/Data Science libraries and development environments.
 Experience with AI/ML evaluation and observability, including developing evaluation datasets, metrics, benchmarks, automated evaluations, production monitoring, failure analysis, and methods for connecting model/system behavior to client or business outcomes.
 Ability to move comfortably between technical depth and business context, translating loosely defined problems into hypotheses, analytical approaches, measurable success criteria, and actionable recommendations.
 Demonstrated ability to lead and develop Data Scientists, provide thoughtful technical review, establish engineering and modeling standards, manage competing priorities, and create an environment of accountability, learning, and experimentation.
 Strong data analytics, visualization, and storytelling skills to turn complex data into actionable insights.
 Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts and influence Product, Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, Risk, and senior business stakeholders.
 Education 
 Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Advanced degree preferred. 
 Special Factors 
 Sponsorship 
Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position. 
 About Vanguard 
 At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.
 To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.
 How We Work 
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.
