 Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Business Execution Consultant.
 In this role, you will: 
 Lead support functions or operations for multiple business groups and contribute to large scale strategic initiatives
 Ensure efficiency, quality, cost effectiveness of solutions, and pipeline management relating to assigned operations
 Research moderately complex business, operational, and strategic initiatives that require analytical skills, basic knowledge of organizational strategy and Business Execution, and understanding of international business
 Work independently to make recommendations for support function by providing support and leadership
 Assist in the planning and execution of a variety of programs and initiatives that may include risk mitigation, efficiency, and customer experience
 Collaborate and consult with team leaders in developing project plans, policies and procedures
 Provide leadership in management of relationships and implementation of programs, services, and initiatives with cross functional business partners
 Required Qualifications: 
 4+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
 Desired Qualifications: 
 Manage third-party due diligence activities across the relationship lifecycle, including planning and intake, onboarding, risk assessment, contracting, ongoing monitoring, change events, renewal, and termination.
 Assess and document the business rationale for engaging a third party, including the nature, scope, criticality, data access, technology dependency, regulatory considerations, and inherent risks associated with the proposed service.
 Job Expectations: 
 Apply in-depth knowledge of third-party risk management principles to identify, assess, document, escalate, and support the mitigation of risks related to cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, operational resilience, business continuity, regulatory compliance, financial viability, subcontractor use, concentration, and reputational exposure.
 Evaluate different service types, delivery models, engagement structures, and third-party dependencies to determine applicable due diligence requirements, risk domains, control expectations, and level of ongoing oversight.
 Partner with business stakeholders to gather complete and accurate information regarding the service, data flows, system access, locations, subcontractors, critical processes, and intended use of the third party.
 Review submitted documentation and stakeholder responses for completeness, consistency, and accuracy; identify information gaps; obtain clarifications; and ensure due diligence records are maintained in the designated system with a clear audit trail.
 Coordinate with Lines of Business, Risk Partners, Legal, Compliance, Technology, Information Security, Sourcing, and other subject matter experts to resolve questions, address control gaps, and support timely completion of risk evaluations.
 Serve as a subject matter expert for new and existing third-party relationships by interpreting policy requirements, identifying material risks, advising stakeholders on required actions, and supporting risk-based decisions.
 Translate complex risk, policy, and control requirements into clear, practical, and actionable guidance for business stakeholders, enabling them to understand their responsibilities and meet established requirements.
 Exercise independent judgment and effective challenge when business responses, proposed controls, risk acceptance decisions, or supporting evidence do not adequately address identified exposure or policy expectations.
 Provide timely interim updates, escalation communications, final assessment outcomes, and recommended next steps to relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency regarding open issues, dependencies, and potential delays.
 Monitor remediation plans, control gaps, exceptions, and outstanding actions through closure; escalate overdue or material items in accordance with governance and risk-management requirements.
 Identify areas of operational strength and opportunities to improve business execution, workflow discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder experience, cycle time, control effectiveness, and adherence to service-level expectations.
 Research, develop, and recommend process improvements, action plans, standard procedures, controls, reporting mechanisms, and strategic approaches that improve the effectiveness and scalability of the third-party risk management program.
 Track performance against established metrics and policy requirements, analyze trends and recurring issues, and present clear recommendations to management for strengthening risk governance and business performance.
 Maintain current knowledge of enterprise third-party risk management policies, standards, procedures, regulatory expectations, and industry practices, and apply that knowledge consistently across assigned engagements.
 Assess third-party technology, cloud, software-as-a-service, and artificial intelligence use cases in coordination with relevant specialists, considering factors such as data handling, access controls, model governance, human oversight, transparency, resilience, subcontractor dependencies, and compliance with technology and vendor-management requirements.
 Support an accountable, collaborative, and risk-aware culture by managing multiple priorities, meeting committed timelines, maintaining high-quality documentation, and communicating professionally with stakeholders at all levels.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
About this role: 
 Wells Fargo is seeking a Business Execution Consultant.
 In this role, you will: 
 Participate in a variety of assigned and ongoing business operations to ensure success in meeting business goals and objectives
 Identify opportunities for process improvement by conducting root cause testing of all compliance and business metrics
 Determine areas of strength or Business Execution opportunity within defined scope of work
 Review and research strategies and action plans to establish effective processes while meeting performance metrics and policy expectations
 Utilize independent judgment to guide moderate risk deliverables
 Present recommendations to develop, implement, and monitor strategic approaches, effectiveness of support function, and business performance improvement opportunities for managing risks of the business
 Exercise independent judgment and provide guidance in diverse support functions and operations for a single business group within a line of business
 Collaborate and consult with leaders and executive management
 Provide work direction to less experienced Strategy and Execution staff
 Required Qualifications: 
 2+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
 Desired Qualifications: 
 Possess strong knowledge of banking products and services across key lines of business, including Consumer Lending, Commercial Banking, Wealth & Investment Banking, Trade Finance, and Capital Markets.
 Manage third-party due diligence activities across the relationship lifecycle, including planning and intake, onboarding, risk assessment, contracting, ongoing monitoring, change events, renewal, and termination.
 Job Expectations: 
 Assess and document the business rationale for engaging a third party, including the nature, scope, criticality, data access, technology dependency, regulatory considerations, and inherent risks associated with the proposed service.
 Apply in-depth knowledge of third-party risk management principles to identify, assess, document, escalate, and support the mitigation of risks related to cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, operational resilience, business continuity, regulatory compliance, financial viability, subcontractor use, concentration, and reputational exposure.
 Evaluate different service types, delivery models, engagement structures, and third-party dependencies to determine applicable due diligence requirements, risk domains, control expectations, and level of ongoing oversight.
 Partner with business stakeholders to gather complete and accurate information regarding the service, data flows, system access, locations, subcontractors, critical processes, and intended use of the third party.
 Review submitted documentation and stakeholder responses for completeness, consistency, and accuracy; identify information gaps; obtain clarifications; and ensure due diligence records are maintained in the designated system with a clear audit trail.
 Coordinate with Lines of Business, Risk Partners, Legal, Compliance, Technology, Information Security, Sourcing, and other subject matter experts to resolve questions, address control gaps, and support timely completion of risk evaluations.
 Serve as a subject matter expert for new and existing third-party relationships by interpreting policy requirements, identifying material risks, advising stakeholders on required actions, and supporting risk-based decisions.
 Translate complex risk, policy, and control requirements into clear, practical, and actionable guidance for business stakeholders, enabling them to understand their responsibilities and meet established requirements.
 Exercise independent judgment and effective challenge when business responses, proposed controls, risk acceptance decisions, or supporting evidence do not adequately address identified exposure or policy expectations.
 Provide timely interim updates, escalation communications, final assessment outcomes, and recommended next steps to relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency regarding open issues, dependencies, and potential delays.
 Monitor remediation plans, control gaps, exceptions, and outstanding actions through closure; escalate overdue or material items in accordance with governance and risk-management requirements.
 Identify areas of operational strength and opportunities to improve business execution, workflow discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder experience, cycle time, control effectiveness, and adherence to service-level expectations.
 Research, develop, and recommend process improvements, action plans, standard procedures, controls, reporting mechanisms, and strategic approaches that improve the effectiveness and scalability of the third-party risk management program.
 Track performance against established metrics and policy requirements, analyze trends and recurring issues, and present clear recommendations to management for strengthening risk governance and business performance.
 Maintain current knowledge of enterprise third-party risk management policies, standards, procedures, regulatory expectations, and industry practices, and apply that knowledge consistently across assigned engagements.
 Assess third-party technology, cloud, software-as-a-service, and artificial intelligence use cases in coordination with relevant specialists, considering factors such as data handling, access controls, model governance, human oversight, transparency, resilience, subcontractor dependencies, and compliance with technology and vendor-management requirements.
 Support an accountable, collaborative, and risk-aware culture by managing multiple priorities, meeting committed timelines, maintaining high-quality documentation, and communicating professionally with stakeholders at all levels.

 Wells Fargo is seeking a Quantitative Analytics Specialist - AI Research Scientist for Foundation Models & Agentic AI to join the Frontier AI Model Methodology team. This team plays an important role in developing and implementing methodologies, AI agents, and technology solutions that help improve and accelerate model development and validation processes across the organization.
 In this role, you will support the cutting-edge applied research and development initiatives in Artificial Intelligence, with a focus on building the next generation of Foundation Models, Agentic AI solutions, and Generative AI systems.

 Support highly complex research projects in AI / Generative AI / Agentic AI / Machine Learning from ideation, experimentation, implementation, evaluation and documentation. 
 Support building the next generation of foundation models and agentic AI systems - exploration, application, and rigorous evaluation of emerging AI technologies that solve real-world challenges.
 Collaborate closely with interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, data scientists, applied engineers, and domain experts.
 Translate research insights into impactful business solutions, open-source contributions, patents, and publications.

 Publish in top-tier AI/ML conferences and journals and represent Wells Fargo in the broader AI research community.

 2+ years of Quantitative Analytics experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

 PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related computational field, or an MSc with at least 3 years of relevant applied research or industry experience.

 Deep expertise in one or more specialized areas, including but not limited to: Foundation Models (GPT-4, BERT, LLaMA, Claude), Large Language Models (LLMs), Large Reasoning Models, Multimodal Models, Agentic AI

 Experience with transferring foundation models, LLMs, and agentic AI systems in production

 Wells Fargo is seeking a Mortgage Retail Sales Consultant (SAFE) in Consumer Lending as part of Home Lending. For additional information on this line of business, refer to the external Careers Site at www.wellsfargojobs.com .
 In this role you will: 
 Participate in soliciting residential mortgages from various sources
 Produce high quality loans which are compliant and provide excellent customer service
 Build relationships with realtors, builders, financial professionals, bank stores, past customers, and other non-traditional sources
 Develop and maintain a high degree of visibility for Wells Fargo Home Mortgage in the marketplace; stay informed of mortgage industry trends and developments in the assigned market
 Present recommendations for producing loans and exercise some independent judgment while developing understanding of and adherence to Mortgage Retail Sales functional area, policies, procedures, compliance requirements, and generating loans
 Understand real estate appraisals, title reports, and real estate transactions
 Receive customer applications, quote the rate and points, and complete follow-up activities with the registration lock-in; analyze and offer mortgage loan products based on client needs
 Review and analyze low to moderately complex financial and credit data; match customer needs with an appropriate loan program and level of risk
 Inform prospective and existing customers of Wells Fargo Home Mortgage programs, rates, policies, underwriting requirements, and loan procedures; maintain high standard of client satisfaction and quality by ensuring timely and proactive customer communication
 Pursue Wells Fargo training offerings to increase knowledge of company products, policies and procedures, and underwriting requirements
 This SAFE position has customer contact and job duties which may include the offering/negotiating of terms and/or taking an application for a dwelling secured transaction. As such, this position requires compliance with the S.A.F.E. Mortgage Licensing Act of 2008 and all related regulations. Ongoing employment is contingent upon meeting all such requirements, including acceptable background investigation results. Individuals in a SAFE position also must meet the Loan Originator requirements under Regulation Z (LO) outlined in the job expectations below
 Required Qualifications: 
 2+ years of Mortgage Retail Sales experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, or education
 Desired Qualifications: 
 Basic Microsoft Office skills
 Experience with retail residential mortgage, purchase fundings over the past 12 months referred primarily from established, local or external sources
 Experience with educating clients on various mortgage programs
 Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
 Mortgage industry experience 
 Knowledge and understanding of sales prospecting and generating referrals
 Experience developing and cultivating professional relationships
 Bilingual speaking proficiency in Spanish/English
 Customer service experience
 Job Expectations: 
 This position requires SAFE registration at the time of employment. Wells Fargo will initiate the SAFE registration process immediately after your employment start date. The Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System (NMLS) website (http://fedregistry.nationwidelicensingsystem.org) provides the MU4R questions and registration required for employment in this position. Individuals in Loan Originator (LO) positions must meet the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau qualification requirements and comply with related Wells Fargo policies. The LO qualification requirements include meeting applicable financial responsibility, character, general financial fitness and criminal background standards. A current credit report will be used to assess your financial responsibility and credit fitness, however, a credit score is not included as part of the evaluation. Successful candidates must also meet ongoing regulatory requirements including additional screening, if necessary
 Reliable transportation
 Ability to work nights, weekends, and/or holidays as needed or scheduled
 Pay Range 
Compensation includes an hourly base pay rate that meets or exceeds applicable minimum wage requirements, with the opportunity to earn additional commission. All pay complies with applicable minimum wage laws. 
 Benefits 
 Wells Fargo provides eligible employees with a comprehensive set of benefits, many of which are listed below. Visit  Benefits - Wells Fargo Jobs for an overview of the following benefit plans and programs offered to employees.
 Health benefits
 401(k) Plan
 Paid time off
 Disability benefits
 Life insurance, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance
 Parental leave
 Critical caregiving leave
 Discounts and savings
 Commuter benefits
 Tuition reimbursement
 Scholarships for dependent children
 Adoption reimbursement
 Posting End Date: 
27 Nov 2026 * Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants. 
 We Value Equal Opportunity 
 Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. 
 Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

jobs.description:
About this role: 
 At Wells Fargo, a Fraud & Claims Operations Representative is a front-line role in a high-volume call center, supporting customers through potential fraud situations. You will protect customers and the organization by identifying, investigating, and resolving fraud and claims in a fast-paced, high-volume call center environment. You’ll engage directly with customers to handle sensitive situations, analyze account activity, and make informed decisions across multiple claim types.
 In this role, you will: 
 Support fraud and claims investigations by reviewing customer information, account activity, and transactions
 Manage moderately complex fraud and claims cases across multiple claim types and prioritize work effectively in a high-volume, call center environment
 Oversee assigned cases, using critical thinking and sound judgment to determine next steps and ensure accurate, timely resolution through voice and non-voice functions
 Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, especially in sensitive situations, to build understanding and trust
 Navigate escalated or challenging interactions with professionalism while balancing customer experience, risk, and regulatory requirements
 Partner with internal teams and stakeholders to resolve cases and support effective, end-to-end investigations
 Maintain a strong understanding of fraud risk and consistently apply that perspective to make informed, accurate decisions
 Required Qualifications: 
 1+ year of customer service support experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
 PHL only: 1+ year of experience in financial services in a similar industry (call center or international banks)
 U.S. only: Bilingual speaking proficiency in Spanish (optional)
 Required Qualifications for Europe, Middle East & Africa only: 
 Experience in customer service support, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, education
 Desired Qualifications: 
 Understanding of compliance and risk requirements in financial services or other regulated environments
 Demonstrated skill gathering, validating, and documenting customer and account information to support fraud and claims investigations in a call center environment
 Experience in analyzing account activity, identifying fraud indicators, and making sound risk-based decisions
 Success navigating multiple systems, tools, and procedures in a high-volume environment while maintaining accuracy and quality
 Customer interaction skills, including active listening, effective questioning, de-escalation, and accurate case documentation
 Critical thinking, problem-solving, and collaboration skills demonstrated through effective decision-making and adapting to changing priorities
 Bilingual verbal proficiency in Spanish (optional)
 Job Expectations: 
 U.S. and PHL only: Must be able to pass a Language Assessment
 U.S. only: This role is not eligible for Visa sponsorship

jobs.title: Senior Wealth Underwriter
jobs.description:
About this role: 
 Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Wealth Underwrite experienced in Commercial Real Estate Lending Underwriter with strong expertise in borrower and collateral underwriting. The candidate should be skilled in analyzing personal and business financial statements, interpreting U.S. tax returns, evaluating entity structures, and determining global cash flows and key financial ratios. The role requires in-depth knowledge of CRE collateral analysis, including property performance, cash flow assessment, market risk evaluation, and review of third-party reports such as appraisals and environmental reports. The underwriter will prepare comprehensive credit memoranda and provide well-supported lending recommendations. Additionally, the candidate will be responsible for portfolio monitoring, covenant compliance, annual reviews, and managing loan renewal, modification, and servicing requests for assigned relationships
 In this role, you will: 
 Lead or participate in moderately complex initiatives and deliverables and contribute to large-scale planning related to Wealth Underwriting
 Review, analyze, and evaluate borrower financial data for moderately complex high-net-worth loans to determine credit worthiness and monitor existing portfolio to identify issues that require an in-depth evaluation of variable factors; present recommendations for resolving moderately complex situations
 Independently resolve moderately complex business, operational, or technical issues and lead team to meet deliverables while leveraging solid understanding of Wealth Underwriting functional area policies, procedures, regulations, and compliance requirements
 Develop solid understanding of Commercial Real Estate Lending policies, procedures, regulations, and compliance requirements for Wealth Investment Management client as needed
 Collaborate and consult with Wealth Underwriting peers, colleagues, and mid-level managers to resolve issues and achieve goals; serve as a mentor for lower level staff
 Provide input to assist leaders with credit risk management decisions to ensure satisfactory credit portfolio risk examinations
 Required Qualifications: 
 7+ years of Wealth Underwriting experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
 Desired Qualification 
 Borrower and Financial Analysis 
 Perform comprehensive credit analysis of individuals, trusts, partnerships, LLCs, corporations, and other borrowing entities.
 Analyze Personal Financial Statements (PFS), business financial statements, and supporting documentation to assess borrower strength, liquidity, leverage, and repayment capacity.
 Review and interpret U.S. tax returns, including individual (Form 1040), partnership (Form 1065), corporate (Forms 1120/1120S), and trust returns, to determine sustainable cash flow and identify potential risks.
 Evaluate organizational and formation documents, ownership structures, guarantor relationships, and complex entity structures.
 Calculate and interpret key financial metrics, including debt service coverage ratios, liquidity metrics, leverage ratios, debt-to-income ratios, net worth calculations, and global cash flow analysis.
 Perform detailed reviews of balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and supporting schedules to identify trends, risks, and mitigating factors.
 Commercial Real Estate Collateral Underwriting 
 Conduct thorough collateral reviews across various commercial real estate asset classes, including multifamily, office, retail, industrial, hospitality, mixed-use, and special-purpose properties.
 Analyze property operating statements, rent rolls, leasing trends, occupancy levels, and historical operating performance.
 Evaluate property cash flows and determine stabilized Net Operating Income (NOI), Debt Service Coverage Ratios (DSCR), and valuation metrics.
 Review third-party reports such as appraisal reports, environmental assessments, engineering/property condition reports, market studies, flood determinations, and title reports.
 Assess market fundamentals, economic trends, competitive positioning, and property-specific risks impacting collateral performance.
 Credit Underwriting and Risk Assessment 
 Integrate borrower, guarantor, collateral, and market analysis to form an independent credit opinion.
 Identify key credit strengths, weaknesses, risks, and mitigants associated with lending transactions.
 Prepare detailed and well-supported credit memoranda summarizing financial analysis, collateral evaluation, market conditions, risk assessments, and lending recommendations.
 Ensure underwriting analysis complies with internal credit policies, regulatory requirements, and risk management standards.
 Partner with relationship managers, credit officers, portfolio managers, legal teams, and other stakeholders throughout the credit approval process.
 Portfolio Management and Monitoring 
 Perform ongoing monitoring of assigned loan portfolios to ensure credit quality and policy compliance.
 Track and review financial covenant compliance, reporting requirements, borrowing base submissions, and other post-closing obligations.
 Complete annual reviews, periodic risk assessments, and portfolio surveillance activities.
 Evaluate loan modification requests, renewals, extension requests, and other portfolio management activities.
 Monitor market conditions and borrower performance to identify emerging risks and recommend appropriate actions.
 Ensure timely completion of assigned portfolio management and credit administration responsibilities.

jobs.description:
About CITI 
 Citi's mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We have 200 years of experience helping our clients meet the world's toughest challenges and embrace its greatest opportunities.
 Analytics and Information Management (AIM) 
 Citi AIM was established in 2003, and is located across multiple cities in India – Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune and Mumbai. It is a global community that objectively connects and analyzes information, to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. It identifies fact-based opportunities for revenue growth in partnership with the businesses. The function balances customer needs, business strategy, and profit objectives using best in class and relevant analytic methodologies.
 What do we do? 
 The North America and APAC Consumer bank information management team provides reporting and business Insights support to help the business monitor/size the impact of various business strategies, campaigns and portfolio actions.
 The team helps the business take strategic decisions based on lots of data exploration, thorough understanding of business needs backed by structured thinking.
 Few notables among the multiple areas that we work in:
 Drive Strategic Business Solutions & Insights : Relevant insights to the business that can accelerate strategic decisions effectively pointing towards early data trends and their drivers
 Business critical Dashboards : self-explanatory and detailed dashboards to review the portfolio health with the business leaders with analytical backing of particular trends of interest
 Assessing Campaign Impacts : Understand the campaign setup and through data exploration get the actual campaign performance in terms of P&L. Using the data put together a solution to optimize the marketing spends based on campaign performance.
 Opportunity sizing : Help the business with sizing the impact of various regulatory / market / business / strategic changes to the portfolio
 Process Efficacy : Periodically review existing process and identify potential ways to streamline the process
 Business Intelligence Tools : Deploy existing reports to other advanced reporting platforms
 To achieve the best in class analytical solutions across business units we use the best in class tools and technology.
 The Business Analytics Analyst is a developing professional role. Applies specialty area knowledge in monitoring, assessing, analyzing and/or evaluating processes and data. Identifies policy gaps and formulates policies. Interprets data and makes recommendations. Researches and interprets factual information. Identifies inconsistencies in data or results, defines business issues and formulates recommendations on policies, procedures or practices. Integrates established disciplinary knowledge within own specialty area with basic understanding of related industry practices. Good understanding of how the team interacts with others in accomplishing the objectives of the area. Develops working knowledge of industry practices and standards. Limited but direct impact on the business through the quality of the tasks/services provided. Impact of the job holder is restricted to own team.
 What’s expected from you? 
 As a Business Analytics Analyst 2, we are seeking an experienced analytics candidate who should be able to perform below behaviors in their day to day role: 
 Client Obsession – Create client centric analytical and insightful solutions to accelerate strategic decisioning for the business. Individual should be able to have a holistic view of multiple businesses and develop analytics solutions accordingly.
 Analytic Project Execution – Own and deliver multiple and complex analytical projects. This would require an understanding of business context, deeper understanding of the business critical KPIs along with their behavior and impact, identifying trends and patterns with data
 Stakeholder Management : Experience in stakeholder management across various functions and regions and should be able to effectively handle partner communications.
 Articulation & Presentation Skills : Creating and delivering high class presentations to share the thoughts, the solutions or the problem statement to business stakeholders and senior management
 Ability to coach and mentor juniors .
 Skillset you should possess 
 The most important skill that our analyst should possess is their love for data and their eagerness for new challenges & solving new problems. Apart from these, they should also have the following skillset
 Basic Qualifications 
 Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/computer science/Statistics from premier institutes with 3+ years of experience in delivering analytical solutions
 Experience in working on Credit Cards with good understanding of the PNL
 Ability to identify, clearly articulate and solve complex business problems and present them to the management in a structured and simpler form
 Demonstrate thought leadership to approach open ended problems and build solutions
 Hands-on experience in SAS, SQL & Python
 Experience working with large and multiple datasets, data warehouses and ability to pull data using relevant programs and coding.

 Strong team player

 Control orientated and Risk awareness

 Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities

jobs.title: Stress Testing and Model Risk Expert
jobs.description:
As a Stress Testing and Model Risk Expert, you will coordinate services regarding execution preparation and reporting of the stress risk models across Citi, giving senior stakeholders and regulators confidence in the numbers that guide major business decisions. Sitting within DART – Enterprise Risk & Stress Testing Reporting and Analytics, this role focuses on Wholesale Credit Risk stress loss and capital modelling, supporting ICAAP and regulatory stress testing from methodology through to final results. You will work closely with Model Development Quant teams and Model Risk colleagues, bringing a strong analytical mindset and modern tooling to a function that is central to how Citi manages its risk profile.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Build expertise on Wholesale Credit Risk stress loss and capital models, assessing assumptions, methodology formulation, implementation, and underlying macroeconomic drivers.
 Review projected macroeconomic scenarios used in stress testing exercises, assessing their appropriateness for wholesale portfolio characteristics in combination with stress loss methodology , and alignment with regulatory expectations.
 Review CECL and IFRS9 modelling outputs and assess the quality of overlay governance work.
 Translate business requests into clear data and analytical criteria, then test expected results against regulatory and industry standards.
 Package validation findings into detailed technical documentation that meets regulatory guidelines.
 Assess model limitations and quantify model risk, informing stakeholders and shaping compensating controls.
 Present results and recommendations to senior management
 Periodic interactions with model developers, scenario design teams, and wholesale credit risk stakeholders.
 Required Qualifications & Skills 
 Minimum 6 years of experience in quantitative risk, model development, model validation, stress testing, economic research, or related analytical roles within financial services.
 Strong understanding of ICAAP, regulatory stress testing frameworks, and macroeconomic projections and scenario design.
 Experience assessing the impact of macroeconomic variables on wholesale credit risk implications such as expected credit loss and credit  capital assessment.
 Working knowledge of Wholesale Credit Risk stress loss and capital modelling approaches.
 Working knowledge of CECL and IFRS9 modelling approaches.
 Understanding of model risk frameworks, including model governance, model change processes, limitations, and remediation activities.
 Proficiency in Python or another statistical or analytical programming language.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex analytical findings to senior stakeholders.
 Beneficial Skills & Qualifications 
 Prior experience collaborating directly with Model Development Quant teams and Model Risk teams.
 Comfort using GenAI tools to support analytical and productivity tasks.
 Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple validation projects at once.
 A proactive, self-directed approach to problem-solving in a high-autonomy environment.
 Education: 
 Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience, potentially Masters degree
 By joining Citi Solutions Center Poland, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (currently up to 2 days working at home per week), but also (potentially, subject to final offer) receive a competitive base salary and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits which can include:

jobs.description:
About Citi: 
 Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.
 As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.
 Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.
 The Team: 
 The Startups & Partnerships team is the forward scout of the Citi's Head of AI Organization . Our mandate: identify, evaluate, and rapidly onboard the emerging technologies that will define Citi's next chapter with Artificial Intelligence as our number one strategic priority right now. We don't sit in a lab waiting for ideas to trickle in. We move across every line of business at Citi, sit down directly with business stakeholders and clients, and go toe-to-toe with the sharpest startups and frontier AI labs in the market. We run fast, we run lean, and we run with the full weight of a global institution behind us.
 The Opportunity: 
 As an AI Engineer on the Startups & Partnerships team, you will be at the tip of the spear for Citi's AI strategy - building, testing, and shipping real applications that touch real business problems across the bank, not writing whitepapers about them from the sidelines.
 You'll get a level of exposure that's rare in a Tier-1 global bank: direct access to business requirements, hands-on evaluation of the newest models and platforms from the industry's leading AI labs, and the mandate to move at startup speed inside an institution operating at global scale. If you want to build things that matter, get them in front of real users fast, and shape how one of the world's largest financial institutions adopts AI - this is the seat.
 What You'll Do Day to Day 
 Build and ship AI applications - architect, develop, and deploy production-grade AI-powered tools, pipelines, and workflows that solve real business problems across Citi's lines of business.
 Evaluate emerging AI technology - run structured proof-of-concepts and sandbox "bake-offs" to rapidly assess new models, platforms, and startup tools (LLMs, agentic frameworks, orchestration layers) for real-world fit.
 Prototype at speed - turn a business idea into a working demo in days, not quarters, and iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback.
 Integrate across the stack - connect LLMs and agentic systems to enterprise APIs, data pipelines, and lightweight front-end or tooling layers to deliver end-to-end working solutions.
 Deliver PoCs into production pathways - work with governance, risk, and platform teams to shepherd validated solutions from prototype toward scaled deployment.
 Communicate impact - translate technical work into clear, compelling narratives for senior business and technology stakeholders.
 Required Skills 
 A full-stack engineer with applied AI/LLM experience - this is explicitly not a data science or ML research role. We need builders, not modelers.
 Proven experience building and shipping AI applications, pipelines, and workflows in live, production environments - not just notebooks and academic experiments.
 Hands-on proficiency with Large Language Models (LLMs) , prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks and orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or similar).
 Strong software engineering fundamentals - comfortable working across the stack, from backend services and API integrations to lightweight front-end or internal tooling layers.
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills - you can work directly with business leaders and clients, not just other engineers.
 A track record of learning and adopting new tools and platforms quickly as the AI landscape evolves.
 Comfort operating in a large, regulated, global institution while bringing a startup-speed mentality to your work.
 Nice-to-Have Skills 
 Experience working directly with startups, venture teams, or technology scouting functions.
 Familiarity with vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or knowledge graph-based retrieval.
 Experience with containerization and cloud-native deployment (Docker, Kubernetes) for AI services.
 Prior exposure to financial services, banking, or other highly regulated industries.
 Experience presenting technical concepts to non-technical, senior business audiences.
 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
 Master’s degree preferred

jobs.description:
This role leads the Risk and Controls function within the 1st Line of Defense for Bank Handlowy w Warszawie (Citi Handlowy), responsible for maintaining a high-quality risk and controls environment across the bank. 
 The role ensures the operationalization of Manager's Control Assessment (MCA) guidelines issued by the 2nd Line of Defense, leads the community of Operational Risk Coordinators, owns the MCA-related systems and governance frameworks, and represents Citi Handlowy in Citi's enterprise-wide R&C initiatives as a restricted entity.
 Responsibilities : 
 Act as the Citi Handlowy Risk and Controls Head for the 1st Line of Defense, responsible for maintaining a high-quality risk and controls environment for the bank.
 Strengthen the risk management function within the 1st Line of Defense across identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring and reporting.
 Oversee the country risk profile, ensuring robust control execution and adherence to regulatory standards.
 Operationalize 2nd Line MCA guidelines, establishing effective control designs and Key Risk Indicator (KRI) thresholds.
 Serve as Application Owner for MCA platforms, managing incident escalations and representing entity requirements in system enhancements.
 Manage end-to-end governance for the Business Risk, Compliance and Control Committee (BRCC), including charter ownership, agenda management, and quarterly executive reporting.
 Direct bank-wide Issue Management, conducting impact analysis, supporting timely remediation of complex issues and providing monthly reporting to BRCC.
 Own and administer the Citi Handlowy Escalation Policy, acting as the primary point of contact for operational and committee escalations.
 Lead and support the network of Operational Risk Coordinators across business units through continuous guidance and training.
 Represent Citi Handlowy in Citi’s global R&C initiatives, ensuring compliant adoption aligned with restricted-entity governance rules.
 Qualifications & Skills : 
 Bachelor's/University degree, Master's degree preferred
 10+ years of experience in Risk & Controls, Compliance, Operational Risk, or Audit within the financial services sector
 Proven track record in enhancing internal control environments, developing governance strategies, and driving process improvements
 Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build consensus across multi-disciplinary business lines and functions
 Excellent presentation and communication skills (verbal and written) to engage senior management and committees
 Analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with high attention to detail
 Demonstrated capability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment
 Fluency in both English and Polish (spoken and written)

jobs.description:
Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Associate Consultant, Launch Program 2027 – Milan/Rome, Italy 
Associate Consultant, Launch Program – 2027- Milan/Rome, Italy 
Why join Mastercard’s Launch Program? 
Over the course of this 18-month program, you'll build specialized expertise through hands-on experience, structured learning, and mentorship from industry leaders. You'll work on real business challenges, applying your skills to projects that create meaningful impact. 
Along the way, you'll deepen your knowledge of Mastercard's business, collaborate with teams across the organization, and develop the technical, analytical, and professional capabilities needed to accelerate your career. By the end of the program, you’ll have a strong foundation in your chosen field and the confidence to continue to grow here at Mastercard. 
About the team 
Mastercard’s Advisors & Consulting Services (A&CS) team helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities. 
What you’ll do 
As an Associate Consultant, you will: 
collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions.  
create meaningful contributions through ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality, and more. 
Specialization Tracks 
We are looking for passionate and talented professionals who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs. We are recruiting four specialization tracks that make up our team. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences. 
Strategy & Transformation 
Guide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms. 
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer: 
How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market? 
How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial, and strategic goals? 
Team members typically support 1-3 projects concurrently, with each project lasting for approximately 8-16 weeks. 
Performance Analytics 
Use quantitative and qualitative skills and enterprise applications (e.g., Business Intelligence Platforms, SQL, Python, and more) to drive data-led consulting solutions for customers. Weave together vast amounts of Mastercard, client & 3rd party data assets to investigate trends, build propensity models, develop data visualizations, and synthesize millions of data points into a cohesive story. Engage with client stakeholders through virtual and in-person meetings, leveraging insights to inform strategic recommendations. 
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer: 
How does a financial institution fraud/authorization metrics fare against competitors, and what are strategies that can help it be best-in-class? 
How is a technology customer’s market share changing over time, and are there any segments where the client is relatively under penetrated? 
Team members support typically support several customers concurrently and include both short- and long-term projects that can last anywhere from 4 weeks up to 1 year. 
Marketing 
Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard. 
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer: 
How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications? 
How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer? 
How can a large financial institution best execute a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more? 
Team members typically support 1-3 projects from any domain and build fundamental marketing and consulting toolkit. 
Deploy 
Help clients implement, launch, and scale Mastercard products, platforms, and business transformation initiatives. Combine program management, stakeholder engagement, and implementation expertise to guide complex initiatives from strategy into execution. 
Work closely with client and Mastercard teams, coordinate cross-functional efforts, manage risks and dependencies, and drive adoption to ensure clients realize value from their investments. 
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer: 
How can a financial institution successfully implement and launch a new payments, fraud, or digital banking solution while minimizing disruption to customers and internal teams? 
What governance structure, implementation roadmap, and stakeholder engagement plan will best position a client to deliver a large-scale transformation on time and within scope? 
How can a client accelerate adoption and maximize the value of a newly deployed platform, product, or technology investment across its organization? 
Team members typically support 1-2 projects or customers concurrently in execution and implementation. These projects are usually for 6-12 months. 
What we’re looking for 
Undergraduate or accelerated master’s degree with an expected graduation date between Dec 2026 - August 2027 
Eligibility to work
This position does not have a compensation range. The fixed annual salary for this position is EUR 43,475 gross.
We recruit for and value the following core competencies: 
Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities. 
Analytic Excellence: Demonstrates a strong aptitude for structured problem solving, analytical, and quantitative skills. Experience using data analysis or querying tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Excel or Tableau) is an asset (particularly for Performance Analytics or Business Experimentation tracks). 
Business Interest: Clear interest in the world of business, and intuition for the way that companies make decisions. 
Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities.

Overview 
The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation and optimization (Test & Learn), and data-driven information and risk management services.
Test & Learn 
As a member of the Test & Learn team, you will pioneer industry-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. We are rapidly building new products, improving existing products, and expanding the ways we deliver Test & Learn to our clients. We are looking for innovators who can execute and evolve our analytic strategy, tackling the big challenges of the future. This role will focus on analytic research; pushing the boundaries for our analytics by finding ways to apply new data science methods to top business challenges and translating it into novel products, and scalable commercial solutions. 
Position Responsibilities 
Drive the research of new functionality within an analytics platform used by the world's largest organizations to make critical, multi-million-dollar decisions. 
Work cross-functionally with product management to understand and solve customer needs requiring novel analytic solutions 
Work hand-in-hand with engineering teams to help guide the implementation of your analytic ideas into our products 
Collaborate with leaders across the business unit to identify problems and drive innovative solutions. 
All About You 
5+ years experience in data science OR equivalent graduate coursework.
Experience of applying machine learning, causal inference, and/or generative and agentic AI to real world problems.
Strong technical aptitude and ability to understand complex technical concepts, coupled with strong business acumen to identify applications of technology to solve commercial questions

 Job Description 
Allstate’s Data & Analytics Technology organization is seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable, reliable, and high performing data pipelines that support enterprise analytics, reporting, and advanced data use cases. In this role, you will focus on building robust batch and streaming data solutions using Apache Spark and modern cloud data platforms. Experience with Microsoft Fabric is a strong plus.
You will work closely with analytics engineers, data scientists, product teams, and platform partners to transform raw, complex data into trusted, analytics ready datasets. This role plays a critical part in enabling data driven decision making by ensuring data quality, performance, scalability, and operational excellence across the data platform. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, build, and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Apache Spark and cloud‑native data technologies.
 Develop and optimize ETL/ELT workflows to ingest, transform, and curate data from diverse source systems into analytics‑ready datasets.
 Implement data modeling and transformation logic to support reporting, dashboards, and downstream analytical and machine learning workloads.
 Build and manage data processing workloads within modern Lakehouse platforms, including Microsoft Fabric / One Lake (preferred).
 Ensure data quality, reliability, and consistency by implementing validation checks, monitoring, and reconciliation processes.
 Optimize Spark jobs for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability across large and complex datasets.
 Manage and evolve data schemas while handling schema drift and upstream source changes.
 Develop reusable frameworks, libraries, and standardized patterns to improve data engineering productivity and consistency.
 Implement CI/CD pipelines for data workloads to enable automated testing, deployment, and rollback.
 Monitor data pipelines and jobs, troubleshoot failures, and resolve performance or data quality issues.
 Partner with analytics engineers, BI developers, and data scientists to understand data requirements and deliver curated datasets.
 Collaborate with platform, security, and governance teams to ensure data security, compliance, and proper access controls.
 Contribute to Agile delivery processes, including sprint planning, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
 Required Qualifications 
 Strong experience as a Data Engineer building and operating production data pipelines.
 Hands‑on experience with Apache Spark for large‑scale data processing.
 Proficiency in Python , SQL , and data transformation best practices.
 Experience with cloud‑based data platforms and storage (e.g., Data Lakes, Lakehouse architectures).
 Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric , One Lake , or similar analytics platforms (strong plus).
 Experience designing and optimizing data models for analytical workloads.
 Understanding of distributed data processing concepts, performance tuning, and fault tolerance.
 Experience with CI/CD, version control, and infrastructure‑as‑code concepts.
 Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex data issues.
 Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and non‑technical teams.
 4+ years of experience in data engineering or equivalent role (preferred).
 Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have Skills 
 Experience with real‑time or event‑driven data processing.
 Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.
 Exposure to orchestration tools and workflow management systems.
 Experience supporting analytical, reporting, or machine learning use cases.

 This job does not have supervisory responsibilities.

 Join our Network Security Engineering team and help secure and modernize critical enterprise infrastructure. As a Senior Consultant I, you will engineer, support, automate, and maintain network security platforms that protect the organization while improving reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
 We're looking for an experienced engineer with a strong foundation in networking and network security who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and leveraging automation to drive better outcomes. You'll work with technologies such as enterprise firewall platforms, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, scripting, and automation frameworks to streamline operations and enhance platform performance.
 This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, works independently, and delivers high-quality engineering solutions with limited oversight. You'll troubleshoot complex network and security issues, implement infrastructure improvements, support automation initiatives, and contribute ideas that help advance the team's engineering practices.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Engineer, support, and maintain enterprise network security platforms, including Palo Alto Networks and related security technologies.
 Implement, test, and validate network security solutions across enterprise and cloud environments.
 Troubleshoot complex network, firewall, routing, connectivity, and application communication issues.
 Develop and maintain automation using scripting, APIs, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and configuration management tools.
 Build and support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment, testing, validation, and configuration management.
 Create automated pre- and post-change validation processes to improve reliability, consistency, and operational efficiency.
 Integrate security platforms with monitoring, deployment, and operational tooling to enhance visibility and automation.
 Identify and automate repetitive operational tasks to reduce manual effort and improve platform scalability.
 Support platform lifecycle initiatives, including upgrades, vulnerability remediation, technology refreshes, and modernization efforts.
 Partner with network, cloud, security, and application teams to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable solutions.
 Contribute to technical reviews, process improvements, and engineering best practices while operating within established architecture and security standards.
 Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, scripts, and automation.
 Provide technical assistance and knowledge sharing to other members of the team.
 Required Qualifications 
 Strong background in network engineering and network security.
 Strong understanding of core networking technologies and concepts, including: TCP/IP, Routing, Subnetting, NAT, DNS, and application connectivity
 Experience engineering, implementing, or supporting enterprise firewall and network security platforms.
 Experience with Infrastructure as Code concepts, practices, and version-controlled infrastructure.
 Hands-on experience developing scripts and automation for infrastructure engineering and operational use cases, including areas such as: Infrastructure change implementation, Configuration management, Pre-change and post-change validation, Infrastructure monitoring and health checks, Data collection and reporting, Operational troubleshooting, API-driven infrastructure management

jobs.description:
About this role 
 Forward Deployed Business Analyst 
 Your team 
 The BlackRock Transformation Office (BTO) is a global group of change professionals that delivers strategic transformation to help make BlackRock greater than the sum of its parts. We drive 1BLK outcomes by continuously connecting and being students of the firm’s people, processes and technology. 
 We are a versatile team with varied experiences and backgrounds, motivated by the challenge of finding solutions that benefit BlackRock and our clients. In BTO, we focus on developing our people, strengthening leadership and delivery skills, and broadening firm and industry knowledge. Projects and roles consider both successful delivery and individual development objectives and career aspirations. 
 Your role and impact 
 The Forward Deployed Business Analyst will work in cross-functional teams to reimagine, innovate and scale solutions that drive growth and operating models within the firm. 
 This is not a traditional business analysis role centered on gathering requirements and handing them to technology. The role combines business analysis, product discovery, business architecture and hands-on prototyping to turn ambiguous problems into tangible solutions that business users and engineers can test and refine together. 
 Successful candidates will combine the structured thinking of a business analyst, the prioritization instincts of a product owner, the enterprise perspective of a business architect and the bias to action of a hands-on builder. 
 Your responsibilities 
 In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: 
 Take ownership of complex, ambiguous business problems and rapidly translate them into testable solution hypotheses with measurable outcomes. 
 Build structured business context covering terminology, entities, relationships, decision logic, data dependencies, controls and exceptions for use by subject matter experts, AI tools and engineering teams. 
 Decompose business processes into explicit logic, controls and exception paths for implementation by technology teams. 
 Create functional prototypes using AI-enabled development capabilities to discover requirements, challenge assumptions and validate future-state processes, data, policies and controls. 
 Shape the target operating model, including ownership of data, governance, controls, roles and exception management. 
 Partner continuously with business experts, product managers, engineers, architects, data specialists and control partners from discovery through implementation. 
 Develop measurable project objectives, drive consensus, and communicate plans, progress and outcomes effectively to stakeholders and management across levels. 
 Your experience 
 3–5 years of relevant work experience in transformation, product delivery, business architecture, technology-enabled change or a comparable discipline. 
 Experience in business architecture and operating-model design, connecting solutions to business capabilities, roles, governance, policy ownership, controls and exception handling. 
 Proficiency in prototype-led problem solving and rapidly converting ambiguous business problems into functional prototypes that stakeholders can see, test and challenge. 
 Expertise using AI-enabled development environments to accelerate analysis, prototyping, requirements definition and testing, including critically evaluating generated outputs, maintaining traceability and understanding where human judgment remains essential. 
 Experience with iterative delivery and hands-on ownership through cycles of analysis, experimentation and solution shaping. 
 Experience in financial services or a similar industry. 
 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate objectives and influence outcomes. 
 Our benefits 
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
 Our hybrid work model 
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
Guidance on AI use for candidates 
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance  on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
 About BlackRock 
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being.  Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com . We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn , Instagram , YouTube , X , and TikTok .
 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected characteristics at law.

You will work through ambiguity, surface decisions early, and communicate clearly with technical teams, business partners, vendors, and senior leaders.
 Responsibilities
 Lead end-to-end delivery of security infrastructure for office construction and expansion projects, from site assessment and requirements definition through design, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and closeout.

 Oversee system installation, acceptance testing, commissioning, punch-list resolution, documentation, and first-day-of-business readiness.

Who we are
 About Stripe & Clerky
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 Here at Clerky, we build software to make legal paperwork easier for startups and their attorneys. Recently acquired by Stripe, Clerky is now part of Stripe. We're profitable and growing sustainably. We're the most popular way for high-growth technology startups to form, and are also used by many top-tier startups for hiring and fundraising.
 As a Customer Support Specialist at Clerky, you will be the voice of the company to thousands of startup founders, investors, and attorneys. These customers use Clerky to get critical legal paperwork done, often on a tight timeline. Our success is based on word-of-mouth, so we have a strong culture of providing world-class service (ask us about our satisfaction ratings!). We are rabidly customer-centric.
 About the team
 It’s a lot harder here. Helping our customers can be unusually challenging due to the nuanced and specialized nature of their questions. Doing the job well can require a lot of iterative feedback, so we're looking for someone who thinks critically about their writing and is always looking for ways to improve. Along the way, you'll also pick up a lot of knowledge about startups and startup law. 
 The challenges never stop. The level of learning and craftsmanship that goes into writing responses to our customers requires intense focus. If you’re looking for the kind of position where you can easily master all the information at the beginning and work in a way that does not require intense focus, this position will probably not be a good fit for you. On the other hand, if you love learning and constantly challenging yourself, this position could be a good fit for you. 
 There are often no right answers. We’re often not able to provide definitive answers to the questions we receive. In many cases, the best we can do is to equip our customers with the information they need to be able to figure out the right answer on their own, or to understand that it isn’t possible to figure out what the right answer is. If you prefer an environment more oriented around providing definitive answers, this position may not be a good fit for you.
 What you’ll do
 Responsibilities
 Writing thoughtful and empathetic replies to customer emails using our help desk software, Help Scout
 Writing and maintaining help center articles, and identifying topics for new articles based on customer inquiries
 Working with our engineering team to debug software issues our customers encounter
 Using our software to develop and manage new ways for our customers to complete legal paperwork
 Assisting product team by testing new features and bug fixes, and conveying customer feedback
 Spotting trends in customer issues that other team members should be alerted to
 Who you are
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.  
 Minimum requirements
 Genuine love for helping people
 High emotional intelligence
 Logical / analytical thinker
 Exceptional written English communication skills, including the ability to write precisely and succinctly
 Extremely detail-oriented
 Comfort with working remotely and independently
 Technologically savvy - you should be confident in your ability to use new software without training
 Appreciation for giving and receiving feedback often (often several times a day)
