jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Grad
jobs.description:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 
 Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.
 Your role 
 Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.
 To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.
 Who you are 
 Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
 Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
 Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities.  At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.
 Minimum requirements 
 A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience).
 Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
 Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).
 Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.
 Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.
 Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.
 Preferred qualifications 
 One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. 
 Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.
 Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.
 Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.
 Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.

jobs.description:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.  About the team
 The Risk team builds trust, an essential ingredient for Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We make it possible for millions of businesses to access and use Stripe’s financial infrastructure while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader ecosystem from harm.
 Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users.
 At Stripe’s scale—$1.9 trillion in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, processed across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries.
 What you’ll do
 As a Staff Product Manager on the Risk team, you will lead cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives that fundamentally change how Stripe and our users manage risk. You will identify the most important opportunities that cut across Risk’s infrastructure and products, define solutions to our most ambiguous problems, and drive execution from early technical shaping through delivery and adoption.
 You will operate as a product counterpart to Risk’s senior technical leaders. You will shape infrastructure and product direction across Risk, connect work that would otherwise remain fragmented, and help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities. You will remain deeply engaged in the work, helping teams navigate difficult technical and product decisions.
 Responsibilities
 Identify high-leverage problems that cut across teams, turn ambiguity into clear product and technical direction, and establish measurable outcomes.
 Lead major cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives from initial shaping through delivery, adoption, and iteration.
 Lead changes in Risk’s approach to using data and AI to accurately identify and mitigate risk at scale.
 Partner deeply with engineering, data science, and machine learning leaders to shape architecture, data foundations, models, APIs, and product experiences.
 Help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities quickly and effectively while guiding Risk teams toward coherent, reusable infrastructure and product decisions.
 Build alignment among teams with different goals and constraints, resolve difficult tradeoffs, and drive progress without relying on formal authority.
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for an exceptional product leader who combines strong technical judgment with product insight, strategic range, and executional rigor. You identify important problems before they become obvious, bring clarity to deeply ambiguous spaces, and mobilize teams around solutions that work across products, organizations, and time horizons. You are deeply curious and stay at the forefront of advances in AI and technology, finding practical ways to apply them to our most challenging problems.
 You move fluently from defining multi-year strategy to driving the details of execution. You build alignment and lead transformational work across teams without direct management authority. You earn trust through the clarity of your thinking, your focus on users, and your hands-on engagement in the work. You raise the ambition and effectiveness of the teams and product managers around you without needing to manage them.
 Minimum requirements
 A track record of identifying and delivering high-impact, transformational product or technical initiatives that span multiple teams and organizations.
 Demonstrated ability to bring clarity to deeply ambiguous problems, set a compelling direction, and drive work through execution and adoption.
 Strong technical judgment across data, machine learning, AI, APIs, platforms, and system architecture.
 Experience partnering deeply with senior engineering, data science, and product leaders to shape both technical direction and product strategy.
 Strong product judgment across foundational infrastructure and user-facing experiences, with a focus on building capabilities that solve real user problems.
 Deep quantitative fluency and the ability to use data and causal reasoning to understand problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and measure outcomes.
 Proven ability to influence senior leaders, build alignment across organizational boundaries, and drive execution without direct management authority.
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate compelling strategies, influence technical and executive audiences, and make complex topics clear.
 High agency, intellectual honesty, curiosity, and a low-ego, hands-on working style.
 Preferred qualifications 
 An engineering background, preferably with a focus on machine learning.
 Experience applying AI and machine learning to complex, high-stakes problems at scale.
 Experience with fraud, credit, payments, financial services, trust and safety, or another domain involving complex decisions and asymmetric consequences.
 Experience working with globally distributed teams.

jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.
 The Role 
 As an Enterprise Sales Lead, US , you will lead and develop a team of Enterprise Account Executives responsible for winning Square's most strategic sellers and partner with enterprise sales leadership to shape our next stage of growth.
 This is a leadership role for a proven enterprise sales leader who can set strategy, raise execution standards, coach complex deals, and build a high-performing team. You will be accountable for enterprise pipeline, deal quality, forecast discipline, and revenue outcomes across a focused set of high-value prospects and sellers. You’ll lead and develop Enterprise Account Executives while staying close to the most strategic opportunities.
 You’ll partner deeply with Solutions Engineering, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and sales leadership to bring the full Square ecosystem to market.
 This is a hands-on people leadership role for someone who has built and scaled high-performing enterprise sales teams in a market where commerce, payments, software, data, and AI are converging. You'll bring the judgment of an experienced sales leader, the technical curiosity to sell a platform, and the operating discipline to turn an emerging motion into a repeatable business.
 You Will 
 Build and coach a high-performing enterprise team: Hire, develop, and lead Enterprise Account Executives through clear expectations, deal coaching, pipeline inspection, direct feedback, and accountability for results. Raise talent density and set the performance standard for enterprise selling at Square.
 Generate enterprise pipeline: Build a repeatable pipeline-generation motion with Sales Development, Marketing, and Partnerships, combining targeted outbound prospecting, executive engagement, and account-based programs. Own pipeline coverage, not only pipeline inspection.
 Deliver new enterprise acquisition outcomes: Be accountable for pipeline creation, new enterprise seller wins, revenue, and forecast accuracy, and partner with implementation and account teams to turn signed agreements into successful launches and sustained processing volume.
 Establish a rigorous operating cadence: Create consistent rhythms for pipeline reviews, forecast calls, account planning, deal inspection, and performance management, and hold the team to a high standard of accuracy and preparation in each.
 Own account prioritization and coverage: Partner with enterprise sales leadership to translate enterprise priorities into account and territory plans, then direct team capacity toward the prospects with the strongest strategic fit and commercial potential.
 Raise the bar on deal execution and deal quality: Coach the team through complex deal constructs and multi-stakeholder sales cycles spanning executive, technical, commercial, procurement, legal, and finance stakeholders. Hold a high standard on deal economics, implementation feasibility, and commitments Square can deliver.
 Codify repeatable sales motions for upmarket growth: Create scalable approaches to account planning, qualification, discovery, business case development, executive engagement, negotiation, and closing, so wins become repeatable patterns rather than one-offs.
 Lead the most strategic deals from the front: Set account strategy, open executive doors, drive complex negotiations, and clear blockers on the highest-priority pursuits. Build and own trusted relationships with C-level decision-makers, and make the case for Square yourself when the deal demands it.
 Partner cross-functionally to win: Work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, implementation, and sales leadership to align internal teams around strategic opportunities, and move deals forward.
 Turn market insight into business impact: Bring customer, competitor, partner, and market feedback back into Square to influence product, pricing, packaging, partnerships, and go-to-market strategy.
 You Have 
 10+ years of enterprise or strategic sales experience, including a strong track record of exceeding targets and closing complex, high-value deals
 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated record of leading enterprise teams to hit revenue targets and of hiring, ramping, and developing Account Executives who perform
 Experience leading enterprise teams in complex platform, SaaS, fintech, payments, data, or commerce environments
 Experience building pipeline-generation motions, including outbound prospecting, account-based programs, and partner-sourced opportunities
 Proven ability to build territory, segmentation, and coverage strategies in a developing or high-growth market
 Deep experience leading teams through complex, multi-threaded sales cycles involving executive, technical, procurement, legal, and finance stakeholders
 Commercial acumen to coach teams on pricing, negotiation, business case development, deal structure, and deal economics
 Operating and analytical discipline across pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and deal inspection, with comfort using data to improve conversion and make resource decisions
 Executive presence and credibility—you communicate with precision, challenge constructively, and earn trust with senior decision-makers
 Technical curiosity and the ability to sell business value across APIs, integrations, data, automation, and emerging AI use cases
 A customer outcomes mindset, with experience partnering across pre-sales, implementation, customer success, product, and support to set newly won enterprise sellers up for a successful launch
 A builder mentality—you create clarity in ambiguity, take ownership of outcomes, and are energized by building the playbook, not just running an existing one

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
Overview  
 The Global Seller Onboarding team works directly with sellers and internal teams to ensure they are able to take full advantage of Square’s products and services. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists work closely with teams within Sales & Account Management as well as Product Specialists and Product Marketing Managers to deliver a seamless and exceptional merchant experience and give key input into the product roadmaps for customer-facing developer products. Additionally, Global Seller Onboarding Specialists play a key role in merchant discovery and lead the final stages of the sale, working with Square's upmarket sellers and cross-functional teams to successfully implement and activate new accounts.
 Square initially pioneered the simple self-service model to enable small businesses to take a payment. Now, we aspire to expand that same seamless experience up-market. This position will play a pivotal role in establishing seller success needed for us to drive growth, retention, and scale our services up-market. We’re working to find new and better ways to help businesses succeed on their own terms—and we’re looking for people like you to help shape tomorrow at Square.
 Seller Onboarding Expert - L3 (IC) 
 You Will (Responsibilities): 
 Strategic Onboarding & Education (Estimated 70% of work)
 Guide sellers (customers) to start transacting with Square quickly and with confidence, delivering high-quality onboarding and implementation experiences for Square’s SMB and mid-market sellers
 Lead seller-facing scoping and onboarding calls, help sellers along their onboarding journey by delivering tailored, necessary training content, and support sellers after they begin transacting with Square
 Learn and maintain a strong understanding of relevant product features and releases
 Execute onboarding best practices consistently while escalating complex product or technical needs.
 Balance the needs of numerous (20-30) sellers at any given time, ensuring successful completion of each onboarding engagement
 Project / Process Execution (Estimated 20% of work)
  Identify issues or blockers that could affect a seller’s onboarding experience or go-live date, and escalate appropriately to senior team members or cross-functional partners.
 Contribute to improvements in onboarding processes by documenting gaps, proposing refinements, and sharing observations from seller engagements.
 Maintain clear, proactive communication with assigned sellers and demonstrate the ability to maintain an onboarding tracker with key milestones, target dates, and next steps to keep sellers informed and on track for go-live.
 Help sellers understand and complete the steps required for launch, following up on outstanding needs and confirming readiness ahead of their target go-live date.
 Use AI to improve the seller experience and automate or enhance internal processes.
 🤝 Team Collaboration & Skill Development (Estimated 10% of work)
 Share best practices with peers and contribute to a positive team culture.
 Take ownership of keeping product knowledge current, including new features, updates, and known limitations, to provide sellers with accurate guidance.
 Support team knowledge areas (POS, Online, integrations) by developing product expertise and serving as a go-to resource for standard questions.
 Participate in internal meetings, training, roadmap updates, and optimization discussions to build broader product and organizational understanding.
 Escalate product, process, or policy issues clearly and promptly to senior teammates and product teams; assist in resolving routine internal or client concerns.
 Demonstrate reliability and consistency in onboarding execution while learning to manage more complex workflows.
 Comfortable working in a high-volume, high-tempo, customer-focused onboarding environment.
 You Have (Qualifications): 
 2–4+ years of experience in onboarding, implementation, operations, or account management customer support, customer success; relevant industry experience (restaurant, services, retail) is a plus.
 Demonstrated strong performance and consistency in onboarding work (metrics, CSAT, responsiveness, quality).
 Experience managing multiple onboarding projects simultaneously with reliable delivery.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; professionalism in client and stakeholder interactions.
 Proactive attitude and eagerness to learn; ability to apply feedback quickly.
 Strong time-management and organizational skills.
 Comfort operating through change and ambiguity with appropriate support.
 Familiarity with project management practices.
 Basic understanding of data analysis or reporting tools (Looker, Salesforce, etc.) is a plus.
 Strong understanding and consistent usage of AI tools and platforms
 Perks 
 At Square, we want you to be well and thrive. Our global benefits package includes:
 Healthcare coverage
 Retirement Plans
 Work from home flexibility 
 Employee Stock Purchase Program
 Wellness perks
 Paid parental leave
 Paid time off
 Learning and Development resources

jobs.title: IT Audit Senior Manager
jobs.location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.
 The Role 
 Square Financial Services is seeking an IT Audit Senior Manager with deep technical audit expertise and direct experience auditing regulated financial institutions. In this role you will lead and personally execute risk-based operational, technology, and cybersecurity audits from risk assessment and scoping through testing, reporting, and remediation validation. As well as assess the systems, infrastructure, applications, and technology service providers supporting banking activities, including services delivered through affiliated entities.
 You Will 
 Plan and perform risk-based IT audits, including technical walkthroughs, control design assessments, operating effectiveness testing, workpaper preparation, and reporting.
 Assess technology and cybersecurity risks across identity and access management, privileged access, cloud and infrastructure security, network security, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and incident response.
 Audit banking applications and supporting interfaces, including systems supporting lending, deposits, and payments, with attention to application controls, data integrity, and automated processing.
 Evaluate third-party and affiliate-provided technology services, including the Bank’s oversight, service dependencies, assurance coverage, and accountability for controls.
 Maintain the IT audit universe and risk assessment, inform the annual audit plan, and adjust coverage for emerging risks, new products, and significant technology changes.
 Contribute to audit methodology, coach colleagues, and support integrated audits by assessing technology risks within broader banking processes.
 You Have 
 7+ years of IT audit experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for engagements within a regulated financial institution.
 Strong understanding of internal controls, risk assessment, and audit methodologies, with experience driving continuous improvement in audit processes, risk coverage, and/or issue management.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
 Demonstrated ability to apply data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) tools across the audit lifecycle to strengthen risk assessment and testing.
 Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple audits and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
 Executive presence and sound judgment, with a demonstrated capacity to build cross-functional relationships and influence stakeholders.
 CPA, CIA, CRCM, CISA, or other relevant professional certification.
 We would also value 
 Prior experience interacting with regulators or supporting regulatory exams.
 Willingness and ability to learn and contribute to audit coverage beyond primary areas of expertise as business needs evolve.
 Experience applying frameworks such as NIST or COBIT to risk-based audits without treating framework compliance as a substitute for control testing.

jobs.title: Manager, Machine Learning Engineering, Checkout
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 Join Affirm as a Machine Learning Engineering Manager and become a pivotal part of our International Credit Machine Learning group. Specifically, you will manage a team of ML engineers that builds the models powering credit lending decisions in countries across Europe and in Australia. You will lead your team in using novel ML techniques and rich data representations to predict repayment behavior and optimize how we offer loans to our borrowers.
 In this role, you will help shape the future of machine learning at Affirm. You'll partner with engineering, product, and risk leaders to design, implement, and scale advanced ML solutions that drive critical capabilities across the company. You will mentor engineers, bring clarity to complex, ambiguous problems, and contribute to a cohesive long-term ML strategy.
 What you'll do 
 Set the technical strategy for your team, and help your engineers tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects in our underwriting system
 Act as a force multiplier through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
 Collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by partnering with product management, design, analytics, and risk to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
 Develop talent by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.
 What We Look For 
 Bachelor's in a technical field with 8+ years of industry experience, including 3+ years managing engineers.
 A background in financial services, specifically in credit / lending.
 Proficiency in machine learning with experience in areas including tree-based models, transformers, deep learning, and agentic ML.
 Strong engineering skills and the ability to provide hands-on technical leadership while working with our code and architecture.
 You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low-level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work

jobs.title: Operations Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About Ops Enablement 
 The Operations Enablement team builds the capabilities required to deliver fast, accurate, and high-quality servicing experiences for Affirm’s customers and merchants—while identifying opportunities to eliminate the need for them to contact us in the first place. We partner across Operations, Product, Engineering, Vendor Management, Legal, and Compliance to ensure every agent is trained, equipped, and able to deliver measurable results from day one.
 Operating across the full servicing lifecycle, we translate new products, policies, and business requirements into scalable operational capabilities. Our work includes designing training and operational readiness strategies, standing up new servicing experiences, defining and measuring interaction quality, and ensuring agents can quickly access the information they need to resolve issues correctly.
 We use performance insights, customer contact drivers, quality trends, and agent feedback to identify capability gaps and their root causes. We then build the learning programs, quality frameworks, knowledge systems, processes, and tools needed to close those gaps—while helping our Product and Engineering partners address friction upstream rather than requiring agents to absorb it downstream. By owning the full journey—from operationalizing new products and policies to improving existing workflows—Operations Enablement turns complex change into consistent, compliant, and high-quality servicing at scale.
 One Role, Multiple Teams 
 We are hiring multiple Manager roles across Affirm's Ops Enablement organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across Ops Enablement.
 If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.
 Potential team placements include:
 Customer Enablement: Owning and improving specific customer servicing experiences across multiple product offerings
 Horizontal Enablement: Owning programs that touch multiple customer servicing experiences for specific product offerings
 About the Role 
 As an Operations Enablement leader you will help to deliver scalable, compliant, and high-quality servicing experiences across our Operations organization. In this role, you will define and execute strategies that enable our servicing operations to grow efficiently while maintaining exceptional customer and merchant outcomes.
 You will set the vision for operational readiness, ensuring that people, processes, and enablement systems evolve in lockstep with Affirm’s servicing strategy. As a senior member of the Operations Enablement team, you will own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives aligned to strategic priorities—driving delivery across timelines, dependencies, and measurable business outcomes. You will define and execute servicing strategies by developing clear program roadmaps and execution plans and be responsible for planning, coordination, documentation, change management and measurement across assigned initiatives to ensure operational readiness and measurable outcomes
 This role works closely with partners across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and external vendors to align priorities and ensure readiness for key business and regulatory changes. Serving as a connector between servicing strategy and day-to-day execution, you will translate strategy into scalable operational capabilities. We are looking for a hands-on, data-driven leader who thrives in complex, regulated environments and is passionate about building durable, high-quality servicing experiences at scale.
 What You’ll Do 
 Own Program Performance: Lead complex cross-functional programs and initiatives, ensuring alignment with servicing strategy, OKRs, and long-term business priorities.
 Define Program Roadmaps: Develop clear program roadmaps and execution plans, tracking progress against KPIs, timelines, budgets, dependencies, and risks.
 Partner for Impact: Collaborate closely with senior leaders and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, and Operations to align priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.
 Drive Stakeholder Engagement: Establish strong stakeholder engagement and governance practices, delivering clear, polished, and executive-ready communications on program status, outcomes, risks, and impact.
 Manage Risk & Issue Resolution: Proactively identify risks, issues, and dependencies; propose data-backed solutions; and drive resolution in partnership with stakeholders.
 Lead Operational Excellence: Apply Lean Six Sigma methodologies to identify root causes, implement scalable improvements, and continuously raise the bar for quality, efficiency, and compliance.
 Own Change End-to-End: Manage the full lifecycle of process and product changes—from design and implementation through change management, adoption, and measurement—ensuring meaningful impact for customers and the business.
 Build Technical Resources: Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate technical concepts into clear manuals and resources for both human and AI agents.
 Elevate Knowledge Management : Architect and evolve our knowledge ecosystem (SOPs, job aids, learning platforms, AI-enabled knowledge tools), ensuring resources are accurate, engaging, and accessible at scale.
 Translate Technical Concepts: Apply technical depth to plan, design, and create complex operational, instructional, and procedural content, translating technical concepts into clear resources for both human and AI agents.
 Own Learning & Training Strategy : Oversee end-to-end design and delivery of training programs (onboarding, continuous learning, new product rollouts), ensuring effectiveness through measurement and feedback loops.
 Collaborate on Experience Improvements: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to deepen understanding of the current customer and agent experience and identify opportunities for workflow and experience optimization.
 Expand Program Scope: Take on additional program and project management responsibilities as needed, developing working knowledge across adjacent domains to support evolving business needs.
 What We Look For 
 7+ years of experience in program management or product operations, preferably within large-scale or global operations.
 3+ years of experience at a fintech or financial institution, including 3+ years in a role that involves scaling operations and providing ongoing coaching and feedback to team members.
 Subject matter expert on financial regulations such as UCC, Reg E, Reg Z, Card Act, GLBA, UDAAP, GDPR, among others.  Have a deep understanding of dispute management rules, response codes, and recommended response data.
 Certification in Six Sigma, Project Management or Design Thinking
 Experience implementing and scaling knowledge management and training (Salesforce, Confluence, LMS platforms, or AI-driven knowledge tools).
 Demonstrated success leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives with strong execution, stakeholder alignment, and measurable outcomes.
 Strong skills in strategic planning, issue/risk management and cross-functional execution.
 Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to deliver polished, executive-ready updates and influence stakeholders. 
 Proficiency in process mapping and workflow analysis
 Proven experience designing business processes that drive a positive end user experience, reduce business risk and increase overall workflow efficiency. 
 Experience building workflow

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the Revenue team
 The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.
 About the Role 
 Affirm is seeking a dynamic and passionate Partner Marketing Lead to support and coordinate co-marketing initiatives with our valued merchants across North America. You will help plan and execute strategic cross-channel marketing campaigns across onsite Marketplace placements, offsite media, affiliate, and other emerging channels. These campaigns will be designed to drive revenue growth, GMV, customer acquisition, and measurable value for Affirm and our merchant partners.
 You’ll work closely with external partners and internal cross-functional teams, including Client Success, Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Brand and Creative, and Legal and Compliance, to coordinate and deliver impactful campaigns aimed at driving GMV (gross merchandise volume), brand awareness, new user acquisition, and lifetime value. You should feel comfortable working across several industries, including home, fitness, electronics, fashion, and omnichannel retail. You’re a collaborative marketer who is eager to navigate complex challenges, deliver strong execution, and build trusted relationships with marketing counterparts.
 What You’ll Do 
 Support the development and coordinate the execution of full-funnel co-marketing campaigns across categories and channels, including onsite, offsite, and affiliate. This includes supporting go-to-market plans, monthly planning, and cross-functional campaign delivery.
 Build and nurture day-to-day marketing relationships with a set of merchant partners, identifying opportunities to improve performance and support growth.
 Support the marketing strategy and campaign performance of assigned merchant partners, identifying opportunities to grow merchant investment and contribute to revenue, GMV, and performance goals.
 Execute and optimize Affirm Marketing Solutions programs across onsite Marketplace placements, offsite media, affiliate, and emerging channels.

 2+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent internship/co-op experience with strong projects

 Experience with GitHub, CI/CD, testing, and code review

 Strong written communication and documentation skills

The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.

We are reinventing credit cards entirely. We are looking for a Senior Manager Software Engineering to lead teams centered around integrations with partners, processors, and internationalization.  Your mission will be to decrease the time it takes for our teams to integrate with external partners dramatically and allow us to launch cards as soon as we launch Affirm in a new country. jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer (Credit International ML)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to be the technical leader building high-quality production-grade models powering credit lending decisions in countries across Europe and in Australia. You will use novel ML techniques and rich data representations to predict repayment behavior and optimize how we offer loans to our borrowers. In this role, you will help shape the future of how machine learning fuels Affirm’s global expansion. You'll partner with engineering, product, and risk leaders to design, implement, and scale advanced ML solutions that drive critical capabilities across the company. You will mentor engineers, bring clarity to complex, ambiguous problems, and contribute to a cohesive long-term ML strategy.
 What you’ll do 
 You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
 You will collaborate with ML Platform, product, engineering, and risk leadership to shape long-term modeling capabilities needed for scalable international expansion.
 You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
 You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards.
 You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.
 What we look for 
 8+ years of experience researching, designing, deploying, and operating large-scale, real-time machine learning systems. A relevant PhD can count for up to 2 YOE.
 Strong Python skills and experience writing production-quality code.
 Experience building and evaluating models for tabular classification problems (including gradient-boosted decision trees like LightGBM/XGBoost, and deep learning frameworks like PyTorch).
 Experience working with distributed data processing or parallel compute frameworks (e.g. Spark, Ray).

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. · You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents.
· You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships.
· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.

· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager, SEO & AI Search
jobs.description:
About the Role 
 People increasingly find financial products by asking ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode instead of scrolling search results. Chime's Organic Growth team helps members find Chime without paid media. Chime is already one of the most visible brands in AI answers in several core banking categories, and we want to widen that lead.
 We're hiring a Content Marketing Manager, SEO & AI Search to own the content and citation work that wins in AI search. You'll run Chime's blog from planning through publishing, run our AI-powered content workflows, and earn Chime coverage on the third-party sources AI models trust most. You'll partner closely with our Principal, AI Search Strategy & SEO, who sets Chime's AI search strategy, priority categories, targets, and measurement. You'll own the content that helps us hit those Visibility targets.
 This is a hands-on role with plenty of room for strategy. In the same week you might find a citation gap in a high-value category, brief a publisher partner, move a refreshed article through compliance review, and publish it in our CMS.
 In this role, you can expect to 
 Own Chime's blog and editorial content plan for SEO and AEO. You'll turn priority categories, prompt data, and member insights into a sequenced roadmap that helps Chime own its story and earn accurate, positive citations in AI answers.
 Run the editorial calendar and keep a steady publishing cadence. Structure content so AI models can find, understand, and cite it, with clear answers, clean formatting, and accurate, current product details (like rates, limits, and eligibility) in Contentful.
 Lead content across Chime.com, including product launches and seasonal moments with Product Marketing. Lift conversion on the blog and site through inline CTAs, email capture, stronger conversion paths, and regular CRO testing.
 Manage the day-to-day relationship with AirOps, our AI content optimization platform, and automate manual steps in the content lifecycle, from drafting and optimization to disclosures and CMS publishing. The goal is faster turnaround without losing quality.

jobs.location: San Francisco HQ; Seattle Office; New York City Office
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

We are hiring for a leader for the newly forming Detection and Response team at Plaid. Our mission is to protect Plaid's financial infrastructure by detecting and responding to suspicious activity across the company. We are responsible for the entire lifecycle of detection and response, including detection infrastructure, AI triage and response, investigation tooling, Red Teaming, and Fraud Operations. Security is foundational to the trust thousands of businesses and millions of consumers place in Plaid, and we work directly to reduce risks and enable our business to move faster and safer.

As the Head of Detection and Response, you will be the founding leader responsible for standing up and evaluating Plaid's detection and response team. You will lead a specialized technical team of analysts and engineers, gain deep experience partnering with the CISO and cross-functional engineering leaders, and build critical security infrastructure at scale. This is a unique leadership opportunity to manage a team that encompasses traditional security operations alongside Red Teaming and Fraud Operations, directly impacting Plaid's security posture and long-term stability.

Responsibilities:

 - Form and set up Plaid’s Detection and Response team from scratch, defining its culture and operational standards.

 - Lead the day-to-day operations for incident response and evaluate the overall effectiveness of the detection and response program.

 - Manage and mentor a technical team responsible for detection infrastructure, AI-driven triage, and investigation tooling.

 - Oversee Fraud Operations and Red Team activities to ensure a proactive and comprehensive security posture.

 - Partner with senior leadership (CISO, CTO, COO) to communicate security risks and maturity gains achieved through influence and cross-functional collaboration.

 - Define and track metrics to evaluate and demonstrate the effectiveness of the D&R program

Qualifications:

 - Must haves:
   
   - 8-14 years of overall detection and response or security engineering experience.
   
   - Strong technical background in security or detection engineering, with the ability to guide work on SIEMs, EDR, and SOC operations.
   
   - Experience managing a team of security analysts and engineers in an operational, platform, or infrastructure context.
   
   - Ability to build cross-functional relationships and drive security maturity through influence rather than authority.
   
   - High-empathy communication skills with the ability to represent technical work to Staff-level leadership.
   
   - Strong AI-first skillset applicable to security operations.

   - Experience at a fintech or high-technology organization adjacent to payments/finance.

jobs.title: AML Compliance Officer Customer Risk
jobs.description:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen is the financial technology platform of choice for leading companies. By providing end-to-end payments capabilities, data-driven insights, and financial products in a single global solution, Adyen helps businesses achieve their ambitions faster. With offices around the world, Adyen works with the likes of Facebook, Uber, H&M, eBay, and Microsoft. To maintain our momentum, we need people to join us in finding new ways of solving our unique challenges.
 AML Compliance Officer Customer Risk  
 A key part of building our business is ensuring we do it ethically, securely, and sustainably. In order to do so, Adyen needs to understand and monitor at all times what happens on our platform and whether this is in line with regulations and our risk appetite. And that in a scalable, automated, and adaptive way.
 To achieve this, we are looking for a Compliance Officer to join our AML/CFT Compliance Department based in Amsterdam, covering our global business. In this role, you will be the Second Line expert responsible for driving the evolution of Adyen’s Customer Risk and broader CDD Framework .
 Sitting in the Second Line of Defense, you will bridge regulatory requirements with technical product execution. You will work directly alongside Product Management, Engineering, and Regulatory teams to design, embed and monitor effectiveness of scalable, data-driven customer risk scoring models that minimize customer friction while ensuring rock-solid regulatory compliance.
 Are you a senior specialist who excels at translating complex CDD/KYC regulatory requirements into scalable operating frameworks? Then this is the role for you!
 What you'll do
 CDD Framework: Drive continuous maturity of Adyen's global CDD framework, translating regulatory expectations and supervisory guidelines (e.g., DNB, EU AML Regulation) into processes and procedures.
 Customer Onboarding: Align and evolve Adyen's global CDD procedures, defining baseline Financial Crime data requirements as well as standards for customer onboarding and ongoing review. Support relevant teams in translating it into clear 1st LoD operational guidelines.
 Customer Risk Scoring: Support the design and implementation of Adyen's risk-based approach toward customer risks, conducting deep-dive assessments of potential integrity risks across complex business models and platform structures.
 Product Collaboration: Partner up with our Product and Engineering teams to translate compliance procedures and risk-scoring logic into scalable, automated customer risk solutions.
 Operational Alignment: Support operational execution by designing, refining, and reviewing operational guidelines and 2nd-line oversight mechanisms for customer risk reviews.
 Audit & Regulatory Reviews: Support internal audits and regulatory examinations by explaining customer risk scoring logic and CDD framework design.
 Who you are

 - Lead compensation planning, benchmarking and pay decisions, including salary structures, geographic differentials, market positioning, merit and bonus cycles, and offer guidance.

 - Use market data, benchmarking and financial modeling to make recommendations, influence decisions and translate complex analysis for leaders, managers and employees.

 - Partner closely with Talent Acquisition, People Partners, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Equity and executive leadership on compensation, organization decisions, systems, equity budgets, compliance and strategy.

 - Experience designing benefits programs and managing plan renewals, including broker and insurance carrier negotiations; hands-on benefits administration isn’t the focus of this role.

 - Strong compensation analytics capability, including market benchmarking, salary range architecture, geographic pay differentials, compensation cycles, modeling and projections.

 - Experience making and communicating compensation decisions with senior leaders, People Partners, recruiters and employees.

 - Own the Americas Total Rewards program across the US and Canada, Brazil and Mexico, with end-to-end responsibility for compensation, benefits design and equity programs.

 - Lead compensation planning, benchmarking and pay decisions, including salary structures, geographic differentials, market positioning, merit and bonus cycles, and offer guidance.

 - Lead global and regional Total Rewards projects, including the Americas rollout of the equity framework and IPO-readiness initiatives, from scoping and design through stakeholder alignment and implementation.

 - Use market data, benchmarking and financial modeling to make recommendations, influence decisions and translate complex analysis for leaders, managers and employees.

About the team



Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.



What you'll do

As the Senior Manager, Financial Crime Investigations & Intelligence, you’ll lead proactive, complex, and high-risk anti-money laundering and financial crime investigations across Airwallex’s global financial infrastructure. You’ll act as an investigative subject-matter expert and operational lead, helping identify and mitigate risks across cross-border payments, corporate accounts, cards, FX and embedded finance. 



Responsibilities:

 - Lead end-to-end investigations into complex financial crime typologies involving cross-border payment flows, multi-currency corporate accounts, complex ownership structures, cross-product financial-crime risks, KYB/UBO considerations and high-risk corridors.

 - Oversee case intake, triage, prioritisation and assignment for special investigations, ensuring matters requiring enhanced investigative expertise are resolved thoroughly and within established SLAs.

 - Lead financial-crime-related internal fraud and insider-threat investigations where employees or insiders may be involved in fraud, collusion with external parties, misuse of access or other conduct with a financial-crime nexus. Partner with Fraud, Infosec, People/HR, Employment Legal and senior management. Provide evidence-based findings and risk-based recommendations.

 - Analyse layered international transactions across payment rails including SWIFT, local clearing rails, card schemes and alternative payment methods to trace illicit fund movements, identify beneficial owners and uncover hidden counterparty networks.

 - Provide investigative analysis, suspect and typology recommendations, quality assurance and escalation support for SAR/STR cases, enabling MLROs to make final filing decisions in accordance with local requirements.

 - Translate investigative findings into actionable feedback for Risk, Data and Engineering teams to calibrate transaction monitoring rules, improve automated detection models and address control vulnerabilities.

 - Develop and maintain financial-crime typologies, investigative intelligence and threat assessment based on internal investigations, external intelligence, and regulatory guidance; translate these insights into control improvements, targeted training and intelligence briefings.

 - Partner with Transaction Monitoring, Onboarding and EDD, Sanctions, Fraud, Legal and regional MLROs to address systemic threats and implement coordinated risk-mitigation measures.

 - Build and maintain investigative playbooks, investigative analysis, typology context and case documentation standards and quality-assurance frameworks tailored to B2B fintech, complex law-enforcement referrals, regulatory information request, partner-bank inquiries and partner due-diligence reviews..

 - Support internal audits, independent reviews and regulatory inquiries with clear documentation, case files and briefings on investigative methodologies and outcomes.

 - Provide day-to-day guidance, peer reviews and typology training to investigators and analysts across the broader Financial Crime Compliance team.



Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.



Minimum qualifications:

 - 8+ years of dedicated experience in AML/CFT investigations, financial intelligence or special investigations within cross-border payments, global fintech, merchant acquiring or international corporate and commercial banking.

 - Deep understanding of cross-border payment mechanisms, including SWIFT, local ACH and clearing schemes, and FX; business payment flows; merchant acquiring; and corporate entity structures, including complex shareholding, shell companies and beneficial ownership.

 - A proven track record of independently conducting and documenting complex, multi-layered financial crime investigations from initiation through documented findings, risk recommendations and support to the MLRO-led regulatory reporting process.

 - Solid working knowledge of global AML/CTF and sanctions regulatory frameworks, including, where applicable,FATF recommendations, FinCEN/BSA, FCA, AUSTRAC,MAS and other relevant local regulatory requirements.

 - A strong analytical mindset, with experience querying, synthesising and interpreting large datasets of transactional and customer data.

 - Exceptional written communication skills, demonstrated through investigative narratives and SAR/STR drafting, with the ability to articulate complex financial crime risks to non-compliance stakeholders, including Product and Engineering.

 - Comfort working in a high-growth and rapidly evolving fintech environment, managing competing priorities under tight deadlines.



Preferred qualifications:

 - A professional certification such as CAMS, CFE or an equivalent ICA diploma.

 - Practical experience with data querying and visualisation tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau or network/link analysis software.

 - Experience investigating financial crime risks in digital assets or crypto rails, or embedded finance/BaaS integrations.

Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The SME & Growth team helps ambitious businesses start, scale and operate internationally. We work across acquisition, activation, retention and expansion to build a consistent, insight-led commercial engine for our customers. Our team operates in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, partnering closely with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations and Product. You will have the opportunity to take ownership early, solve complex commercial problems and grow your scope as the Vietnam business scales.

What you'll do

We are looking for a hands-on Sales Manager to lead and develop our sales representative team while strengthening commercial execution across the SME customer lifecycle. You will combine people leadership, sales management, commercial operations and performance analytics to improve funnel conversion, customer outcomes and revenue performance.

You will work across the full funnel, from lead generation and qualification through conversion, onboarding, retention and expansion. This role is based in Vietnam.

Responsibilities:

 - Own inbound sales targets, setting clear goals, priorities, operating rhythms and execution plans.

 - Define team KPIs and performance standards across lead response, qualification, discovery, follow-up, conversion, revenue contribution and handover quality.

 - Run team meetings, pipeline reviews, one-to-ones, call reviews and performance reviews.

 - Build a disciplined lead-management process that improves response times, qualification quality, conversion and sales velocity.

 - Own full-funnel performance analytics: productivity, conversion, revenue, forecasting, retention, expansion and customer health.

 - Maintain high standards for CRM hygiene, pipeline visibility and activity quality, and improve forecasting accuracy.

 - Use data, customer feedback and frontline insights to diagnose gaps and recommend corrective actions.

 - Hire, onboard, train and develop the inbound sales team through regular coaching, feedback and performance reviews.

 - Coach reps on discovery, needs analysis, solution positioning, objection handling, negotiation, follow-up and closing.

 - Partner with Marketing and Sales Operations to improve lead quality, campaigns, routing, attribution, CRM processes and reporting.

 - Build a high-performing, insight-led commercial organisation with clear accountability across the customer lifecycle.

 - Act as a hands-on leader who balances people management, operational execution and strategic problem-solving.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

 - 4–5+ years of relevant experience in banking, payments, PSP, fintech, e-commerce or platform-based businesses.

 - Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, inbound sales, telesales or another high-volume, lead-driven sales environment.

 - Experience leading, coaching or mentoring sales representatives or another quota-carrying team.

 - A track record of delivering against revenue, conversion or other commercial targets.

 - Strong understanding of inbound sales funnels, lead qualification, CRM discipline, pipeline management, forecasting and performance reporting.

 - Experience using data to diagnose funnel performance and improve sales processes.

 - Experience setting targets, managing performance and establishing effective operating rhythms.

 - Excellent coaching, communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

 - Ability to balance team leadership with hands-on involvement in customer and deal conversations.

 - Strong commercial judgement, ownership, resilience and a customer-first mindset.

 - Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment.

 - Professional fluency in English and Vietnamese.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience building processes, playbooks, reporting frameworks or operating models from the ground up.

 - Experience managing a high-velocity SME or inbound sales motion.

jobs.description:
Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Engineering at Brex 
 Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems.
 What you’ll do 
 The Identity and Access Management team builds and maintains secure, user-friendly authentication and authorization systems that protect users, safeguard company assets, and provide a seamless access experience for developers. The team owns critical platform capabilities including login methods, step-up authentication, our custom authorization platform, account delegation flows like Copilot, Pro Access login, embedded partnerships authentication, and core vendor integrations.
 As a Staff Engineer on IAM, you will lead projects and initiatives to improve the security, reliability, and developer experience of our authentication, authorization, and identity platforms for customers, partners, and internal systems. You will scope and drive projects with clear impact, work cross-functionally with the broader engineering organization, help define the team’s technical quality, and help evolve the identity platform as Brex invests in signed identity propagation, delegated and agent identity, fine-grained authorization, stronger auditability, and enterprise-ready customer authentication experiences.
 Where you’ll work 
 This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require Monday, Wednesday and Thursday to be designated in office days. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!
 Responsibilities 
 Design, build, and operate backend systems and APIs for authentication, authorization, identity context, and audit-related workflows.
 Lead engineers across the organization on initiatives end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and operational support.
 Improve login and access experiences across SSO, MFA, step-up authentication, delegated access, and enterprise identity flows.
 Build and extend authorization systems that support custom roles, resource-aware access control, and secure defaults for product teams.
 Lead creation of durable, identity-aware audit trails and attribution for user, service, delegated, and agent-driven actions.
 Partner closely with engineers across Brex to make IAM integrations secure by default and easier to adopt through clear patterns, tooling, and shared libraries.
 Mentor engineers on the team to deliver high-quality code and produce operational improvements that raise the bar for reliability and maintainability across the team’s systems.
 Requirements 
 You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building reliable production backend systems.
 You have experience leading complex projects and mentoring other engineers.
 You have strong API design fundamentals, rigor around testing, code quality, and documentation.
 You understand core IAM concepts such as authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, MFA, SSO, OAuth, SAML, OIDC, or RBAC.
 You communicate clearly, collaborate well across teams, and are effective in cross-functional technical discussions.
 You care about operational excellence and know how to improve system reliability, reduce toil, and maintain high-quality services over time.
 You have strong product and engineering judgment and can balance security, usability, and developer experience.
 Bonus points 
 You have worked on identity and access management, authentication, authorization, or audit systems in a production environment.
 You have hands-on experience with Okta, Oso, SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth, or WebAuthn.
 You have experience building enterprise-facing admin controls, authorization platforms, delegated access flows, or audit trails.
 You have worked on platform teams that provide shared infrastructure, paved roads, or secure-by-default frameworks for other engineering teams.
 Compensation: 
 The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000 CAD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Lead is a banking infrastructure platform trusted by the most innovative companies to power complex financial products. We enable fintechs to offer compliant, programmable services like payments, lending, and digital assets at scale. Banking has moved beyond traditional institutions and is now embedded directly into everyday experiences, meaning companies need modern infrastructure that is safe, secure, and operationally sound.

Today, Lead is one of the only API-first, developer-focused partner banks with the financial, regulatory, and legal expertise required to help fintechs succeed. We operate offices in San Francisco, Sunnyvale, and New York City, and an FDIC-insured bank in Kansas City.



Information Security Team at Lead

The Information Security team helps Lead stay nimble enough to move fast without compromising on safety. They own cybersecurity, overseeing detection and response, and building security controls for all data networks, cloud infrastructures, and IT systems. Working closely with the Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams, they ensure Lead meets and stays up to date on all security standards. Scaling the systems that protect Lead and the fintechs we serve requires critical thinking, good judgment, and an ownership mentality. This is a collaborative team of builders who approach problems creatively, constantly iterating to improve the security of our platform.



Role Description

Lead Bank is looking for a Senior Security Analyst to join our Security Operations team. You'll be a core contributor to our detection and response capabilities — building detections, triaging alerts, responding to incidents, and proactively hunting threats across cloud infrastructure, security tooling, and data pipelines. You'll mentor junior analysts and partner with leadership to drive our security posture forward. Your expertise will be vital in navigating the complex regulatory landscape of the banking industry and defending against advanced persistent threats.



In this role you will:

 - Build, tune, and maintain detection rules and alerts in our SIEM, writing queries to identify threats and coverage gaps aligned to MITRE ATT&CK

 - Own incident response execution end-to-end — containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned — including forensic log analysis and post-incident reporting

 - Monitor and investigate security events across endpoints, cloud (AWS), identity, and network telemetry — identifying misconfigurations, anomalous activity, and suspicious behavior

 - Assist with security audits and regulatory examinations, ensuring timely and accurate security documentation and evidence is provided

 - Analyze systems, applications, and networks for security configurations in partnership with security engineers.

 - Manage log pipelines including ingestion, parsing, normalization, and enrichment to ensure high-fidelity data is available for detection and investigation

 - Triage and prioritize vulnerability findings using risk-based frameworks and track remediation SLAs with IT and Engineering

 - Collaborate with Engineering on IaC and CI/CD security reviews, and contribute to runbooks and playbooks

 - Perform all other duties as assigned



What we are looking for:

Required

 - 5+ years in information security or security operations

 - Hands-on SIEM experience with query writing, detection building, and alert tuning

 - Strong working knowledge of cloud security concepts and services (AWS preferred; GCP and Azure also considered)

 - Proficiency working with logs across endpoint, cloud, network, identity, and application sources

 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation) from a security perspective

 - Solid grasp of Windows, macOS, and Linux internals — processes, persistence mechanisms, and attacker TTPs

 - Demonstrated IR experience, including leading or contributing to investigations

 - Familiarity with data normalization, log parsing, and ETL concepts

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred

 - Experience with log routing, transformation, and enrichment

 - Hands-on experience with an enterprise EDR/XDR platform and its ecosystem tooling — SOAR, exposure management, and identity protection

 - Experience with network security tools and interpreting proxy or web traffic logs Background in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare) with familiarity with NIST CSF, GLBA, or FFIEC

 - Relevant certifications: CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCED, CEH, GDSA, or equivalent

Nice to Have

 - Detection as Code experience using version-controlled detection content

 - Exposure to identity security tooling
