jobs.title: Senior Design Manager - Business Banking & Investments
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
Art Blakey led the Jazz Messengers from behind the drums. He brought musicians including Wayne Shorter and Lee Morgan into the band, encouraged them to write new music, and helped them develop into bandleaders themselves. His contribution was both the music he made and the talent he brought forward. Blue Note Records 
 We’re looking for a Design Manager with that combination of creative leadership and personal craft. Someone with strong design judgement, deep visual craft, and the ambition to change what businesses expect from financial software.
 You’ll lead design for Mercury’s Business Banking* and Investments teams, spanning payments, accounts, and treasury. These teams help businesses move money, organize their accounts, and put idle cash to work. As the team grows, you’ll be accountable for the quality of its work, the development of its designers, and the impact of the experiences it ships.
 Our ambition goes beyond making familiar banking workflows look better. We want to question how they work, identify what customers should no longer have to think about, and create something meaningfully better. That takes a leader who can recognize a promising idea, push it further, and bring a team together to make it real.
 Visual design matters deeply in this role. So do interaction design, simplicity, and the judgment to make them work together. You should have a clear point of view about what excellent looks like and the hands-on ability to demonstrate it. You’ll hold a high standard through specific feedback, compelling direction, and a willingness to work alongside the team. People should feel inspired to do the best work of their careers, and supported in getting there.
 *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC. 
 In this role, you’ll: 
 Raise the quality bar of the team's work. Own the visual and interaction quality of the experiences your team ships, from the structure of a complex workflow to typography, composition, spacing, and motion. Make the standard concrete through thoughtful critique and clear direction. Review the implemented experience, not just the design file.
 Challenge the status quo. Partner with Product and Engineering to shape an ambitious direction for payments, accounts, and treasury. Question inherited assumptions, including our own. Help the team distinguish genuine constraints from familiar habits, explore alternatives, and turn the strongest ideas into simpler, more useful products.
 Take ownership from problem to outcome. Identify opportunities without waiting for a brief. Create clarity when the path is ambiguous, bring the right people together, make decisions, and work through obstacles. Your responsibility continues after handoff and launch: understand what changed for customers and the business, and act when the results fall short.
 Get hands-on where your craft makes a difference. Sketch a stronger direction, prototype an interaction, or work through a difficult flow with a designer. Be able to show what better looks like, not only describe it. Use your skills selectively to advance the work and develop the designer’s judgment without taking over their ownership.
 Turn ambition into excellent work that ships on time. Make deliberate decisions about scope, sequencing, and where to spend the team’s attention. Surface tradeoffs early and resolve them with your partners. Know which details are essential to the experience and where a simpler approach will help the team move faster without compromising what matters.
 Build a healthy team with high expectations. Develop designers’ taste, confidence, and ability to deliver. Give direct, useful feedback, set clear performance expectations, and address gaps with care and conviction. Explain why the work matters and bring people together around a shared vision. Celebrate the designers behind the work and make their contributions visible across Mercury Design.
 You should: 
 Have strong visual and interaction design craft. Your portfolio demonstrates thoughtful typography,  composition, hierarchy, and interaction design in shipped products.
 Know how to simplify complex product experiences. You can work through complicated workflows, information architecture, and product constraints to make experiences clear and intuitive.
 Have managed designers and raised the quality of their work . You can show how your coaching, feedback, and clear expectations helped designers grow and improved what reached customers. You know how to inspire ambition while holding people accountable.
 Have set a product vision and helped a team deliver it. You can connect an ambitious direction to practical decisions about scope and sequencing, with shipped work and clear customer or business impact.
 Stay close to the design work. You’re comfortable sketching, prototyping, and working through detailed design problems alongside designers, with the judgment to know when your direct contribution will help.
 Build strong partnerships with Product and Engineering. You’ve shaped priorities together, worked through competing constraints, and used clear storytelling to build alignment around design decisions.
 Think and work like an owner. You act on what’s best for customers and the business, not just what’s in the brief. You spot problems and opportunities before they’re assigned, make decisions with incomplete information, and adapt without drama when priorities shift. You stay close to implementation and outcomes, and you care more about making Mercury better than about whose idea it was.
 Build conviction without relying on authority. You can tell a clear story about where the product should go and why. You start disagreements with curiosity, make your reasoning specific, and change your mind when a better idea emerges. You help people pursue a demanding standard because they understand and believe in it.
 What success looks like 
 A year from now, the team’s shipped work demonstrates a visibly higher standard of visual craft, interaction quality, and simplicity. It has moved beyond incremental improvements to deliver new approaches with clear customer and business impact. Designers are ambitious, motivated, and growing in their judgment. They own their work, deliver reliably, and receive recognition across Mercury Design for what they contribute.
 Please share examples of both your own design craft and work produced under your leadership. We’d like to understand the standards you set, the assumptions you challenged, the decisions you owned, and what ultimately shipped.

jobs.title: Dealer Development Manager (Las Vegas, NV)
jobs.description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. 
 We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.  
 We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. 
 About the Role: 
 The Dealer Development Manager will represent Upgrade Inc (Auto Finance Division) and promote our indirect lending programs. They will develop, maintain, and grow business partnerships between Upgrade Inc. and our dealership partners. The Dealer Development Manager is also responsible for staying up-to-date on local market conditions and industry trends. In this role, you will work with internal partners to find solutions that better serve our customers, and build long lasting relationships with key decision makers to drive growth and continuous improvement.   This position requires residency in the greater Las Vegas area. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 Dealer Relationship Management 
 Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing dealer partners 
 Act as a trusted advisor to dealership owners, GMs, and F&I managers 
 Conduct regular in-person dealership visits based on a structured drive schedule 
 Deliver consistent follow-up and service to ensure dealer satisfaction and loyalty 
 Dealer Acquisition & Activation 
 Identify, onboard, and activate new dealer partners 
 Drive dealer sign-ups and first deals (“activation”) 
 Re-engage inactive dealers (e.g., no deals in 90 days) and return them to production 
 Execute onboarding training to ensure dealers understand programs and systems 
 Production & Volume Growth 
 Achieve monthly funding and application volume goals 
 Increase contracts per active dealer and overall territory production 
 Focus on growing volume in Tier 3–5 segments while maintaining quality 
 Drive penetration targets (e.g., 3+ and 5+ deals per dealer per month) 
 Credit & Deal Structuring 
 Partner closely with underwriting/credit teams to structure deals effectively 
 Educate dealers on program guidelines, stips, and deal packaging 
 Improve pull-through by coaching dealers on submitting clean, fundable deals 
 Portfolio Performance & Quality 
 Monitor dealer portfolio performance (delinquency, charge-offs, profitability) 
 Manage dealer mix to align with company risk appetite and profitability goals 
 Shift focus toward preferred collateral and higher-performing dealers 
 Ensure adherence to compliance, credit policies, and documentation standards 
 Training & Dealer Development 
 Conduct ongoing product and process training with dealership staff 
 Educate dealers on value-added products  
 Provide market insights and best practices to improve dealer success 
 Position the company as a relationship-driven partner vs. transactional lender 
 Territory & Activity Management 
 Maintain a disciplined weekly drive schedule maximizing in-person dealer time 
 Track and manage activity through CRM (e.g., Salesforce) 
 Analyze territory performance and adjust strategy based on data 
 Participate in team calls, sales meetings, and performance reviews 
 What We Look For: 
 2+ years of experience in indirect auto finance, auto sales, or related field 
 Strong understanding of credit tiers, loan structuring, and dealership operations 
 Proven ability to build relationships and drive sales growth 
 Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills 
 Self-motivated with strong time management and territory planning skills 
 Ability to travel locally (significant field time required) 
 What We Offer You:  
 Competitive salary, uncapped commission and stock option plan 
 Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 
 Flexible PTO 
 Competitive 401(k) 
 Opportunities for professional growth and development 
 Paid parental leave 
 Health & wellness initiatives 
 #LI-Hybrid  
 For California residents:  Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants. 
 Environmental & Working Conditions 
 Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations. 
 Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives. 
 The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need. 
 Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position. 
 Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings. 
 Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

jobs.description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit.  We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. 
 About the Role: 
 Upgrade is looking for a Merchant Risk Data Analyst to transform how we identify and mitigate merchant risk through data analysis and visualization. You'll combine merchant risk expertise with analytical skills to build predictive models, automated monitoring triggers, and actionable insights that protect our platform from fraud, compliance violations, and operational failures. You'll turn millions of transactional data points into strategic risk decisions, applying analytical rigor to catch problems early and safeguard our merchants, borrowers, and business. 
What You'll Do: 
 Analyze large volumes of transactional data to identify merchant risk patterns and trends 
 Build predictive models to forecast merchant fraud, financial distress, compliance issues, and operational red flags 
 Develop risk scoring methodologies that prioritize high-risk merchants for proactive review 
 Conduct historical trend analysis to understand how merchant risk evolves over time and across verticals 
 Identify leading indicators of merchant misconduct, project abandonment, chargebacks, and borrower harm 
 Design automated merchant risk triggers based on transactional behavior and performance metrics 
 Create early-warning systems for financial distress, fraud patterns, compliance violations, and operational deterioration 
 Optimize trigger logic to balance detection accuracy with operational efficiency 
 Collaborate with Engineering and Product to operationalize triggers into monitoring workflows 
 Monitor trigger performance and adjust thresholds based on investigation outcomes 
 Build and maintain Tableau dashboards for merchant investigations using transactional data, WIP trends, chargeback patterns, and complaint analysis 
 Create visualizations that empower the Merchant Risk team to investigate merchants quickly and effectively 
 Develop performance metrics reporting for team productivity, investigation outcomes, and risk mitigation effectiveness 
 Design executive-level reporting on merchant risk trends and portfolio health 
 Ensure dashboards are intuitive, accurate, and actionable 
 Partner with Merchant Risk Managers and analysts to understand investigation needs and data gaps 
 Provide data-driven recommendations to improve risk detection and investigation efficiency 
 Collaborate with Sales, Credit, Compliance, FinCrimes, and Product teams on risk strategy 
 Present findings and recommendations to leadership in clear, compelling formats 
 Stay current on merchant risk trends, fraud schemes, and industry best practices 
 What We Look For: 
 3+ years merchant risk experience in fraud detection, compliance monitoring, underwriting, or risk operations (fintech, payments, or lending preferred) 
 Strong SQL skills for querying large datasets and performing complex data analysis 
 Proficiency in Tableau (or similar BI tools) for building dashboards and visualizations 
 Experience with predictive modeling and statistical analysis (regression, classification, clustering) 
 Excel/Google Sheets expertise for data manipulation, pivot tables, and analysis 
 Deep merchant risk knowledge: fraud patterns, financial distress indicators, compliance red flags, operational issues, borrower harm signals 
 Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and ability to spot patterns in complex data 
 Clear communication to translate analytical findings for non-technical audiences 
Nice to Have: 
 Experience with Python or R for data analysis and modeling 
 Familiarity with machine learning techniques and model validation 
 Knowledge of merchant underwriting, credit risk, or transaction monitoring 
 Experience with WIP (Work-in-Progress) data in project-based lending 
 Background in home improvement, solar, elective medical, or other merchant verticals 
 Understanding of regulatory requirements (UDAAP, state licensing, consumer protection) 
 Prior experience building automated alerting systems or risk triggers

 Competitive salary and stock option plan 
 100% paid coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance  
 Flexible PTO 
 Competitive 401(k)  
 Opportunities for professional growth and development    
 Paid parental leave 
 Health & wellness initiatives

jobs.description:

GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best-in-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018.
 
GoodLeap is also proud to support our award-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.

jobs.title: Client Delivery - Vice President
jobs.description:
About the Role 
 iCapital is looking to hire a Client Delivery Vice President to join the Annuities Platform team. This role is responsible for leading the successful delivery of client implementations and ongoing client delivery portfolios. This individual serves as a senior client-facing leader accountable for delivery outcomes, client satisfaction, and operational discipline.
 This role will lead delivery teams across multiple concurrent engagements, partnering closely with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure priorities are clear, risks are addressed early, and commitments are met. This leader will bring strong executive presence, sound judgment, and a structured approach to solving complex delivery challenges while continuously improving the processes, practices, and operating models that support scalable client delivery. This role requires a highly organized, detail-oriented leader who can build trusted client relationships, guide decision-making, and maintain accountability across teams while balancing client value, delivery quality, commercial impact, and long-term scalability.
 Responsibilities 
 Serve as the senior delivery leader for assigned client portfolios, building trusted relationships and ensuring delivery strategies are aligned to client business objectives.
 Own end-to-end delivery outcomes across multiple concurrent client implementations, including timelines, quality, scope, risks, dependencies, and executive stakeholder alignment.
 Lead and develop teams of Project Managers, Business Analysts, and delivery resources, creating clarity, accountability, and consistent execution across engagements.
 Establish and maintain strong delivery governance, including clear decision-making forums, escalation paths, change control, scope management, and portfolio health reporting.
 Guide clients and internal teams through delivery trade-offs, ensuring requests are assessed against scope, timeline, resourcing, commercial impact, and overall client value.
 Identify delivery risks proactively, resolve complex issues, and drive practical solutions that protect client outcomes and support long-term scalability.
 Own portfolio financial performance, including P&L, margin targets, revenue performance, resource planning, and risk mitigation.
 Create executive-level visibility into portfolio health, key risks, scope decisions, dependencies, milestones, and actions required to support successful delivery.
 Partner closely with the Product team to translate client feedback, implementation learnings, recurring pain points, and enhancement needs into clear, actionable insights.
 Collaborate with the Sales, Support, Operations, and Product teams to improve handoffs, align expectations, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and strengthen the overall client experience.
 Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, playbooks, metrics, automation opportunities, and operating practices to increase consistency, efficiency, and predictability.
 Identify opportunities to expand client value while ensuring delivery commitments, scope considerations, and commercial implications are clearly understood.
 Qualifications 
 10+ years of experience in client delivery, implementation, program leadership, or professional services within SaaS, technology, financial services, or a similarly complex environment
 Proven success leading complex client implementations and delivery portfolios with accountability for scope, timelines, quality, client satisfaction, and business outcomes
 Strong executive presence with the ability to build trust with senior client stakeholders, communicate clearly, guide decision-making, and lead productive conversations around priorities and trade-offs
 Demonstrated ability to manage scope, establish governance, hold stakeholders accountable, and maintain delivery discipline while preserving strong client relationships
 Experience diagnosing complex delivery challenges, identifying root causes, and implementing practical, scalable solutions across teams and client engagements
 Experience partnering with product teams to translate client needs, implementation feedback, and recurring themes into actionable product insights and prioritization inputs
 Track record of building, improving, or enforcing delivery processes, governance models, implementation playbooks, metrics, and operating rhythms
 Experience leading and developing teams of project managers, business analysts, implementation consultants, or other delivery resources
 Strong commercial judgment, including experience managing delivery financials, margin performance, resource planning, revenue impact, and client commitments
 Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating across multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced environment
 Experience with project, portfolio, and resource management tools such as Jira, Kantata, or similar platforms
 Benefits 
 The base salary range for this role is $130,000 to $150,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).
 We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday. This role is based in the greater Des Moines area.

jobs.description:
About the Role 
 iCapital is looking to hire a Vice President to join the Corporate Reporting team within Corporate Finance. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, SEC Reporting, this individual will be a key leader across building out the firm’s SOX controls readiness program as well as focus on iCapital's technical accounting programs. This role combines hands-on experience with business process controls and IT general controls (ITGCs), public-company reporting and governance requirements, and complex U.S. GAAP technical accounting matters. This individual will partner closely with other members of the Corporate Finance, Corporate Development, Technology, Legal and Compliance, Human Resources and Benefits teams. This role also works with outsourced advisors for technical accounting and tax, external auditors, and other business leaders to build scalable, audit-ready processes and help prepare the organization to operate like a public company.
 Responsibilities 
 Lead key workstreams within the firm-wide SOX program, including risk assessment, scoping, control design, documentation, testing coordination, deficiency evaluation, remediation, and executive reporting.
 Provide subject matter expertise across both business process controls and ITGCs, including the evaluation of control dependencies, automated controls, system-generated reports, and key interfaces.
 Help design and execute the organization’s path to SOX compliance, including readiness planning, external auditor coordination, evidence standards, testing strategy, and sustainable program governance.
 Partner with process and control owners to develop and maintain process narratives, flowcharts, risk and control matrices, and other control documentation.
 Identify control gaps and process improvement opportunities, develop practical remediation plans, and drive issues through timely and sustainable resolution.
 Provide periodic reporting to senior management, including the CAO and CFO, on SOX readiness, testing results, remediation status, emerging risks, and key decisions.
 Lead and support initiatives across accounting, financial reporting, internal controls, governance, and SEC reporting capabilities.
 Prepare and review technical accounting memoranda for complex and judgmental matters, including business combinations, asset acquisitions, revenue recognition, stock-based compensation, consolidation, capital raising activity and other transactions.
 Research and assess new accounting standards and SEC developments, determine their impact, and coordinate implementation across relevant stakeholders.
 Develop and maintain accounting policies that translate U.S. GAAP and SEC requirements into clear, scalable operating practices.
 Support financial statement preparation and review, including U.S. GAAP and SEC disclosure requirements, as needed.
 Mentor team members and strengthen technical accounting, controls, project management, and executive communication capabilities across the organization.
 Qualifications 
 8+ years of progressive public accounting, internal controls, financial reporting, or technical accounting experience
 Public accounting experience is required  
 CPA license is required
 Demonstrated experience testing or evaluating internal controls at a public company, including both business process controls and ITGCs
 Experience helping a company prepare for or complete its first year of Section 404(b) auditor attestation is strongly preferred
 Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, SEC reporting requirements, PCAOB standards, and public-company internal control expectations
 Able to research complex accounting matters, develop well-supported conclusions, and prepare clear technical accounting memoranda
 Financial services, fintech, asset management, wealth management, or alternative investments experience is preferred
 Proven ability to lead cross-functional programs, influence senior stakeholders, prioritize competing demands, and drive workstreams to completion
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical matters into concise, decision-oriented recommendations
 Highly organized and detail-oriented and able to connect detailed execution to broader business objectives
 Benefits

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description:
About the Role
 The Site Reliability Engineering team at iCapital is fundamental to ensuring our platform delivers consistent, reliable service to our client base. Our services run on Kubernetes in AWS, and this role focuses on keeping them healthy in production.
 We're looking for the hands-on engineer others turn to when production is broken and the cause isn't obvious. You'll troubleshoot across the full stack (the application, its containers, Kubernetes, and the underlying cloud infrastructure) and turn what you learn into lasting improvements: stronger reliability standards, safer rollouts, sharper alerts, and automation that prevents repeat failures. You'll rely on metrics, logs, and traces every day, but the heart of this role is diagnosing and fixing what they reveal.
 Responsibilities
 Act as a senior escalation point for complex production issues in Kubernetes-based services, leading hands-on investigation across application, container, Kubernetes, and AWS layers through to root cause.
 Partner with the teams that own our cluster infrastructure to resolve platform-level issues, and feed what you learn back into reliability standards and improvements.
 Define and implement reliability and operability standards for Kubernetes-based services, including resource sizing, health checks, scaling patterns, rollout safety, and baseline monitoring, as part of service onboarding.
 Serve as Incident Commander or senior technical lead for high-severity incidents, lead postmortems, and drive systemic improvements through action items and measurable follow-through.
 Turn recurring investigations into runbooks, diagnostic tooling, and automated remediation that shorten time to resolution and eliminate toil.
 Coach engineers in systematic troubleshooting and Kubernetes best practices through reviews, game days, and knowledge sharing.
 Define, implement, and iterate service level objectives (SLOs) and service level indicators (SLIs) that reflect customer and business expectations.
 Standardize monitoring and alerting through “monitors as code” (Terraform preferred), including quality gates such as severity, ownership, and runbook links.
 Operate and tune OpenTelemetry pipelines, including sanitizing data, managing cardinality, and enriching telemetry with consistent fields.
 Maintain the infrastructure behind our monitoring stack, including Helm charts, ArgoCD ApplicationSets, Kinesis streams, Lambda functions, and Prometheus.
 Participate in on-call rotations with a focus on improving reliability, reducing alert noise, and increasing signal quality over time.
 What You'll Need (Must-Haves)
 5+ years in SRE or related roles, with evidence of technical seniority across multiple services and teams.
 3+ years of hands-on experience running and troubleshooting production workloads on Kubernetes, with a deep understanding of how Kubernetes schedules, connects, scales, and rolls out workloads.
 Proven ability to independently diagnose complex failures in distributed systems running on Kubernetes, spanning application, configuration, resource, networking, and scaling issues, including cases where the root cause wasn't obvious.
 Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, with the ability to troubleshoot below the container layer.
 Strong production experience with AWS, including how cloud networking and access controls affect workloads running in Kubernetes.
 Strong incident response skills, including leading retrospectives/postmortems and following through on systemic fixes.
 Strong IaC skills (Terraform preferred), with examples of reusable modules, monitors-as-code patterns, or similar standardization work, and the coding ability to build automation and diagnostic tooling.
 Track record of defining SLOs/SLIs and using an observability stack (such as Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Splunk, or similar) to drive decisions and find root causes quickly.
 Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence engineering teams through standards, tooling, and practical guidance.
 Nice to Have
 Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKS) or equivalent depth.
 Experience improving rollout safety and autoscaling behavior for Kubernetes workloads.
 Familiarity with common data stores (Postgres, MongoDB, DynamoDB) and how they fail in distributed systems.
 OpenTelemetry instrumentation experience at scale.
 We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday). 
 Benefits 
 iCapital offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes a total compensation program consisting of competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity for all full-time employees; healthcare with 100% employer-paid health and dental insurance; and generous paid time off (PTO).
 For additional information on iCapital Network, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us   Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc

 How you’ll make an impact

 Production-quality coding experience in Python, including data manipulation and algorithm implementation.

 PhD in a quantitative field.
 Experience with marketplace optimization, particularly where pricing or offer decisions are central.
 Experience with causal machine-learning methods or treatment-effect modeling.
 Experience with supervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering, especially with large or complex datasets.
 Experience taking work from exploratory analysis and experimentation through production-model development while maintaining analytical rigor and model reliability.
 Ability to translate broad business problems into structured research questions and communicate complex findings as actionable recommendations.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, People Operations & Total Rewards
jobs.description:
About Betterment 
 Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.  We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).
 About the role 
 As Senior Director of People Operations & Total Rewards, you’ll shape and execute a holistic compensation strategy that’s both strategic and operational. You’ll lead all aspects of People Operations & Total Rewards (e.g., compensation, equity, payroll, benefits, and related-HR systems), ensuring programs are data-driven, competitive, and aligned with our company mission. As a trusted advisor to the CPO, CFO, and executive leadership team, you will play a critical role in designing and executing total rewards strategies that attract, retain, and motivate talent, while ensuring scalability, compliance, and financial discipline. You’ll act as both architect and operator: designing scalable frameworks while staying close to the details that make them work.
 This role is based out of our NYC office. For jobs based out of our NYC HQ, we require in office attendance Monday through Thursday, weekly. Below we've reflected the base salary range we would offer for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees. 
 New York City: $200,000 - $225,000
 This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus. 
 A day in the life 
 Design, implement, and govern compensation structures, including frameworks, pay band architecture as well as supporting equity programs and incentive plans
 Lead market benchmarking, pay equity analyses, and compensation reviews to ensure competitiveness, fairness, and transparency
 Partner with the CPO and CFO on compensation strategy, annual budgeting, and long-term incentive planning
 Collaborate with the Finance team to align policies and reporting across functions, as well as forecast compensation costs in support of workforce planning 
 Manage and continuously improve benefits programs and ensure compliance with employment and benefits regulations (ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, FLSA, and others)
 Cultivate strong relationships with benefits providers, brokers, and HR technology vendors to optimize cost, service, and employee experience
 Lead the payroll function, ensuring compliant, accurate, and timely payroll cycles 
 Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Legal, and external vendors to ensure compliance with complex tax and employment laws, while continuously improving payroll systems and processes
 Own HRIS and people data infrastructure-ensuring accuracy, reporting, and actionable analytics
 Drive operational excellence across People Operations, ensuring smooth execution of payroll, onboarding/offboarding, and compliance practices
 What we’re looking for 
 10+ years of progressive experience in People Operations and Total Rewards, with at least 5 years in a leadership capacity
 Deep knowledge of payroll, benefits, and employment laws, practices and systems
 Proven ability to lead People Operations teams in high-growth environments
 Experience managing HR systems (e.g., ADP, Pave, CultureAmp, Lattice, Greenhouse) and driving data accuracy and compliance
 Strong project management and process design skills, particularly around building systems that scale with business growth (including IPO readiness)
 A collaborative, proactive, and detail-oriented approach with a passion for operational excellence and a bias to action
 Join a team built on these core values 
 We change lives 
 Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease . 
 We set audacious goals 
 We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.
 We value all perspectives 
 When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.
 We simplify financial services 
 We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.
   Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being: 
 We offer a competitive suite of benefits , including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options
 Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.
 Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year.
 Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees.
 Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments.
 What happens next 
 We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.
 In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions.
 On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of  applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process. 
 We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process!
 Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.  
 Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. 
 Come join us!  
 We’re an equal opportunity employer and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We strictly prohibit and do not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, gender (including gender nonconformity and status as a transgender or transsexual individual), sexual orientation, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current or prospective service in the uniformed services, predisposing genetic characteristic, domestic violence victim status, arrest records, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

 Occasionally unpack and store office or cleaning supplies. 
 Must have the ability to travel between designated work locations (including outreach activities) within a reasonable commuting distance as part of standard job duties. Travel will be limited to sites considered part of an ordinary commute.

 Skills & experience 
 Required

jobs.description:

 The Capacity & Efficiency Engineering team builds the software that manages, governs, and reduces Robinhood's AWS cloud spend across compute, databases, and storage, operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and FinOps. We own the full lifecycle of cloud cost, from attribution and forecasting to automation that rightsizes infrastructure at fleet scale and keeps a bursty, latency-sensitive trading platform both reliable and cost-effective. Our work carries CEO-level visibility, has already driven millions of dollars in annualized savings, and is delivered in close partnership with Infrastructure, Finance, and product engineering teams across Robinhood.
 As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will own capacity and efficiency for Robinhood's storage and database fleet, from Aurora clusters to S3 and the caches and volumes in between. You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0-to-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill.
 This role is based in our Bellevue, WA office , with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week .
 At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.
 What you’ll do 
 Build forecast-driven capacity planning for the storage and database fleet, turning traffic history, load tests, and known events (market open, earnings, IPOs, promotions) into plans that scale up ahead and back down after, with an expiry on every temporary capacity hold
 Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules
 Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right-sized as load changes
 Own S3 efficiency at scale: storage class and Intelligent-Tiering strategy, lifecycle and retention policies, noncurrent versions and incomplete uploads, and request costs, using Storage Lens and inventory data
 Take every recommendation to closed-loop automation with guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback, in partnership with the Storage infrastructure team, handling constraints such as AWS capacity shortages, fallback instance types, and connection pooling
 Measure outcomes in cost and reliability (savings against baseline, forecast error, utilization, capacity left behind after events) and share our forecasts with the pod rightsizing system so compute and storage scale together
 What you bring 
 Deep hands-on experience operating AWS storage and databases at scale, especially Aurora or RDS (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and S3, including replication, read scaling, storage classes, and lifecycle management
 Capacity planning and forecasting experience: modeling time-series demand, load testing, and translating traffic into instance counts, sizes, and storage growth
 A track record of rightsizing infrastructure from utilization data (CPU, memory, IOPS, throughput, bytes stored) without hurting latency or availability
 Strong Python or Go engineering, with experience building automation that safely modifies production infrastructure (guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback built in), not just systems that observe and report
 Familiarity with AWS storage and database pricing (S3 storage classes and requests, Aurora I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Reserved Instances) is a strong plus
 Experience with bursty, event-driven workloads (trading, payments, ticketing) or with Spark, Airflow, or Kubernetes is a plus

Data Product Analyst
 Location: Charlotte, NC (Hybrid)
 The Opportunity
 We’re looking for a Data Product Analyst to help transform business needs into trusted, usable data products that power reporting, analytics, and better business decisions. In this role, you’ll help bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring data products are thoughtfully designed, well-documented, and built to solve real business problems.
 You’ll have the opportunity to contribute throughout the data product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements gathering to testing, documentation, and ongoing improvement. If you’re curious about data, enjoy solving problems, and like bringing people together to turn ideas into action, this is an opportunity to build your expertise while making a meaningful impact.
 How You’ll Make an Impact
 Translate Business Needs into Actionable Requirements: Partner with business stakeholders to understand their goals, reporting needs, workflows, and data challenges. Document requirements and translate discovery findings into clear user stories, development tickets, and acceptance criteria.
 Support Data Product Design and Development: Collaborate with Data Product leads, reporting teams, and data engineers to define data needs, business rules, definitions, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
 Build Trusted Product Documentation: Write and maintain product requirements documents (PRDs), data contracts, business definitions, and usage guidance. Partner with Data Governance and engineering teams to document data structures, quality expectations, ownership, and refresh requirements.
 Validate Data Products and Deliver Quality: Use basic SQL and reporting tools to explore data, investigate discrepancies, and validate results. Prepare and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), coordinate business participation, document defects, and confirm fixes meet acceptance criteria.
 Strengthen Stakeholder Alignment: Communicate requirements, proposed designs, testing results, and product demonstrations to technical and business audiences. Keep partners informed of open questions, issues, and progress.
 Identify Opportunities for Improvement: Monitor product usage, performance, and user feedback to identify issues and opportunities to make data products more accurate, accessible, and useful.
 Who You’ll Work With
 You’ll work closely with Reporting, Data Governance, and Data Product leads, business stakeholders, analysts, and data engineers to bring data products from discovery through delivery. This is a collaborative, cross-functional role where you’ll help connect business priorities with technical execution, build shared understanding, and ensure the products we deliver are trusted and useful. You’ll also have the opportunity to learn from experienced partners as you deepen your understanding of our data ecosystem and product practices.
 What You’ll Bring
 A college degree.
 At least two years of experience working alongside data or analytics teams in a business, analytical, technical, or product support capacity.
 Basic SQL skills, including the ability to query, filter, join, and summarize data.
 Experience working with databases or reporting and business intelligence tools.
 Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into clear, organized documentation.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data concepts to business audiences and communicate business needs to technical teams.
 A collaborative approach to working with stakeholders, analysts, and data engineers.
 Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to organize work and follow through on open items.
 What Will Help You Thrive
 Hands-on experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data engineering.
 Experience writing user stories, development tickets, acceptance criteria, or product requirements documents.
 Experience supporting user acceptance testing or validating reports, datasets, or data pipelines.
 Familiarity with data governance concepts, including data quality, business definitions, ownership, lineage, and data contracts.
 Experience using tools for project tracking, documentation, or data cataloging.
 Curiosity about how data products are designed, developed, governed, and used to solve business problems.
 Comfort using AI tools to support discovery, requirements gathering, data product design, prototyping, and documentation, while validating outputs for accuracy and ensuring responsible data use.
 Experience designing or building AI agent workflows and automations to streamline tasks, connect tools or data sources, and support business processes.
 A proactive mindset, strong relationship-building skills, and the ability to navigate open questions and evolving requirements.
 What Success Looks Like
 Business needs are clearly captured and translated into actionable requirements, user stories, and development tickets.
 Data products are well-documented, with clear definitions, ownership, usage guidance, and quality expectations that help business users understand and trust the data.
 Testing identifies issues early, discrepancies are resolved collaboratively, and delivered products meet agreed-upon acceptance criteria.
 Business and technical partners stay aligned through clear communication, thoughtful collaboration, and timely follow-through.
 Product usage and stakeholder feedback inform improvements that make data products more valuable, accessible, and effective.

 Help make it easier for consumers to move through LendingTree’s online experience. As an Optimization Analyst, you’ll bring insurance industry experience to drive optimization ideas, manage the testing roadmap, and improve landing pages and web form flows. Working with creative, technical, and analytics partners, you’ll launch experiments and turn findings into recommendations that support revenue growth.

 Proactively identify optimization opportunities through stakeholder collaboration, competitive analysis, and insights from the analytics team, then translate those ideas into actionable testing hypotheses.
 Manage the optimization testing roadmap, including priorities, timelines, and stakeholder alignment.
 Partner with the analytics team to estimate the revenue potential of proposed tests and prioritize opportunities based on business goals and expected impact.
 Execute A/B tests across landing pages and web form flows, partnering with creative teams on designs and technical teams on setup, quality assurance, tracking, and launch.
 Partner with the analytics team to monitor test and funnel performance, interpret results, and investigate unusual trends or tracking issues.
 Apply testing best practices and collaborate with analytics partners to recommend when tests should conclude or continue based on established testing guidelines.
 Prepare timely test recaps with input from the analytics team that explain findings, business impact, and recommended next steps to technical and nontechnical partners.
 Who You’ll Work With 
 You’ll work closely with creative and front-end development teams to translate testing ideas into live experiments. You’ll collaborate with product and business stakeholders to generate ideas, align priorities, and manage the testing roadmap. You’ll also partner with the analytics team to understand funnel performance, interpret test results, and inform optimization decisions.
 What You’ll Bring 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
 Insurance industry experience.
 1–2 years of experience in website optimization, digital experimentation, or a related role, including hands-on exposure to A/B testing.
 An understanding of conversion funnels and how testing can improve the online customer experience.
 The ability to manage a testing roadmap, coordinate timelines, and align stakeholders around priorities.
 The ability to collaborate with creative, front-end development, and analytics teams to launch experiments and translate findings into next steps.
 What Will Help You Thrive 
 B2B insurance experience is preferred.
 Curiosity about user behavior and a proactive approach to generating optimization ideas through stakeholder conversations and competitive analysis.
 Strong attention to detail in test setup, quality assurance, and reporting, along with the ability to organize work and manage competing priorities.
 Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working with multiple partners and explaining test findings to nontechnical audiences.
 Analytical skills, including familiarity with website performance metrics and basic statistical concepts used to evaluate experiments, are preferred.
 Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI is a plus.
 Familiarity with data platforms or analytical tools such as Databricks, Jupyter, or Snowflake, along with basic SQL skills, is a plus.
 A basic understanding of HTML and JavaScript is a plus.
 What Success Looks Like 
 The testing roadmap reflects business priorities, with clear timelines and aligned stakeholders.
 Stakeholder collaboration and competitive analysis consistently generate optimization ideas and documented testing hypotheses.
 Tests launch accurately and on schedule, with reliable tracking.
 Performance changes and data issues are identified and investigated promptly in partnership with the analytics and technical teams.
 Test recaps clearly explain what happened, what the results mean, and what to try next.
 Insights developed with the analytics team inform roadmap decisions and help improve user experience and conversion.
 Life at LendingTree 
 We’re a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that’s curious, creative, and always ready to roll up our sleeves and get things done. You’ll work alongside smart, driven people who care about doing great work — and about helping each other succeed.
 We believe the best ideas come from different perspectives, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where people feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to make an impact. You’ll have the trust and flexibility to do your best work, the opportunity to take ownership and try new things, and teammates who genuinely enjoy working together.
 And while we work hard, we don’t take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate wins, recognize great work (our GSD — Get Stuff Done — Award is a fan favorite), and make time to have some fun along the way.

jobs.description:
Role Summary:

We're looking for a paid media lead with a history of success in SEM, youtube, and display, to drive customer acquisition across multiple financial services verticals. Experience driving marketing results with Claude or Chat GPT is highly desirable.

This is both a hands-on and strategic role: you'll build the roadmap, launch and optimize campaigns , and partner with analytics, business, creative, and engineering  to continuously drive value for our customers and business.  Success here requires strong data/creative/ monetization skills, a high degree of initiative, and a vision for paid marketing tactics and experiences in the age of AI.


This role reports to the Managing Director.



Where you can make an impact:

Strategy & Campaign Ownership

 - Own paid marketing strategy, execution, and performance across multiple verticals, aligning campaigns to each vertical's growth targets, funnel dynamics, and audience needs

 - Build campaign structures across SEM, youtube, display, Open AI, and other platforms as needed

 - Set objectives, bidding strategy, audience approach, budget allocation, and conversion events per campaign

 - Manage campaigns end-to-end: setup, QA, pacing, troubleshooting, optimization

 - Build testing plans for new verticals, bidding strategies, conversion events, creative angles, and funnel experiences
   
   

AI Utilization

 - Use AI tools to enhance and accelerate traditional marketing functions

 - Use AI as your own personal agency - building high quality creative, data insights, and landing pages, etc to overcome blockers and limited resources

 - Combine your own deep understanding of paid marketing with AI tools for novel and innovative purposes.



Optimization & Performance

 - Monitor marketing performance and diagnose CTR, CVR, and Revenue and monetization issues, data/tracking issues, funnel friction, monetization problems, and/or lead quality.

 - Make budget and pacing calls based on performance trends and business priorities

 - Stay current on platform, algorithm, privacy, and ad product changes



Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

 - Own recurring performance reporting — results, trends, learnings, risks, next steps

 - Translate platform performance into business impact for vertical leads and leadership

 - Communicate tracking issues, data discrepancies, and testing results clearly and proactively



Data, Tracking & Measurement

 - Partner with data, analytics, and engineering teams to define measurement needs and map new conversion events

 - Troubleshoot discrepancies between platform and backend data (attribution, event firing, duplicates, timing)

 - Help build measurement frameworks that optimize toward lead quality and business outcomes, not just volume



Creative Strategy

 - Lead creative strategy across verticals: messaging angles, hooks, scripts, static/video/UGC concepts

 - Write creative briefs covering business goal, audience, value prop, and key claims

 - Review assets for clarity and platform fit; give feedback through concept, script, and production stages

 - Build creative testing roadmaps and turn results into next-round recommendations



Landing Page & Funnel Strategy

 - Evaluate landing pages and funnels for message match, conversion flow, and drop-off

 - Recommend and support tests across landing pages, advertorials, lead forms, quizzes, and pre-qualification flows

 - Ensure creative, landing pages, and tracking are aligned before launch



Platform Partnerships & Competitive Research

 - Manage relationships with platform reps; evaluate their recommendations against NerdWallet's goals and data quality

 - Track competitor creative, offers, and funnel approaches; feed insights back into strategy
   
   

Your experience:

 - 5+ years of paid search experience, ideally in lead generation.

 - Proven track record of utilizing AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate marketing functions, gain data insights, and optimize creative processes.

 - Forward-thinking vision regarding how and where to market in the age of AI and video, demonstrating the ability to craft tactics for finding consumers as search behaviors shift beyond standard search engines.

 - Demonstrated experience in video marketing, with a track record of driving performance through short-form video content, emerging ad formats, and platforms like YouTube to capture audiences outside of traditional Google Ads.

 - Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Proven track record scaling paid search (7 figures in monthly spend preferred) while maintaining or improving CPA/CAC and ROAS.

 - Experience managing toward lead gen, revenue, ROAS, CPA/CAC, or funnel-based goals.

 - Ability to build paid media strategy from the ground up — structure, testing, measurement, creative, optimization.

 - Strong analytical skills, comfortable with both platform and backend business data.

 - Experience troubleshooting tracking, attribution, or reporting discrepancies.

 - Experience writing creative briefs and giving feedback to creative teams or external partners.

 - Strong project management skills across multiple concurrent verticals and workstreams.

 - Clear, confident communicator who can translate data into recommendations for non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience and success outside of Google or Bing

 - Experience in financial services (insurance, lending, wealth, banking, investing, mortgage, home equity, or other regulated categories)

 - Experience with lead gen funnels, prequalification/quiz flows, marketplace models, or affiliate/partner revenue models

 - Experience optimizing toward backend events — funded loans, booked appointments, matched leads

 - Experience with server-side tracking and conversion signal quality

 - Experience with UGC creative, creator partnerships, or video production workflows

 - Comfort working with legal, compliance, or brand review processes in regulated industries

What Success Looks Like:

 - Campaigns launch with clean setup, strong creative, accurate tracking, and aligned stakeholders

 - New revenue streams outside of traditional SEM are discovered and scaled

 - Creative & LP testing is structured, insight-driven, and tied to business outcomes

 - Tracking issues are caught early and resolved in partnership with data teams

 - Stakeholders have a clear read on performance, risk, and next steps at all times

 - New verticals have a clear, de-risked path to testing and scaling paid social

jobs.title: Sales Trainer (Scottsdale, AZ)
jobs.description:
At NerdWallet, we're on a mission to provide clarity for all of life's financial decisions. Every small business has a unique story, and we're passionate about helping entrepreneurs access the financing they need to start, grow, and succeed. As part of our Small Business Sales team, you'll play a critical role in developing the sales professionals who make that mission possible.

We're looking for a Sales Trainer who is passionate about developing people, elevating sales performance, and building a culture of continuous learning. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role where you'll partner closely with Sales Leadership to onboard new Account Executives, coach existing team members, and reinforce the sales behaviors that drive exceptional customer outcomes.

You'll spend time where it matters most—embedded with the sales team—observing live customer conversations, facilitating coaching sessions, analyzing performance trends, and helping representatives sharpen their consultative selling skills. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy helping others succeed, and love translating coaching into measurable business impact, we'd love to meet you.



WHERE YOU CAN MAKE AN IMPACT:

As a Sales Trainer, you'll serve as a trusted partner to Sales Leadership while helping representatives build the confidence, skills, and product knowledge needed to succeed.

This role is approximately 70% new hire onboarding facilitation and 30% ongoing sales coaching. You'll:

 - Lead an engaging onboarding program that prepares new Account Executives to confidently navigate customer conversations, master our sales process, and achieve ramp expectations.

 - Deliver ongoing coaching through live call observation, call reviews, role plays, deal strategy sessions, objection-handling exercises, and pitch refinement.

 - Maintain a consistent presence on the sales floor, identifying coaching opportunities and providing timely, actionable feedback that improves performance.

 - Reinforce NerdWallet Small Business's Challenger-based and consultative sales methodology throughout every stage of the customer journey.

 - Coach representatives on discovery, objection handling, urgency creation, lender positioning, financing education, ROI articulation, follow-up strategy, and closing execution.

 - Become a subject matter expert on small business financing, alternative lending solutions, borrower profiles, lender programs, and deal positioning.

 - Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Business Development, Product, and Operations to ensure onboarding and coaching remain aligned with business priorities, market trends, and product updates.

 - Analyze call recordings, coaching observations, and performance metrics to identify recurring skill gaps and develop targeted coaching plans.

 - Create and continuously improve practical enablement materials including playbooks, talk tracks, call examples, role-play scenarios, and job aids.

 - Support frontline sales managers by reinforcing coaching best practices and driving consistency across teams.


WHERE YOU CAN GROW:

At NerdWallet, learning doesn't stop after onboarding. As a Sales Trainer, you'll have the opportunity to influence the development of an entire sales organization while partnering closely with leadership to shape coaching strategy, improve onboarding programs, and continuously raise the bar for sales excellence. You'll build strong cross-functional relationships, expand your expertise in sales enablement, and directly contribute to the growth of both our people and our business.




YOUR EXPERIENCE:

 - 1+ years of experience in sales training, sales enablement, sales coaching, or frontline sales leadership within a fast-paced, quota-driven organization.

 - A proven track record of onboarding new sales representatives and improving speed to productivity.

 - Experience coaching sales professionals through live observation, call reviews, role plays, and direct feedback.

 - A strong understanding of Challenger, consultative, and transactional sales methodologies.

 - Excellent communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.

 - The ability to deliver direct, actionable coaching while building trust and credibility across the sales organization.

 - Experience using sales and enablement technologies such as Gong, Salesforce, LMS platforms, or similar tools.

 - A data-driven mindset with the ability to connect coaching activities to measurable improvements in sales behaviors and business outcomes.

 - Willingness to travel approximately twice per quarter to support in-person onboarding, training, and coaching.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience selling or coaching within small business financial services, alternative lending, merchant cash advance (MCA), fintech, or another high-volume transactional sales environment.

 - Formal certification or experience with recognized sales methodologies such as Challenger, SPIN Selling, Sandler, or MEDDICC.


HOW YOU'LL KNOW YOU'RE SUCCESSFUL

Success in this role will be measured by the impact you have on the development and performance of our sales organization. You'll help new hires ramp more quickly, improve the quality of customer conversations, strengthen sales execution, increase conversion rates and funded revenue, reduce recurring performance gaps, and build a culture where coaching is an everyday part of winning.




WHERE:

 - This role is Full-time in office and will be based in Scottsdale, AZ.

We have found that working in-person, alongside peers and more senior members of the team, confers great advantages owing to the spontaneous learning and collaboration opportunities that arise daily on a sales floor and that cannot be easily replicated in a remote environment.

We also understand the importance of flexibility to work remotely, both for personal and professional reasons. While this is an in-office role, as long as you are meeting our minimum performance standards, you’ll have the option to work remotely 20% of the month from anywhere in the continental US starting after you complete training, typically between months 4-6.




WHAT WE OFFER:

Pay Transparency: $85,000 - $117,000 base + equity

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

 - Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents

 - Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown

 - New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care

 - Mental health support

 - Paid sabbatical after 5 years for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge, and pursue their interests

 - Health and Dependent Care FSA and HSA Plan with monthly NerdWallet contribution

 - Monthly Wellness Stipend, Cell Phone Stipend, and Wifi Stipend (Only remote Nerds are eligible for the Wifi Stipend)

 - Work from home equipment stipend and co-working space subsidy (Only remote Nerds are eligible for these stipends)

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

 - Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

 - Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

 - Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction 

 - Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

 - 401K with 4% company match

 - Be the first to test and benefit from our new financial products and tools

 - Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

 - Disability and Life Insurance with employer-paid premiums

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information
