jobs.title: Revenue Operations Partner II
jobs.description:
Territory Planning Analyst II  
 About the Role  
 The Territory Planning Analyst II owns the design, execution, and ongoing integrity of AvidXchange’s GTM territory structures. You’re the person who ensures every account has a clear owner, every rep has a well-defined book of business, and every territory reflects the current state of the market — across direct sales, channel, and strategic partnerships. You sit within the GTM Planning function under Revenue Operations, working alongside the Sales Compensation Analyst and Senior GTM Strategy Analyst. The territory potential data and coverage analysis you produce are direct inputs to quota planning, and the account data
 you monitor is the foundation everything else is built on. When the data is clean, the whole GTM motion runs better. 
 What You’ll Do  
 Territory Design & Optimization  
 Own the annual territory planning and carving process, building balanced territories that optimize for coverage, revenue potential, and equitable distribution across segments. 
 Maintain territory rules engines defining assignment logic — named accounts, geography, verticals, partner affiliations, revenue tiers — and ensure consistent application. 
 Manage execution of territory realignment and account reassignments. 
 Build scenario models that let leadership evaluate the impact of proposed territory changes on coverage, quota distribution, pipeline disruption, and customer experience. 
 Conduct post-realignment analyses to measure whether changes delivered expected improvements and surface recommendations for future planning cycles. 
 Define requirements for territory and account scoring models built by the Revenue Insights team, providing business-side QA on model outputs and feedback on scoring methodology. 
 Partner & Channel Territory Management  
 Manage territory and account assignment complexity across 20+ ERP partner relationships and banking partnerships, maintaining clear rules of engagement and attribution boundaries. 
 Maintain partner-specific territory maps and account overlays defining sourced, influenced, and co-sold accounts versus direct motions. 
 Build and maintain attribution data models linking partner-sourced opportunities to the correct territory, rep, and compensation plan. 
 Produce partner territory coverage reports identifying white space, overlap, and conflict, and coordinate with Channel and Strategic Partnerships teams to keep definitions aligned with current agreements. 
 Account Data Monitoring & Integrity  
 Own ongoing monitoring of account and territory data health in Salesforce — identifying and resolving misalignments before they affect territory accuracy, quota inputs, or GTM reporting. 
 Monitor duplicate records and enforce deduplication standards; partner with Systems & Process to build automated rules, you own the ongoing review and resolution. 
 Review and resolve territory misalignments surfaced by logic errors. 
 Monitor account-to-territory alignment and manage the account handoff process from new business to existing sales, ensuring clean transitions and accurate ownership records. 
 Manage account and contact status progression to ensure lifecycle stages reflect current reality across the CRM. 
 Own firmographic data integrity, enforcing standards and resolving tagging errors that affect segmentation and territory logic. 
 Run regular enrichment cadences, validating enrichment accuracy and coordinating with third-party providers on data quality. 
 Systems Requirements & Execution  
 Define requirements for Salesforce territory configuration — hierarchies, assignment rules, sharing rules, visibility — and submit to the Systems & Process team for implementation. Validate post-deployment. 
 Define specifications for bulk account reassignments and segmentation updates with clear change management documentation, acceptance criteria, and rollback procedures. 
 Maintain a territory change log and audit trail documenting all structural changes, rationale, effective dates, and downstream impacts. 
 What We’re Looking For  
 Required  
 3–5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or CRM/Data Management in a B2B SaaS, payments, or fintech environment. 
 Strong working knowledge of Salesforce territory management, assignment rules, data management, and reporting. Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications for a Systems team. 
 Experience with data enrichment tools (ZoomInfo, Dun & Bradstreet, Clay) and a track record of maintaining data quality standards at scale. 
 Strong SQL or equivalent data querying skills for analysis, auditing, and quality monitoring. 
 Experience managing territory structures in organizations with channel or partner complexity. 
 Highly organized with strong attention to detail — territory and data errors have downstream consequences across quota, compensation, and reporting. 
 Preferred  
 Experience with territory planning tools such as Anaplan, Fullcast, Varicent Territory, or similar. 
 Salesforce Admin certification or equivalent hands-on configuration experience. 
 Background in payments, ERP ecosystems, or B2B platforms serving the middle market. 
 Experience managing territory structures through an acquisition integration or business model consolidation. 
 What Sets You Apart  
 You treat data integrity as a competitive advantage, not a cleanup task — you’re monitoring and resolving issues before they surface in a report or a dispute. 
 You can hold the big picture (territory strategy) and the fine detail (field-level data accuracy) at the same time without losing quality in either. 
 You work well at the seam between business logic and system configuration — you know what you need, you can spec it clearly, and you know how to QA the output. 
 You’re the person who catches problems early and documents the fix so they don’t happen twice. 
 About AvidXchange
 AvidXchange is a leading provider of accounts payable (“AP”) automation software and payment solutions for middle-market businesses and their suppliers. By trade, we are a technology company, but if you ask anyone who works here, they’ll tell you our people are at the core of who we are. At AvidXchange,  mindset is everything . We are Connected as People , Growth Minded , and Customer Obsessed . These three mindsets represent our culture – who we are, who we’ve always been, and they guide us to improve every day. Since our founding in 2000 in Charlotte, NC, we’ve created a company of over 1,300 teammates working across the U.S., or remotely. AvidXchange is proud to be Certified™ as a  Great Place to Work ®. The prestigious recognition is based on anonymous data from our teammates and makes official what our teammates have known for years – that AvidXchange is a Great Place to Work®. 
 Who you are:  
 A go-getter with an entrepreneurial mindset – that means you are not afraid of taking risks, winning big or facing the unknown. 
 Someone who understands that business is people centric. Connecting with others as humans first allows you to develop mutually beneficial working relationships. 
 Focused on making a difference for our customers. AvidXchange exists to help solve complex problems for our customers so we can all realize our potential. 
 What you’ll get:  
 AvidXchange teammates (we call them AvidXers) get the perks and prestige of a growing tech company paired with the flexibility of a founder-led startup. We help our AvidXers develop as professionals and as human beings, providing work/life balance, development programs, and competitive benefits. At AvidXchange, we are building more than a tech company – we are building an experience. We remain committed to a culture where you can fully be 'you’ – connected with others, chasing big goals, and making a meaningful impact. If you want to help us grow while realizing your potential and creating stories you’ll tell for years, you’ve come to the right place.
 AvidXers enjoy:   
 18 days PTO* 
 11 Holid

The Technical Implementation Consultant is a subject matter expert responsible for implementing the technical configurations for Connectors, APIs, Web Services, and other technical functionalities within customer implementation projects. This role focuses on the hands-on execution of complex system integrations, ensuring seamless data flow between BlackLine and customer environments, and troubleshooting sophisticated technical challenges to guarantee project success.

 Contribute to the enhancement of integration methodologies and provide feedback to the Product team on API and Connector functionality.

 Stay updated with the latest BlackLine products and industry trends.

 4-6 years of experience in a hands-on technical implementation or integration role 
 Strong understanding of system integration with major ERPs (eg SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics) 
 Advanced understanding of technical implementation principles.  
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.  
 Proven ability to lead and manage complex technical implementation projects.  
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.  
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  
 Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.  
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).  
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field. (Accounting for Intercompany Senior Implementation Consultant).   
 Customer-focused mindset.

 Experience with project management tools and methodologies. 
 Thrive at BlackLine Because You Are Joining: 
 A technology-based company with a sense of adventure and a vision for the future. Every door at BlackLine is open. Just bring your brains, your problem-solving skills, and be part of a winning team at the world's most trusted name in Finance Automation!

 A culture where BlackLiner's continued growth and learning is empowered. BlackLine offers a wide variety of professional development seminars and inclusive affinity groups to celebrate and support our diversity.
 BlackLine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, race, ethnicity, age, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, ancestry, color, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault or stalking, medical condition, genetic information, or any other protected class or category recognized by applicable equal employment opportunity or other similar laws.

Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work.

 The Problems You’ll Solve 
 At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As the Business Development Manager for Carta Law, you will manage our relationships with law firms, investment banks, compliance consultants and other business partnerships globally.
 You will expand Carta’s distribution and market share by helping us deepen working relationships with key channel partners—and developing relationships with new ones. You'll be responsible for identifying, structuring and growing partnerships that drive distribution of Carta Law's services - turning law firms, investment banks and compliance consultancy firms from potential competitors into active referral partners and collaborators. 
 The Team You’ll Work With 
 You'll be joining the Carta Law Sales team in London or Americas offices. Our team manages the full client lifecycle - from welcoming new clients through onboarding, to building deep, lasting relationships with established fund managers and their legal teams.
 We sit at the intersection of legal delivery, commercial strategy, and operations. Day-to-day we partner closely with our legal delivery team, sales, marketing, and operations to ensure clients get maximum value from Carta Law and that we're well-positioned to grow with them over time. We're building the gold standard for client success in the AI-powered legal services space, and you'll have a meaningful hand in shaping what that looks like.
 About You 
 If you have a background in law or legal services, understand how private markets firms and their advisors operate and are energised by the commercial side of the industry, this role is for you.
 Experience in or building partnership channels via law firms, asset management firms or professional services firms preferred. (Ideally from scratch)

 Experience managing senior relationships and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
 Commercially sharp, with the ability to structure and close partnership deals

jobs.title: Senior Implementations Accountant II
jobs.description:
The Company You’ll Join
 Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work.
 For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .
 The Problems You'll Solve 
 At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. 
 As a Senior Implementations Accountant, you are the first contact point for our new Fund Administration customers into Carta services and you will focus efforts on supporting them in their journey. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. 
 In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFOs, Fund Managers) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, provide demonstration of our software and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and their internal stakeholders. 
 From close of sales, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Accountant will exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, curiosity and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience. 
 The Team You'll Work With 
 Carta is looking for our Senior Implementation Accountant to join our fund administration team. Carta expanded to the Asia Pacific region in 2021 and we are building a world-class team to support the private fund ecosystems. 
 The private funds industry has been growing rapidly and we would like to add highly motivated, innovative individuals who are willing to “roll up their sleeves” to join the fund administration team. Our three main pillars of competency in Fund Administration at Carta are technical excellence, client management and innovation. We thrive by putting our customers first, being willing to learn and grow,  are problem solvers, working with urgency to deliver the best experience to our clients, ensure data security is a priority, project management effectively, maintain a professional community and work as one team. 
 Learn more about how we think about fund administration here - https://carta.com/blog/building-fund-admin/ 
 The Impact You’ll Have 
 Our goal is to position Carta as the leading Fund Administration group globally, and as a Senior Implementation Accountant, you will play a central role in achieving it. You will join a highly dynamic, fast-growing team where your contribution is visible from the outset. Every fund you onboard will become a Carta success story, and every process you improve will help shape the future of fund administration.
 You will collaborate with new fund administration customers to deliver a best-in-class onboarding experience. This includes advising them on accounting best practices, managing and completing projects within agreed timelines, and transforming unstructured client data into accurate reports for customers and their investors.
 You will not simply use our platform; you will help shape it. You will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams, contributing your accounting expertise and customer insight to inform what we build next. You will also help pioneer the application of AI in fund administration, supporting the development and adoption of tools that make onboarding faster, more efficient and more accurate. If you are interested in the intersection of technology and finance, this role offers a genuine opportunity to influence the direction of our product.
 About You 
 Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience.
 4+ years of experience in fund administration, with a focus in Private Equity.
 You have strong critical thinking, problem solving, curiosity and decision making skills.
 You are interested in project management and providing best-in-class-service.
 You take pride in your ability to communicate effectively and are able to multitask to meet multiple deadlines. 
 You have a strong foundation in Private Equity Fund Administration and a good understanding of common fund structures.
 You have experience interpreting and understanding fund documents like Limited Partnership Agreements, Private Placement Memorandum etc.
 You are curious about AI and eager to explore how emerging technology can improve accuracy, efficiency and the client experience in fund administration.
 You are interested in working on projects in a fast paced environment with a supportive team and as an individual.
 Experience with Australian fund structures, including VCLPs and ESVCLPs, will be an advantage.
 Having SaaS experience will be an advantage
 At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating  infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally  to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

jobs.title: Copy of Senior Email Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Email is one of the most direct ways we connect with prospects and customers—and this is your opportunity to lead it. On the Digital Demand Gen team, you’ll have the ownership to set the strategy, the creative freedom to try new approaches, and the hands-on role to bring them to life. If you want to see your ideas translate into stronger engagement, pipeline, and revenue, this role puts that impact within reach.
 Based in San Francisco, this senior individual-contributor role spans prospect nurture, pipeline generation, customer adoption, cross-sell, and upsell. 
 What you’ll do
 Lead a multi-quarter roadmap for nurture, campaigns, newsletters, and follow-up journeys. Partner with Demand Gen and Sales to connect growth goals to audiences, messages, offers, and next steps.
 Partner with Marketing Operations on the email calendar; own what goes out and when. Prioritize competing requests so each contact gets relevant, valuable content at the right time without being overwhelmed.
  Align campaign owners on priorities and timing, communicate tradeoffs, and push back constructively on requests that dilute the audience experience.
 Set the creative bar for concepts, copy, and design. Use briefs and performance insights to guide reviews and coach Creative and Campaign partners toward useful, distinctive, on-brand emails.
 Build, QA, and optimize modular emails in Knak, including personalization and reusable components. Create templates, workflows, and QA standards for consistent execution. Marketing Operations owns technical setup and sending; review their work and flag targeting, automation, tracking, or delivery issues.
 Grow and protect the reachable prospect database. Partner with Marketing Operations on acquisition, segmentation, automation, deployment, deliverability, consent, and suppression.
 Lead testing across audiences, offers, messages, formats, cadence, and timing, prioritizing experiments by business impact and learning value.
 Measure conversion, pipeline, opportunities, and revenue alongside engagement, audience health, and deliverability. Turn results into clear recommendations for leadership on strategy, creative, targeting, and investment.
 Partner with Lifecycle and Customer Marketing to develop and optimize adoption, cross-sell, and upsell programs as core email priorities.
 What we’re looking for
 5+ years leading B2B SaaS email, demand generation, or growth programs, with ownership of multi-quarter roadmaps and measurable pipeline or revenue impact.
 Deep hands-on Knak experience and enough technical fluency in segmentation, automation, tracking, and deliverability to review send setup and recognize when something isn’t working.
 Strong creative and editorial judgment; you can improve messaging, concepts, and execution beyond the initial brief.
 Strategic, analytical thinking across audience growth, experimentation, database health, and performance tied to business outcomes.
 Strong cross-functional influence and clear communication with leadership. You can align stakeholders, make tradeoffs, push back constructively, mentor teammates, and drive accountability.

 Working knowledge of Marketo, Salesforce, or similar marketing systems.
 Experience with customer adoption, cross-sell, or upsell, or email across multiple segments, regions, or products.

jobs.title: Global Learning Content & Delivery Specialist
jobs.location: Berlin, Germany; Gothenburg, Sweden; London, UK
jobs.description:
The Learning and Development Specialist helps Navan deliver its strategic and operational objectives by turning the global learning strategy into practical, effective learning experiences.
 As part of the Navan Core and Navan Signature Global Learning Team, you will represent learners and the Learning and Development team on key global projects. You will contribute to the learning strategy and roadmap, then design and deliver the learning content and activities within your scope. You will own the development of learning materials, support training delivery as needed, and maintain the learning management system.
 Your work will help Global Service and Operations teams put our service philosophy into practice: We provide industry-leading service so our customers have an exceptional, seamless travel and expense experience, while achieving unparalleled efficiency. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 As part of the Learning and Development team, you’ll support the Customer Experience organization by:
 Partnering with learning content administrators and business stakeholders to build and deliver engaging new hire curricula and learning pathways for existing colleagues. Tailor learning to different learner profiles and business priorities, helping new hires reach competency efficiently without compromising quality.
 Developing and maintaining learning content, supporting training delivery as needed, and keeping the learning management system and learning portfolio up to date. Coordinate stakeholder reviews and sign-off before content is published.
 Working with the wider Learning and Development team and standards trainer to shape content plans and establish consistent formats and frameworks for learning across regions and delivery settings, including remote, hybrid, and in-person learning.
 Delivering effective training that meets different learner needs and supports successful outcomes across regions and learning environments.
 Conducting regular learning needs analyses and partnering with Navan Core and Navan Signature leaders to identify learning gaps and implement learning that reflects organizational needs and regional requirements.
 Building feedback loops across Global Operations and Service to encourage, capture, and act on feedback about learning content and delivery.
 Partnering with internal and external stakeholders, including CAPS and Product, to keep learning content current as products, regulations, sourcing strategies, and the travel industry change.
 Continuously developing your knowledge of Navan, travel industry standards, and customer experience practices to keep learning content accurate and relevant.
 What We’re Looking For: 
 Strategic learning partnership: Uses a strategic, analytical, and consultative approach to understand business needs and determine when learning is the right solution. Keeps programs aligned with business priorities and the global learning strategy.
 Learning design and delivery: Applies Learning and Development principles to create clear, engaging programs for different learning needs. Uses effective design, testing, and delivery practices to achieve the intended outcomes.
 Measurement and continuous improvement: Evaluates learning quality and impact, defines success measures with stakeholders, and uses performance data and learner feedback to improve programs and measure return on investment.
 Customer and travel expertise: Understands how learning supports customer experience. Has customer service experience in a contact center or customer-facing role, and experience in a TMC or business travel role covering air, rail, car, and hotel products. Has advanced working knowledge of Sabre and Amadeus.
 Facilitation and relevant experience: Communicates confidently and has experience presenting to and managing classes of 12 or more learners. Brings at least one year of experience in a Learning and Development Specialist or content role, and takes ownership of ongoing development.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Navan Edge is an AI-powered personal assistant and concierge for frequent business travelers, on iPhone and web. It learns preferences, executes complex bookings, stacks rewards like hotel loyalty, and hands off to a 24/7 human concierge.
 Edge is a chat product. Screens change with the conversation, and timing is not fixed. Writing stable UI automation for that is the core of this job. You'll plan and implement iOS and web automation for Edge, and define how the tests run, fail, and get owned.
 What You’ll Do: 
 Write and maintain UI automation for iOS (Maestro or equivalent) and web (Cypress or equivalent) on booking paths: hotels, flights, restaurants, loyalty.
 Make tests stable on a chat UI: no hard sleeps, variable copy and layout, streaming results. A failure should mean a real defect, not flake.
 Own coverage, stability, and effectiveness of Edge automation, and maintain the CI/CD for it (Bitrise, Jenkins, GitHub).
 Define the protocol: what runs, when, what blocks a release, what is informational, what is skipped and why.
 On failure: capture evidence, open a ticket with a named owner, retest after the fix.
 Keep pass rate, flake rate, and coverage visible in dashboards people use.
 Work daily with iOS, web, Edge, and SRE. Escalate quality risks early.
 What We’re Looking For: 
 3 to 5 years building and owning UI automation, not only running an existing suite.
 Experience automating dynamic or conversational UIs, or a clear record of fixing flaky tests.
 Hands-on with agents and models: working with an agent product, MCP (or equivalent tool and agent interfaces), and enough model and LLM literacy to test and debug agent-driven UI. Not prompt research.
 iOS: Maestro, or Appium/XCUITest with the ability to work in Maestro.
 Web: Cypress or Playwright.
 Strong troubleshooting and clear communication. Tickets include evidence and a named owner.
 Comfortable in a fast-moving environment.
 Nice to have: 
 Maestro and Cypress in the same role.
 Grafana.
 Bitrise (CI/CD platform).
 Slack and JIRA used a failure-to-ticket process.

Navan Expense provides employees with a refreshingly easy way to pay for what they need while giving finance leaders one easy place to control, manage, and track spend. With physical and virtual cards, smart policy management, and automated expense reports, Navan Expense streamlines the entire business spending process — driving cost-savings, productivity, and compliance.
 We’re looking to bring on a Solutions Consultant, Expense who will continue to scale Navan Expense and the future of this product line.  You will be a key player in helping Account Managers expand Expense product offerings within current strategic travel accounts, implement the Expense solution, and increase adoption within the Commercial segment by combining your expertise of accounting and finance with your knowledge of our expense management platform and corporate credit card. jobs.description:
Email is one of the most direct ways we connect with prospects and customers—and this is your opportunity to lead it. On the Digital Demand Gen team, you’ll have the ownership to set the strategy, the creative freedom to try new approaches, and the hands-on role to bring them to life. If you want to see your ideas translate into stronger engagement, pipeline, and revenue, this role puts that impact within reach.
 Based in San Francisco, this senior individual-contributor role spans prospect nurture, pipeline generation, customer adoption, cross-sell, and upsell. 
 What you’ll do
 Lead a multi-quarter roadmap for nurture, campaigns, newsletters, and follow-up journeys. Partner with Demand Gen and Sales to connect growth goals to audiences, messages, offers, and next steps.
 Partner with Marketing Operations on the email calendar; own what goes out and when. Prioritize competing requests so each contact gets relevant, valuable content at the right time without being overwhelmed.
  Align campaign owners on priorities and timing, communicate tradeoffs, and push back constructively on requests that dilute the audience experience.
 Set the creative bar for concepts, copy, and design. Use briefs and performance insights to guide reviews and coach Creative and Campaign partners toward useful, distinctive, on-brand emails.
 Build, QA, and optimize modular emails in Knak, including personalization and reusable components. Create templates, workflows, and QA standards for consistent execution. Marketing Operations owns technical setup and sending; review their work and flag targeting, automation, tracking, or delivery issues.
 Grow and protect the reachable prospect database. Partner with Marketing Operations on acquisition, segmentation, automation, deployment, deliverability, consent, and suppression.
 Lead testing across audiences, offers, messages, formats, cadence, and timing, prioritizing experiments by business impact and learning value.
 Measure conversion, pipeline, opportunities, and revenue alongside engagement, audience health, and deliverability. Turn results into clear recommendations for leadership on strategy, creative, targeting, and investment.
 Partner with Lifecycle and Customer Marketing to develop and optimize adoption, cross-sell, and upsell programs as core email priorities.
 What we’re looking for
 5+ years leading B2B SaaS email, demand generation, or growth programs, with ownership of multi-quarter roadmaps and measurable pipeline or revenue impact.

 Strategic, analytical thinking across audience growth, experimentation, database health, and performance tied to business outcomes.

jobs.title: Financial Products General Ledger Team Lead
jobs.description:
Financial Products General Ledger Team Lead 
 Sofia, Bulgaria | Permanent, office-first 
 Take a look inside our Sofia office 
 Team description 
 The Financial Products General Ledger (FGL) team sits at the strategic core of SumUp's financial operations. We own the financial integrity of SumUp's financial products (payment services, issuance of electronic money), ensuring every euro of revenue and cost from our payments, merchant business accounts, banking and cash advance lending products is accurately captured, reconciled and reported.
 As SumUp scales, our work has become highly analytical and data-driven. We combine deep accounting knowledge with SQL, AI-assisted reconciliation tools and advanced data analytics to understand not just what was recorded, but why and how our business operates financially.
 This leadership role is the owner of the European FGL team. You will lead a team of 6 people, own the quality and timeliness of the e-money and PSP close, and drive the automation and controls that will support our IPO-readiness.
 What you'll do 
 Lead a team of 6 accountants, setting clear expectations, priorities and workload distribution.
 Coach team members on complex reconciliations, accounting judgment calls and month-end routines; support their professional growth and foster a culture of precision, curiosity and continuous improvement. 
 Work on subject matter that covers the core activities of regulated business in the Fintech industry - payment processing, issuance of electronic money and cash advances, characterized by complex financial transactions and big data sets.
 Map the accounting flow for new products and ensure correct treatment before launch.
 Lead the audit and year-end close readiness, with timely responses to auditors. 
 Communicate complex accounting issues clearly to non-finance stakeholders and escalate facts and impact when needed. 
 Own the documentation and continuous improvement of process governance (Desktop Procedures, Process Maps), internal controls systems and key performance indicators.
 You'll be great for this role if... 
 Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in multiple accounting domains, including reconciliations, general ledger management and IFRS financial reporting, ideally in an international company. 
 Prior experience leading an accounting team.
 ACCA certification required (or near completion).
 You want to understand why discrepancies happen and how to prevent them. 
 You can drive root-cause analysis and systematic improvements across multiple reconciliations and entities.
 You lead through influence, coaching and clear communication. 
 You are motivated to drive automation, controls and process improvement in a fast-growing fintech. 
 You want to understand how the business works, not just record what happened. 
 Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERP systems.
 Experience with with data tools such as Snowflake, BI or Tableau is a plus.
 Why you should join SumUp 
 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our modern Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup 
 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 
 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 
 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 and 10 paid days of educational leave which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education 
 🏖 Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options

jobs.title: Senior AML Investigator
jobs.description:
Senior AML Investigator
 📍  Sofia, Bulgaria  (Office-first)
 Team description
 As part of the AML Operations Team, you'll be one of the silent protectors keeping SumUp and its millions of merchants safe from financial crime, investigating flagged activity before it can turn into real harm. You'll dig into transaction patterns and customer behaviour to catch potential money laundering, terrorist financing, and other illicit activity, working closely with colleagues across the business to land on the right call. If you want a role where sharp attention to detail genuinely protects people and the business, this is where you'll find it.
 📽  Take a look inside our Sofia office 
 What you'll do
 Investigate transactions and accounts flagged by the transaction monitoring system to assess potential risk
 Analyse transaction patterns and customer behaviour to identify signs of money laundering or other financial crime
 Document investigation findings clearly and work with colleagues across the business to reach a final decision on suspicious activity
 Keep up to date with AML regulations and industry best practice, applying them in day to day investigations
 You'll be great for this role if
 At least 1–2 years of experience in AML investigation and financial crimes reporting or a similar field.
 A strong understanding of AML regulations, financial products, and services.
 Proven ability to conduct data analysis and complex investigations.
 Proficiency with technical tools like Microsoft Excel and other data analysis software.
 Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
 Strong communication skills, with excellent command of spoken and written English.
 A proactive and adaptable team player who can thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment.
 A quick learner with the ability to quickly grasp and apply new policies and procedures.

jobs.description:
Senior Risk & Fraud Prevention Analyst 
 Berlin, Germany · Office-first · Permanent, full-time 
 Team description 
 Global Fraud Prevention protects SumUp's banking products, from issued cards to cash in and cash out flows, keeping millions of merchants and consumers safe from financial crime. This role plays a key part in building stronger fraud observability and smarter decisioning for fast growing card issuing and banking volumes across the globe.  Advanced SQL skills for querying and manipulating large datasets

 Location: Berlin, Germany (office-first setup )
 Employment type: Full-time, permanent
 Team description
 Our Vendor Operations team is the engine that allows SumUp to support millions of merchants worldwide. We partner with external service providers to ensure our global support remains personal, efficient, and high-quality. We don't just manage vendors; we build seamless extensions of the SumUp culture, ensuring every merchant receives world-class service, no matter where they are in the world.
 As our Vendor Operations Analyst, you will be the person who keeps our BPO partners performing at their best: day in, day out.  Track productivity and efficiency KPIs across all outsourcing partners, spot deviations early, and push for corrective action before issues escalate

 Prepare data driven agendas for vendor business reviews, track agreed actions, and escalate when partners fall short of targets

 Experience investigating operational underperformance, such as productivity dips, rising backlogs, schedule adherence issues and turning findings into clear, prioritised, improvement plans.

jobs.title: Bilingual Strategic Cuisines Account Executive (Spanish) - Newark, NJ
jobs.description:
This is a bilingual Spanish field sales opportunity based out of a personal home office. You must live local to your territory in Newark/Elizabeth, NJ or be willing to relocate to the area.  
 Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
 As a Strategic Cuisines Account Executive, you will help grow Toast’s presence within the Spanish Cuisine restaurants. Using a consultative sales approach, you will convert inbound demand, generate new opportunities through referrals, and build trusted relationships with restaurateurs. By delivering a high quality, language inclusive experience, you will identify each restaurant’s needs and recommend how Toast’s end-to-end platform helps their business run better. Your role will focus on driving new customer growth through calls, demos, and closing contracts in the customer’s preferred language.
 A day in the life (Responsibilities)  
 Following up on marketing qualified leads in the market you support
 Conducting discovery calls & product demonstrations in your customer’s preferred language
 Creating and reviewing quotes and contracts in your customer’s preferred language
 Ensure our onboarding team and customer are set up for success post sale
 Understand the competitive landscape in your market (strengths, weaknesses, benefits) to best position Toast.
 Your Spanish skills will be used on the job to communicate with Spanish-speaking customers and prospective customers, while your English language skills will be used primarily for communicating with other employees at Toast.  
 As with most internal business at Toast, the job application and interview process for this role will be conducted primarily in English.
 Toast will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this role.
 What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) 
 Fluency in both oral and written English and Spanish is required for this role.
 Prior Sales experience preferred. 
 Ability to work in a fast-paced environment. 
 An entrepreneurial and feedback driven mindset.
 What will help you stand out (Nice to Haves/Nonessential Skills) 
 Restaurant Operations Experience
 Experience using Salesforce to keep track of Sales activities
 Sandler Sales Training
 AI at Toast 
 At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
 Our Total Rewards Philosophy 
 We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits .

In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards components include benefits and equity (if eligible). You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy .

 $148,000 — $237,000 USD 
 How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process 
 Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring 
 Our Approach to Hybrid Working 
We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region:  https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast 
 People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success 
 At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
 Toast International is building its upmarket business across the UK & Ireland, Canada, and Australia, focused on restaurant groups with 16 to 500 locations. We're hiring a solutions leader to own the technical side of every International deal over 15 locations. Your demos and labs are where our deals are won or lost. You'll start as a player-coach, carrying deals yourself, and you'll build the International upmarket solutions team as the business grows.
 About this role: 
 Run demos that win the room. Build every demo from discovery. Show a 40-site group their own menu, their own workflows and the systems they already run, in their market's version of the product. Tailor it to each person in the buying group, from the head of ops to the IT lead to finance. Leave each of them with a reason to champion Toast.
 Run labs that end in a decision. Agree success criteria with the customer before the lab starts. Build and maintain the lab environment, track every issue, drive escalations and root cause analysis, and close the lab with a clear yes or no. No lab ends without an agreed next step.
 Own the technical outcome through go-live. The deal isn't won until the customer is live and it matches what we sold. Stay involved through procurement and handoff.
 Architect the solution. Design how Toast fits into a multi-location group's existing stack:
 ERP, payroll and HR (e.g. Workday)
 Inventory, loyalty, gift card processors and kiosks
 Delivery and custom integrations
 Network and hardware
 Multi-entity and franchise structures, and data migration
 All of it within what's actually available, and what payments rules allow, in each market.
 Lead security, IT and compliance reviews. Own vendor security questionnaires, PCI scoping conversations and the technical sections of RFPs.
 Speak product's language. Write BRDs that product and engineering can act on: the problem, the customer's own words, workarounds tried, what's at stake across the segment (not just one account), and options with tradeoffs. Turn one customer's ask into a case for the platform.
 Present the roadmap with credibility. Walk executive and IT audiences through what exists, what's coming and what isn't, without overpromising. Keep their trust when the answer is "not yet."
 Sell outcomes, not features. Partner with sales to build the business case. Translate technical fit into the outcomes the economic buyer cares about, such as labor, speed of service and revenue. When a buyer is weighing a feature gap, help them see it against the full value of the platform, and make sure their IT team feels heard along the way.
 Engineer workarounds, and know when to hold the line. Design and document solutions to complex gaps, and judge when a workaround creates debt we'll pay for at go-live.
 Build real relationships outside the sales thread. Become the trusted counterpart to the customer's IT lead, head of operations and systems owners, relationships that hold up on their own merit.
 Hand off cleanly. Give onboarding and implementation a clear record of what was promised, what was configured and why, so delivery matches the sale.
 Build the function. Set the engagement model for when and how AEs bring you in, qualify technical fit early and disqualify fast, and build reusable assets: demo environments for each market, reference architectures, an RFP library and BRD standards.
 Partner across Solutions. Work closely with the International SMB Solutions team on clear lanes, shared tools and cross-coverage.
 Grow the team. Help define, hire and develop the International upmarket solutions team as the business scales.
 Own your own leverage. Continuously find the repetitive parts of the role (RFP answers, security questionnaires, discovery notes, demo resets) and systematically get them off your plate.
 Close the loop on what's broken. Feed product gaps, lost-deal reasons and market differences back to product and sales leadership, so the next deal is easier than the last.
 Do you have the right ingredients: 
 An elite demo and lab track record. You've run tailored demos for multi-stakeholder buying committees and taken complex labs or pilots to a signed decision. In the interview, you'll run a demo for us and walk us through a lab you ran end to end.
 You build and maintain your own environments. Demo data, lab configurations and resets are your job, done fast and adapted for each market.
 7+ years in solutions architecture, solutions engineering or technical consulting, with at least 4 supporting mid-market or enterprise deals with 6 to 12+ month cycles and buying committees.
 Experience in hospitality, retail or payments technology serving multi-location operators.
 You've taken complex deals through lab or pilot to go-live. You can walk us through one end to end, including what went wrong and what you changed.
 Integration fluency: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication and data flows. You can read API docs and sketch an architecture on a whiteboard. Coding isn't required, but you can test your own assumptions.
 Security and compliance fluency: PCI DSS scope, and privacy regimes such as UK GDPR, PIPEDA and the Australian Privacy Act. You're comfortable owning a security review.
 Writing that product teams act on. Bring a sanitized requirements doc, solution design or BRD to the interview.
 Executive presence with C-suite and IT leaders, including delivering "no" and keeping the relationship.
 You've mentored or led SEs, or built a presales process from scratch, and you want to build a team.
 International experience across more than one market or regulatory regime. Willing to travel across the UK & Ireland, Canada and Australia (30%+).
 Comfort working in build mode, where territory definition, process and tooling are actively being shaped and you're expected to have an opinion on them.
 Special Sauce (non-essential skills, nice to have): 
 Hands-on experience with enterprise POS or hospitality platforms in these markets
 ERP, HR or workforce management integration experience
 MEDDPICC
 What success looks like in year one 
 Every 16+ location deal gets a tailored demo, and every lab has agreed success criteria and ends in a decision.
 Deals we win go live on the timeline we agreed. No stalls, no churn, no post-sale surprises.
 AEs know exactly when and how to bring you in, and technical fit is settled early in the cycle, not in week ten.
 Product changes a decision because of a BRD you wrote.
 A clear plan for the next upmarket solutions hire.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Orders
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
 On the Orders POS Team, our mission is to provide a state of the art platform for processing and synchronizing changes to orders that enables Toast to build complex and customizable workflows for our customers.
 As a Staff Software Engineer on this team, you’ll play a key role in designing and implementing new features, evolving our architecture and tooling to ensure efficient high-quality delivery, and working with many other Toast R&D teams to bring high-visibility product experiences to life, ensuring that over 1 billion order changes per week across over 200,000 customers are processed quickly and accurately.
 A day in the life (Responsibilities) 
 Lead the design and delivery of significant capabilities on Toast's Orders platform that span multiple teams, from the cloud to the point of sale
 Join a collaborative team of Design, Product, QA, and other engineering members in developing robust and scalable software within Toast’s POS applications
 Drive architectural decisions for correctness, performance, and scale; author and review technical designs within and beyond the team
 Provide design feedback and participate in code reviews to ensure implementations meet requirements
 Align the technical vision and roadmap for the Orders platform with Toast's strategy
 Be a domain expert for order processing and synchronization, and the go-to partner for teams whose products build on orders
 Advocate for best coding practices to raise the bar for you, your team, and the company
 Mentor and provide technical guidance to other team members and raise the engineering bar across the team and the broader Orders organization.
 What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) 
 8+ years of experience with Object Oriented Languages like Java or Kotlin
 Track record of delivering significant platform capabilities across multiple teams in large engineering organizations
 A mix of mobile and backend development expertise, focused on distributed systems problems at high scale in large codebases
 Deep understanding of automated testing, quality, and SDLC best practices, with a history of shipping reliable apps, microservices, and libraries to production

jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 At Toast, we’re building the future of the restaurant industry—and our Global Tax team is building the foundation that makes it all possible. 
 The International Senior Tax Manager is a highly visible, hands-on role responsible for supporting Toast's non-U.S. tax matters across our growing international footprint. The role will have a primary focus on foreign corporate income tax compliance and reporting, while also providing support across VAT/GST, local statutory matters, tax audits, and other international tax requirements.
 Working closely with the U.S.-based Corporate Tax and Global Indirect Tax teams, local-based business partners and external advisors, this role will help coordinate international tax compliance, support quarterly and annual tax reporting, monitor evolving local tax requirements, and provide tax support for business expansion and other cross-border initiatives.

 International Income Tax & Compliance 
 Coordinate and review corporate income tax compliance for Toast's non-U.S. entities, working with accounting teams and external advisors.

 Monitor international income tax developments and assess potential impacts to Toast's foreign operations.
 Support local tax audits, inquiries, assessments, and statutory tax requirements across international jurisdictions.
 Coordinate with the Corporate Tax team on transfer pricing, intercompany transactions, and other cross-border tax matters.
 Drive international R&D tax credit activities in partnership with the Corporate Tax team and external advisors.
 Lead ongoing monitoring and reporting of IDA grant commitments in coordination with relevant business stakeholders.
 International Indirect Tax 
 Partner with the Global Indirect Tax team and external advisors on VAT/GST technical matters and changes in local requirements.
 Support implementation and ongoing compliance with e-invoicing and digital reporting requirements.

jobs.title: Head of Investor Relations
jobs.description:
About Figure 
 Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.
Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.
We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies .
 About the Role 
 Figure is seeking a Head of Investor Relations to own and execute the company’s investor relations program. This role reports to the VP, Corp Dev, IR & Strategy and will work in close collaboration with Figure’s CEO, CFO, and co-founder and Executive Chairman Mike Cagney. You’ll be the driving force on how we tell Figure’s story to the public markets, and you’ll also do the execution: shaping our shareholder and communication strategy, building the materials, meeting with investors and research analysts, running the calendar, and keeping the program moving day to day.
 This is an individual contributor role. There’s no team underneath it, so we’re looking for someone who enjoys being hands-on, owning processes end-to-end, and is energized, not deterred, by the pace around earnings. You will also work cross-functionally across the organization, especially with the Finance and Biz Ops teams, to build and communicate the metrics to clearly communicate the Figure story. 
 While a deep understanding and history in equity capital markets is a must-have, we’re also looking for someone who thinks about investor communication in a modern way. Public companies are increasingly reaching investors through more engaging earnings formats and direct digital channels. We want someone who brings fresh ideas while keeping the discipline and compliance a public company requires.
 What You’ll Do 
 Develop and execute an IR strategy that clearly communicates Figure’s financial performance, strategic direction, and market positioning.
 Drive improvements in shareholder outreach strategy in order to attract new, high-quality investors into Figure’s shareholder base.
 Serve as the primary point of contact for investors, analysts, and financial media (WSJ, Bloomberg etc.), fostering strong relationships and ensuring transparent communication.
 Manage relationships with equity research analysts from major investment banks, ensuring accurate and fair coverage of the company.
 Oversee the preparation and dissemination of quarterly earnings releases and related conference calls, investor presentations, and other financial disclosures in compliance with regulatory requirements.
 Monitor market trends, peer activity, and investor sentiment to inform strategic messaging and provide insights to senior management.
 Leverage knowledge of blockchain technology and real-world asset tokenization to effectively communicate the company's blockchain initiatives and their impact on the business model and market landscape to the investment community.
 Develop and implement communication strategies to address market volatility and other crises, maintaining investor confidence.
 What We Look For 
 5–10 years of experience in public markets investing, sell-side (equity research or ECM), or corporate IR.
 A strong understanding of the equity capital markets and how equity investors evaluate companies, and the ability to anticipate their questions.
 A willingness to roll up your sleeves and a strong sense of ownership over work products. You’re comfortable doing the scheduling, drafting, editing, and reading yourself, and working with the ups-and-downs of the earnings cycle.
 Strong background in financial modeling, analysis, reporting, and familiarity with investor relations platforms.
 Familiarity with public company disclosure requirements and Reg FD, or the ability to get up to speed quickly.
 Proven ability to partner with executive leadership, build trust across all levels, and drive broadly accepted solutions.
 A strong interest in the institutional application of blockchain and real-world asset tokenization.
 An interest in modern investor engagement, including social and digital channels, retail investors, and new earnings formats.
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to executives and investors.
 Bachelor’s degree.
 Strong analytical and strategic thinking with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
 Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and managing multiple projects.
 Established relationships with institutional investors, analysts, and financial media.
 Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
 Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
 Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.
 Salary 
 Base Compensation Range: $226,160 - $339,240/yr
 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly 
 Company equity in the form of RSUs

While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans

jobs.title: Partnerships Lead, New Verticals
jobs.description:
About Figure 
 Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.
Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.
We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies .
 About the Role 
 You will scale three New Verticals: depository institutions, home improvement, and small business lending. 
 This role grows the volume of loans originated on Figure's platform. We want lenders, platforms, and depository institutions to originate on Figure's loan origination system, through private-label programs, embedded and SaaS-style integrations, and direct adoption. You take these partnerships from first conversation through launch and scaling: structuring the commercial terms, negotiating, and pulling together the internal teams needed to launch.
 You will report to the Director of Platform Partnerships and primarily own the hard middle of the process, where partnerships are actually won or lost.
 Work across Figure's key growth markets (including small business, home improvement, and depository institutions) to bring partners onto the platform via direct relationships, private-label programs, embedded integrations, and key channel ecosystem partnerships.
 What You'll Do 
 Map the market and source high-value strategic, product, and channel partnerships.
 Structure and negotiate the commercial terms and product setup for each partner.
 Build our new bank and credit union channel, landing the partners and integrations that make Figure easy for these institutions to adopt.
 Win partnerships in the home improvement and small business lending ecosystems that drive funded volume across multiple products (e.g. HELOC, fix-&-flip, DSCR).
 Coordinate the internal teams a launch depends on, including product, engineering, credit, legal, and implementation, to get partners live and scaling.
 Own each partnership internally. Spot where it is likely to stall and clear the path before it does.
 Build repeatable program structures and playbooks so each new partnership moves faster than the last.
 Track your deal pipeline and activity in Salesforce (our CRM).
 What We Look For 
 5+ years in strategic partnerships, investment banking, venture capital / private equity, business development, consulting, or a related field (we care way more about your actual impact and scope of work than the exact years on your resume—so if you're a bit outside this range, definitely still apply!). Experience with lending, fintech, SaaS, or financial institutions is a plus.
 A track record building platform, product, or channel partnerships, ideally involving banks, credit unions, and non-bank lenders – including the systems they run on.
 Strong negotiation skills and the patience to run a long, multi-party process all the way to launch.
 A working understanding of consumer and small-business lending. You do not need deep capital-markets expertise for this role, but you should understand how originations work.
 Organized and detail-oriented, and good at getting cross-functional teams to move.
 Comfortable with ambiguity and able to own outcomes.
 Nice to have: experience partnering with or selling into depositories, POS, LOS, or core integrations, or home-improvement and small-business lending.
 Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
 Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
 Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.
 Salary 
 Base Compensation Range: $120,000 - $150,000/yr
 On-target earnings: $190,000 - $240,000/yr
 Company equity in the form of RSUs
 This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.
 Benefits 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
 Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
 Employer-paid life and disability insurance
 11 observed holidays and PTO plan
 Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave
 Continuing education reimbursement

 THE WORK: 
 Ripple’s Internal Audit Team within the Legal and Compliance organization is searching for an Internal Audit Information Technology (IT) Manager to implement the risk-based audit plan as the 3rd line of defense for the company! The IT Internal Auditor will work under the supervision of the Internal Audit leadership to complete technical audits and build relationships with leaders across the organization. To succeed, qualified candidates may exhibit the ability to problem-solve as part of a team, demonstrate the capability to actively pursue their career development, exhibit technical proficiency in audit procedures, and interact with client personnel in a professional manner.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO: 
 Manage IT audits successfully through conducting interviews, identifying key risks and controls, drafting work papers, gathering evidence, performing testing and reviewing workpapers.
 Prepare audit work papers adhering to international auditing standards for quality and content, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
 Evaluate and detail the design and efficiency of internal controls, identifying control gaps and opportunities for process improvement.
 Collaborate with Information Security & GRC partners to assess audit findings, communicate control weaknesses, and assist in developing management action plans for mitigation while evaluating the adequacy of responses.
 Prepare comprehensive audit reports outlining findings and recommendations, presenting results to senior management for review and action.
 Coordinate with external auditors and regulatory bodies to support examination efforts, ensuring compliance and transparency in audit processes.
 Manage and mentor junior staff, providing guidance and professional development.
 WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 
 Bachelor's Degree in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, or equivalent business field.
 Minimum 5 years experience conducting internal or external risk-based IT audits. Experience performing audits across Financial Services, Banking & Capital Markets industry is preferred.
 Proven knowledge of accounting principles and Generally Accepted Auditing Standards.
 Solid understanding of Sarbanes-Oxley and/or COSO/COBIT internal control framework is a plus.
 Certifications such as Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), and/or Certified Information Security Professional (CISSP) are a plus.
 Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

 THE WORK 
 Ripple Treasury (formerly GTreasury) is the leading innovator of integrated SaaS treasury and risk management solutions for the digital treasurer. Developed using the latest technology, Ripple Treasury helps empower organizations on their path to strategic treasury, by enabling total visibility into their cash, liquidity, payments and financial risk management.
 At Ripple Treasury, we believe that data-driven decisions are the heartbeat of a successful enterprise. As a Professional Services Consultant, you are the critical link between our cutting- edge technology and the real-world financial goals of our global clients. You aren't just implementing a platform; you are a digital architect and a trusted advisor. Your mission is to deeply understand a client's unique business environment, prescribe industry best practices, and architect a configuration that transforms their treasury operations into a powerhouse of efficiency.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 Discovery & Strategy: Lead deep-dive discovery sessions to uncover client pain points, workflows, and technical requirements

jobs.title: Director, People Operations & Total Rewards
jobs.description:
Pie's mission is to empower small businesses to thrive by making commercial insurance affordable and as easy as pie. We leverage technology to transform how small businesses buy and experience commercial insurance.
 Like our small business customers, we are a diverse team of builders, dreamers, and entrepreneurs who are driven by  core values and operating principles  that guide every decision we make.
 With approximately 350 team members today and scaling through people and technology for the future, Pie is seeking an exceptional Director of People Operations & Total Rewards (Dir, POps & TR) to join the People leadership team. This role will shape and elevate our human resources function at a strategic level through AI, technology, and a blend of business- and people-centered approaches.
 The Dir, POps & TR reports to the Chief People Officer (CPO). This Director role serves as a critical member of the People, Talent & Executive Support (PTE) leadership team, partnering directly with the CPO to co-develop and drive people operations, total rewards and technology strategies. The Director is accountable for the team member lifecycle delivery and experience from pre-hire through retire and supporting the alumnae experience. With this broad-reaching responsibility, the Director provides the structure, data, and analysis necessary for Pie’s leaders and People, Talent and Executive Operations teams to execute against Pie’s people-driven strategies. Given the breadth of responsibilities, this position will align with and influence multiple centers of excellence across the organization — including business intelligence, finance, analytics, and culture ambassadorship.
 The Dir, POps & TR will own the development and execution of 12+ month strategies that shape functional direction and inform broader people strategy, aligned to company objectives. This role has three core pillars of ownership: People Operations, Total Rewards, and PTE Technology. Within these pillars, the Director is responsible for: people operations and tech strategy co-development with the CPO; payroll management; Total Rewards strategy and administration, including compensation, benefits, equity and leave programs — with a Total Rewards expert executing under their leadership; strategic ownership and governance of the People, Talent and Exec Operations technology stack with a strong focus on AI and automation; Workday configuration, maintenance, and data integrity; People workflow, process design and SOP management; reporting and analytics; contractor program oversight and reporting, and compliance. The role is also expected to partner closely with the Dir, Talent to support Talent Operations and the Manager of EA team to support Executive Operations. Aligning all of these areas around cohesive strategies that connect to Pie’s goals and competitive differentiation will be key to our collective success.
 The right person for this role is restless about improvement — not just executing the function, but continuously evolving it. They bring fresh eyes and a bias for experimentation to People Operations, and as a natural side effect of how they operate, they will contribute to making adjacent People team functions better as well. This cross-functional lift isn’t their core responsibility, but it is a hallmark of the leader we’re looking for.
 How You’ll Do It 
 Strategic Leadership, Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Design and sustain an innovative, effective, and inclusive work culture that retains and grows the best talent for the People Team and Pie as an organization
 Directly manage the People and Talent Operations team, currently comprised of four full-time team members with varying levels of experience and responsibility and which is expected to grow as the business demands
 Continuously improve the People Operations function — not just maintaining what exists, but actively evolving how the team operates, identifying what’s not working, and leading the team to a better state over time
 Bring fresh perspective and a partnership mindset to adjacent People team functions; while not directly responsible for those areas, contribute actively to their improvement through shared ideas, candid feedback, and collaborative experimentation
 Continuously uplevel thought leadership specific to People Operations and Total Rewards, leveraging emerging frameworks, AI, and technologies to shape how the function operates
 Accountable for all aspects of people management across the team, including development, coaching, training, and performance management
 Proactively establish and maintain strong collaborative working relationships across the organization with a focus on the following stakeholders: Finance & Accounting, Enterprise Technology, Internal Communications, Legal & Compliance, Product, the Pie Executive Team, the Senior Leadership Team, and the Office of the CEO
 Serve as the strategic owner of Total Rewards at Pie, setting direction on compensation philosophy, benefits strategy, and equity administration; partner with the Total Rewards expert on execution and with Finance and Legal on governance
 Partner proactively with People Partners, Talent, and the Executive Support and Space teams on strategy development and outstanding execution across all aspects of the People, Talent & Exec Support functions
 Leveraging Pie’s Collaboration and Decision Making Framework (CDMF), serve in a lead execution role, as well as supporting and consultative roles, on cross-functional, complex project and program management initiatives
 Lead across the organization as an AI champion and expert, freely sharing learnings and adaptable approaches with leaders and teams across the organization
 People Operations Management 
 Lead the People Operations team through strategic processes, projects, and complex situations; set the organizational standard for rigor, execution, and continuous improvement
 Design, deliver, and monitor the strategic roadmap for the People Operations function on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis
 Oversee payroll approval for the biweekly pay cycle for non-exempt and exempt team members
 Tech Stack Management 
 Own the strategic design, delivery, and administration of our HRIS (Workday) and oversee the People tech stack and resources (Culture Amp, Continu, Ethena, Carta (shared), etc.) while driving AI solutions for faster and higher quality outcomes
