 - Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Field teams to feed customer data architecture patterns back into the product roadmap

 


ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

 - 3–8 years of industry experience, in a pre-sales or solutions architecture role focused on data platforms

 - Deep hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and cloud data warehouse / data lakehouse architectures; able to write working code in a customer session without hesitation

 - Broad experience across the modern data stack: ETL/ELT tools (dbt, Fivetran, Informatica, Spark), streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis), orchestration (Airflow, dbt Cloud), BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)

 - Proven ability to conduct deep data architecture discovery — understanding a customer's source systems, transformation layers, consumption patterns, and governance requirements — and connect those findings to a Snowflake reference architecture

 - Experience positioning AI and ML capabilities within a data platform context: feature stores, model training pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and AI governance

 - Strong intuition for data governance, quality, and compliance challenges (GDPR, CCPA, PCI) and how platform design decisions affect them

 - Ability to quantify the business value of a modern data architecture — cost reduction, time-to-insight, pipeline reliability, data product monetization

 - A demonstrated track record using AI code generation tools to accelerate prototyping and proof-of-concept delivery

 - University degree in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's in Data Science or Business Analytics is a plus

 - Experience working with GSIs (EY, Deloitte, Accenture, Slalom, etc.) on large data platform programs is beneficial but not required

 


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

 - $220,000 - $288,000 OTE (On Target Earnings = Base Salary + Commission/Quota)

 - Snowflake offers competitive base salary, variable compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits including 401(k), health/dental/vision, flexible PTO, and professional development budget.

 


ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer-obsessed data practitioners. We believe in rigorous discovery before prescribing solutions, we stay honest about what Snowflake can and can't do, and we hold ourselves accountable to outcomes — not just demos. We love to learn, give and receive direct feedback, and are relentless about making our customers' data more accessible, reliable, and valuable. If you have strong opinions about data architecture and enjoy proving them with working code, you'll fit right in.

 


ABOUT SNOWFLAKE:

Snowflake started with a clear vision: make modern data warehousing effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Today the Snowflake Data Cloud goes far beyond warehousing — it's where organizations build data pipelines, run ML workloads, share live data across the ecosystem, and power AI applications, all on a single governed platform. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events. 
 In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. 
 Who you are 
  You are a generalist who enjoys answering business questions with data, and you bring a BS degree in a relevant quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Math, Operations Research, Economics) or equivalent practical experience; an MS is a plus.

 Drive active engagement with new and existing leads through creative follow-up communications.
 Analyze addressable markets in emergent geographies and create demand for our disruptive technology.
 Collaborate cross-functionally to create new processes and refine existing ones through innovative thinking.
 Document all activities within our CRM, maintaining flawless data management.
 What This Role Offers 
 A formal SGP-to-SGM training program designed to fast-track your career into a closing sales position.
 Direct partnership and mentorship from top-performing Strategic Growth Managers and market leaders.
 A highly collaborative environment where you can actively innovate on processes and outbound strategies.
 Operate with a "glass-half-full" mentality, making a tangible impact on the company's market expansion.

 Christie’s International Real Estate & @properties
 Chicago, Illinois | Reporting to President, Christie’s International Real Estate 
 The Opportunity 
 We are seeking an exceptional marketing professional to lead the next chapter of Christie’s International Real Estate and @properties. This is an opportunity to shape two distinctive brands, reimagine a global marketing organization, and play a defining role in our international growth.
 The mandate extends beyond traditional marketing. This leader will bring together creative talent, human judgment, and AI to build an organization known for its imagination, responsiveness, and ability to deliver remarkable work at scale.
 At the heart of this opportunity is a relationship unlike any other in luxury real estate. For centuries, Christie’s Auction House has mastered the presentation and sale of extraordinary art, furniture, jewelry, and objects. Christie’s International Real Estate represents the homes in which those objects live. Connecting these worlds through storytelling, experiences, and relationships is an opportunity few brands can match.
 As part of Compass International Holdings, we have the reach and resources to pursue that ambition worldwide.
 The Mandate 
 Reimagine the organization. Lead and reshape a team of more than 25 professionals, combining creative excellence with AI and technology to improve productivity, responsiveness, and the quality of work delivered across our network.
 Accelerate global growth. Make marketing a compelling reason for leading independent brokerages to join Christie’s International Real Estate. Build the capabilities to attract new affiliates and support their success without compromising brand distinction.
 Elevate the agent experience. Create marketing services and tools that agents value and competitors cannot easily replicate. Strengthen engagement, loyalty, and pride in our brands while helping agents win business.
 Unlock the Christie’s relationship. Connect luxury real estate with art, design, and collecting through shared storytelling, partnerships, events, and experiences that give affiliates a meaningful advantage.
 Define the creative direction. Lead our brands across social media, digital campaigns, print, editorial, publications, and events. Develop a social media presence that defines our luxury positioning, showcases our properties, and builds global audiences. Direct the creation and launch of a new global website and oversee our signature luxury magazine, preserving the heritage of Christie’s and the entrepreneurial spirit of @properties.
 Build for growth. Direct marketing budgets, technology investments, partnerships, and revenue-generating initiatives. Collaborate with franchise development, affiliate services, and international leadership to ensure marketing drives business results.
 The Individual 
 We seek a leader with refined creative judgment, commercial instincts, and the ability to build a sophisticated organization.
 This individual understands luxury as a standard of quality, service, discretion, and attention to detail. They must inspire creative talent, lead organizational change, and translate brand investment into measurable growth.
 Required Experience 
 10+ years of progressive marketing and brand experience leading substantial marketing teams, managing significant budgets, and implementing new technologies. Experience in luxury real estate, fashion, hospitality, art, or other distinguished global brands is particularly relevant, as is an understanding of franchise and affiliate networks.
 The Future 
 Reporting to the president, Christie’s International Real Estate, you will also work closely with the CEO/Founder, and will be a member of the senior leadership team.  
 The opportunity is not simply to lead marketing for two established brands. It is to build an organization whose creativity, influence, and value make those brands impossible to overlook.

Implementation is a critical moment in the customer journey: it's where clients first see VTS deliver the value  they bought, and where retention truly begins. In the Senior Implementation Manager role, you will guide global leaders in commercial real estate toward driving early, measurable value from VTS. You'll own onboarding for our largest, most sophisticated  clients, leading enterprise rollouts of VTS AI, from portfolio-scale document abstraction to persona-based activation. Effective Senior Implementation Managers set our clients up for immediate value and long-term retention from day one. This role is fully client facing and is equal parts onboarding and outcome realization.

 This isn't your typical implementation role. At VTS, you'll join a lean, high-impact, AI-augmented implementation team that shares one mission with Client Success - deliver value to your client.

jobs.title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
jobs.description:
About the role   
 The HR team helps protect the firm's largest investment: our people. As a Senior HRBP in our global People Operations team, you'll work with business leaders on complex organizational challenges as the business changes and help keep our culture strong along the way. A large part of the role is coaching. You'll be a trusted coach to leaders and managers, helping them lead their teams, handle hard moments and grow their people. The role is both strategic and hands-on. You'll care about the people, and you'll also see how a great workplace drives business results.   
 We work in a flat, consensus-driven environment where influence matters more than hierarchy. Our team is innovative, driven, collaborative and trustworthy, and we care about what we do and who we do it with.   
 What you'll do   
 Partner on people strategy. Be a thought partner to business leaders. Turn business strategy into decisions on workforce planning, org design, succession and talent. Help managers set their annual priorities and plans. 
 Coach leaders and managers.  Be a trusted one-to-one coach to senior leaders and people managers. Provide coaching on leadership style, performance and feedback conversations, team dynamics, stakeholder relationships and leading through change. Help leaders see their blind spots and build habits to address them. 
 Develop talent.  Help managers grow their people through development plans, internal moves and global career opportunities. Identify high-potential talent and support succession planning. 
 Build coaching capability across the firm.  Support first-time and newly promoted managers through the transition into leadership. Run coaching-based conversations and small-group sessions that grow management capability. Help build a culture where feedback and development happen continuously, not just at review time. 
 Lead employee relations.  Spot, reduce and resolve employee issues and conflict early, with sound judgment, discretion and fairness. Manage ER cases end to end, including grievances, investigations, performance and disciplinary matters, and sensitive exits, working closely with Legal. Coach managers to handle issues themselves where they can. 
 Drive engagement and retention.  Work out what's working and what isn't in the employee experience. Design practical fixes that strengthen engagement and keep critical talent, in line with our values. 
 Carry the culture.  Make sure team and people decisions reflect our core values, and challenge constructively when they don't. 
 Deliver core HR cycles.  Contribute to global processes including performance review, merit and bonus, global mobility, leave and offboarding. Bring the regional view and improve each cycle. 
 Connect regional and global.  Represent APAC needs within global People Operations. Share updates, good practice and new ideas, and help shape improvements to HR operations, systems and processes. 
 Manage risk and compliance.  Work with Legal, Compliance and senior management on local, regional and global changes. Ensure compliance with Hong Kong and wider APAC employment law, and with contract terms such as confidentiality, non-solicitation and non-compete. 
 Develop the HR team.  Mentor and coach HR colleagues and help raise the bar on how we deliver.   
 Other duties as assigned or needed. 
 What you'll bring   
 A proven record of coaching senior leaders and managers to change how they behave, not just giving advice. You can give specific examples of leaders you've helped grow. 
 Strong coaching skills. You listen actively to what is said and what isn't, you choose questions that open up or focus a conversation, and you can give direct, candid feedback in a way that lands. 
 The credibility and presence to challenge senior people constructively and be welcomed back. 
 Strong business acumen. You understand how the business works and can turn business problems into people solutions. 
 A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and building trust in a global matrix organization, including where you have no formal authority. 
 Comfort with ambiguity. You can solve problems where no process or system exists yet, and move quickly across distributed, cross-functional teams. 
 Adaptability with AI. You use AI tools in your daily work, adapt quickly as technology changes how HR works, and apply sound judgment on data privacy and confidentiality. 
 Calm, fair judgment in complex ER situations, and the ability to balance employee, business and legal risk. 
 Sound judgment and complete discretion with sensitive and confidential information. 
 Clear written and verbal communication, strong prioritization and close attention to detail. 
 Curiosity, empathy, and a strong wish to keep learning and to develop others. 
 An interest in building broad, cross-functional experience within People Operations. 
 A sense of humor.   
 Requirements   
 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with a large share of it as an HRBP. Financial services, technology or high-growth experience strongly preferred. 
 Substantial hands-on employee relations experience, including running workplace investigations, handling grievances, performance and disciplinary cases, and managing sensitive or negotiated exits, ideally including senior employees in Hong Kong and APAC. 
 Hands-on experience coaching senior leaders and people managers. A recognized coaching qualification (e.g. ICF-accredited) or formal training in coaching or psychometric tools is a strong plus. 
 Broad generalist depth across performance management, compensation, talent management and global mobility. 
 Solid working knowledge of Hong Kong employment law and practice, including the Employment Ordinance, MPF and PDPO. Experience across APAC (e.g. Mainland China, Singapore, Australia and India) a plus. 
 Experience with HRIS and recruiting systems (e.g. Workday, Greenhouse) and collaboration tools (e.g. Confluence, JIRA). 
 Bachelor's or higher degree in HR, Business, Psychology or a related field. 
 Fluent English. Mandarin and/or Cantonese a plus.   
 Reliable and predictable availability.

 Work as part of a team to establish best-in-class production support, efficient software deployment, configuration processes, and proactive monitoring, with a goal of anticipating and avoiding issues before they occur, minimizing downtime and quick recovery from any incidents.

 Develop proprietary process automation and monitoring tools and leverage third-party technologies as appropriate

 Support core market connectivity and correspond with exchanges regarding trade order activity, connectivity, and other related technical support issues
 Collaborate with traders, DBAs, development, back office, QA, infrastructure, technical support, business development and various management teams around the globe.

 Build documentation for common procedures, troubleshooting scenarios and system architecture.
 Coordinate efforts with other global support teams to ensure continuity and consistency of support in a 24x7 environment
 What’s needed in this role: 
 Superior troubleshooting skills and the ability to navigate issues efficiently that do not have a pre-defined runbook process
 Prior experience supporting high performance applications, process monitoring, and troubleshooting
 Prior experience supporting equities/equity options trading
 Prior experience working with FIX protocol and alternative exchange protocols
 Script development experience a plus
 SQL experience including queries/updates/table creation/basic database maintenance
 Linux & Windows platform support experience in a large-scale production environment
 Experience supporting electronic trading systems; prior experience at proprietary trading firm preferred

Tower Research Capital is a leading quantitative trading firm founded in 1998. Tower has built its business on a high-performance platform and independent trading teams. We have a 25+ year track record of innovation and a reputation  for discovering unique market opportunities.
 Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization. 
 Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. jobs.title: Corporate Concierge
jobs.description:
Corporate Concierge 
 About the Human Resources Department  
 The Human Resources Department at Bridgewater Associates is dedicated to strengthening the talent and systems that drive individual and organizational excellence—supporting our mission to develop a deep understanding of global economies and serve our clients with distinction. HR partners closely with business leaders across the full employee lifecycle, providing both strategic thought partnership and rigorous operational execution across recruiting, onboarding, compensation, benefits, performance, and workplace experience. 
 With an AI-first mindset, the team continuously builds capacity for higher-value work and improves the employee experience at scale. Our five core responsibilities span serving as subject matter experts on all people matters, running the processes that bring our talent strategy to life, ensuring every employee feels deeply cared for and celebrated, safeguarding the institution through disciplined compliance and governance, and building the infrastructure behind firm-wide people operations. 
 About Your Role 
 As the Corporate Concierge, you serve as a highly visible ambassador of the Workplace Experience team, creating an environment where employees and guests feel welcomed, supported, and enabled to do their best work. Acting with urgency, discretion, and a solutions-oriented mindset, you proactively address needs, drive resolution, and enhance the day-to-day experience of employees and guests. You thrive in a structured and service-oriented environment, value consistency and operational excellence, and work collaboratively across teams to ensure every interaction reflects the firm's high standards.
 You will drive the following responsibilities:     
 Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and guests, delivering welcoming, professional, and seamless onsite experience, including managing the internal and external calls that flow through the concierge desk.
 Build strong partnerships across the organization, using sound judgment and effective communication to address requests, solve problems, and support a variety of stakeholder needs.
 Proactively identify opportunities to improve the employee and guest experience through process enhancements, thoughtful service delivery, and continuous operational improvements.
 Manage workplace operations and concierge services with precision and consistency, ensuring efficient execution of daily processes and a high standard of service.
 Support Workplace Experience initiatives, projects, and events that advance team priorities and contribute to broader departmental goals.
 Contribute to a collaborative team environment by sharing knowledge, providing coverage, and adapting to evolving business needs.
 You will be on site 5 days per week and should be comfortable working at both our Westport, CT and New York City campuses.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 You are a service-minded professional who thrives in a structured, fast-paced environment and brings sound judgment, discretion, and strong communication to every interaction. To succeed in this role, you will need:
 A service-oriented mindset and genuine passion for creating positive employee and guest experiences.
 Sound judgment and the ability to navigate new, ambiguous, or evolving situations with professionalism and discretion.
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor communication style, tone, and approach to different audiences and build strong relationships with employees, guests, and stakeholders.
 Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.
 Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative team environment.
 Proficiency in workplace technology and collaboration tools, including Microsoft 365 applications (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint), Zoom Phone, and AI-enabled tools; comfort learning new technologies and systems.
 About Bridgewater 
 Bridgewater Associates is a global macro investment firm, founded in 1975, whose mission is to develop a fundamental, cause-and-effect understanding of how markets and economies work—and translate that understanding into insights, returns, and solutions that help the world’s leading institutional investors solve their most important investment challenges. 
 Over five decades, we have codified our fundamental understanding into a systematic investment process—integrating human judgment with machine intelligence with the goal of applying our thinking consistently, testing it against reality, and continuously improving decision-making over time. We believe this has created a unique platform for applying AI within our process, positioning us at the frontier of integrating technology with investment decision-making. 
 In financial markets—where reality is constantly evolving and outcomes are uncertain—sustained excellence requires continuous learning and improvement. Our culture—anchored in radical truth and transparency—helps us learn faster. 
 Find on our website .
 Our Culture 
 Bridgewater’s culture is anchored in the pursuit of excellence—tied directly to our mission. In financial markets, where the base case is failure and reality is constantly evolving, winning requires continuous learning and improvement. Truth is our most essential tool for improvement, and transparency helps us get closer to truth because it places many eyes on our decisions, problems, and mistakes. By understanding reality clearly, we can identify the gap between where we are and where we want to be—and use that knowledge to learn and get better. Our system that supports this way of being is an idea meritocracy, where we commit to finding and rewarding the best ideas regardless of hierarchy.
 Operating in these ways is hard. Finding truth and learning through it is inherently a high-friction cycle. It’s possible because we share a few core values: a commitment to honesty, high ownership, deeply meaningful work and relationships, and building Bridgewater as a big tent where vast differences are welcomed. These values create the common denominator that binds us together in good times and bad.
 Benefits 
 One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits, including health insurance, retirement benefits, paid leave, and other fringe benefits. Find more information about Bridgewater’s benefits on our website .
 Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations.   
 Sponsorship 
 Please note that we do not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.  
 Compensation 
 The wage range for this role is $80,000-$95,000 inclusive of base salary and discretionary target bonus. The expected base salary for this role is between 80% - 90% of this wage range.   
 This job description is not a contract and confers no contractual rights, privileges, or benefits on any applicant or potential applicant. Bridgewater has the right to change any and all terms of this job description, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, qualifications and benefits. Nothing in this job description constitutes an offer or guarantee of employment. 
 Bridgewater Associates, LP is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Data Sourcing & Strategy Associate
jobs.description:
About Bridgewater        
 Bridgewater Associates is a premier asset management firm, focused on delivering unique insight and partnership for the most sophisticated global institutional investors.         
 Our investment process is driven by a tireless pursuit to understand how the world’s markets and economies work — using cutting-edge technology to validate and execute on timeless and universal investment principles.         
 Founded in 1975, we are a community of independent thinkers who share a commitment to excellence. By fostering a culture of openness, transparency, and inclusion, we strive to unlock the most complex questions in investment strategy, management, and corporate culture.         
 Explore more information about Bridgewater on our website  here .    
 Our Culture        
 Our culture is anchored in excellence, meaning constant improvement, and it is deeply tied to our mission. Because markets are objective, competitive, and getting smarter everyday, we need to keep rapidly improving to have any chance of beating them. Truth is our most essential tool for engaging with the markets and constantly improving because once you know what's true about your problems and opportunities, you can determine how to get better. Valuing truth means being transparent about your decision-making and mistakes, giving and receiving feedback with humility, and fighting for the best answers over hierarchy, ego, or self-interest. Operating this way is hard – it's only possible because we build meaning in our work and relationships. This meaning comes from the audacity of the mission, and the joy of working alongside people who make you a better version of yourself. The culture, like Bridgewater itself, is always evolving. In 1997 our founder Ray Dalio wrote down his lessons, starting with a  Philosophy Statement  which remains our foundation. This later evolved into a set of 300+ Principles. In 2022, when Ray transitioned the company, we re-underwrote several of those principles and evolved others, with a specific focus on  Meritocracy.  Today the culture sits, alongside our people, as our most important edge. When we get it right, it’s the engine that powers everything else.    
 About Your Role     
 In this role, you will be an integral part of the Research, Data Strategy and Acquisition function at Bridgewater. Operating at the front edge of our Investment Data practice, you will be part of the execution and evolution of our Relationship Management, Supplier Knowledge Management, and Internal Stakeholder Management disciplines. You will engage with investors, associates, engineers, and external vendors and sources to improve our understanding of external offerings and vendors’ understanding of our needs, quality management, and business alignment.    
 You will be immersed in our workflows, investment questions, supplier challenges, market making and matching, internal marketing/advocacy, and vendor engagement strategy. You will regularly communicate your understanding and assessments to a diverse group of stakeholders, including investment professionals, vendors and service providers, Management, Compliance, Legal, and Finance. You will partner across the firm and with vendors (existing and prospective), collaborating with hundreds of individuals over the course of a year.    
 You will drive the following responsibilities:    
 Executing across the systems, sourcing, supply chains, and internal demand we use to acquire, provide and maintain the inbound fuel for the Investment requests that arrive unspecified or overly prescribed, helping the investor clarify what they need.   
 Dynamically understanding the world of offerings, known and unknown to Bridgewater, creating potential market matches, indications of interest, discerning and selecting structure from the external world.     
 Owning the Investment Asks that land unspecified or over-specified, where the investor or colleague cannot say what they need.   
 Understanding and effectively communicating the state of specific components of the sourcing portfolio, and our knowledge bases of passes, no bids, and deferred opportunities.     
 Building, maintaining, and rapidly sorting inbound possibilities, candidate sources and existing data sources and services in the sourcing portfolio.     
 Improving and executing on the ML/AI layer we are rapidly introducing into our external discovery and matching process, designed from first principles.   
 Creating and documenting initiatives to raise the quality, reliability, and efficiency of the practice’s systems.     
 Continuously evaluating and enhancing processes for sourcing, vetting, and delivering content processes at scale.     
 Advocating with existing and potential vendors to improve the quality of their pitches.     
 You will be a fit for the role if you:    
 Are curious, practical, analytical, capable, and willing to fail and learn from failing, in broad engagement with a diverse international set of people and processes both inside and outside of Bridgewater.     
 Are able to manage a high volume of work across diverse functions and competing priorities, while effectively communicating, executing and marking to market.     
 Think in terms of systems and naturally look for ways to solve problems through the evolution of those systems.     
 Hold a high degree of personal responsibility and ownership in everything you do.     
 Are willing to operate across all levels of work, starting from basic task execution and evolving into complex, multi-month and multi-modal efforts.     
 In this role, you will grow with us by:    
 Undergoing an on-the-job training program that includes structured engagement with the external world, live apprenticeship, and working with highly experienced colleagues.     
 Actively engaging and grappling with the growth and evolution of the practice.   
 Having your voice and perspective heard, and over time representing the firm in important vendor, counterparty, and provider management discussions.     
 Minimum Qualifications    
 4-year degree from an accredited undergraduate institution    
 3-7 years of relevant work experience at an investment bank, vendor/service provider or asset management firm    
 Experience in at least two of the following: Relationship Management, Supplier Knowledge Management (understanding what suppliers and sources can offer, beyond their past performance), or Internal Stakeholder Management  
 Experience with Capital Markets market or research data is a strong plus    
 Physical Requirements   
 The anticipated onsite requirement for this role is three days per week at our Westport, CT campus and one day per week at our NYC campus.    
 Compensation Band   
 The wage range for this role is $170,000-$225,000 inclusive of base salary and discretionary target bonus. The expected base salary for this role is between 70%-80% of this wage range.    
 Why Choose Bridgewater?     
 It takes all types to make Bridgewater great. We seek a diverse group of innovative thinkers and push them to engage in rigorous and thoughtful inquiry. We develop people through an honest examination of their abilities and performance, enabling personal growth and professional development. We strive to provide you with opportunities that will challenge you and unlock your potential.    
 One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits. Explore more information about Bridgewater’s benefits on our website  here .

jobs.title: IT Sec Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Team: Information Security 
 Position overview 
 The IT Sec Operations Lead will lead Squarepoint’s global security operations capability, covering threat monitoring, detection and response, incident management, forensic readiness, cyber recovery, and vulnerability operations. The role will protect the firm’s proprietary research, source code, models, data and trading technology while enabling a fast-moving engineering environment.
 Responsibilities 
 Own the Security Operations strategy, operating model, roadmap, service standards and day-to-day effectiveness.
 Lead oversight of SOC and MDR services, aligning monitoring and detection coverage to Squarepoint’s priority threats and critical assets.
 Drive detection engineering and threat hunting across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, SaaS, Linux, containers, repositories and data flows.
 Lead material cyber incidents, coordinating investigation, containment, eradication, communications and recovery across relevant teams.
 Maintain and exercise response playbooks for insider threat, IP theft, ransomware, identity or cloud compromise, supplier compromise and data-integrity events.
 Establish forensic-readiness, evidence-handling and investigation practices suitable for legal, regulatory and disciplinary needs.
 Work with Technology teams to establish rapid containment actions, secure restoration criteria and cyber-recovery assurance.
 Provide operational leadership for vulnerability and exposure management, using risk-based prioritisation, service levels and escalation.
 Define clear security operations metrics and executive reporting, and ensure actions from incidents and exercises are tracked to closure.
 Build and develop the internal team and govern specialist providers through measurable outcomes and continuous improvement.
 Required qualifications 
 Significant experience leading security operations, detection and response, incident response or cyber defence in a complex technology environment.
 Proven experience leading serious cyber incidents across technical, operational, legal, compliance and senior stakeholder groups.
 Strong practical knowledge of SIEM, EDR/XDR, MDR/SOC services, detection engineering, threat hunting, identity and cloud telemetry, and incident case management.
 Experience with incident playbooks, crisis exercises, containment, recovery, digital forensics and evidence handling.
 Experience managing security service providers and translating tooling and contracts into measurable operational outcomes.
 Ability to build capable teams, set priorities and deliver through influence across organisational boundaries.
 Clear written and verbal communication, including concise reporting of risk, decisions and operational performance.
 Working knowledge of NIST CSF and MITRE ATT&CK, or equivalent incident-handling and threat-informed defence practices.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience in quantitative finance, trading technology, investment management or another environment protecting high-value intellectual property.
 Knowledge of Linux, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, identity infrastructure, repositories, data platforms or high-performance computing.
 Experience integrating cyber response and recovery with operational resilience, business continuity and disaster recovery.
 Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GNFA or CISM, or equivalent practical experience.
 What we value 
 We are looking for someone who is calm under pressure, technically credible, pragmatic and collaborative. You should be comfortable creating structure in an evolving environment, making ownership explicit and focusing on measurable risk reduction rather than process or tooling for its own sake.

 Embed with PM and strategy teams on rotation. Learn their process, find the bottlenecks, and ship AI agents and workflows that remove them.
 Build AI-assisted research and trading tools, from data ingestion and signal research through to the tools PMs rely on everyday.
 Convert what you learn on the desks back into our shared AI platform: data pipelines, agent memory, architecture, model and agent intelligence, and interfaces (Slack, dashboards, CLI)
 Measure whether what you build gets used and adds value and keep improving it based on feedback.

 Pursuing a degree in computer science, engineering or another quantitative field.

 As a Strategic Finance & Analytics Principal supporting Membership, you will partner closely with leaders across business operations, product, analytics, data science, and adjacent Strategic Finance teams to help build and grow the Membership program. This team is responsible for developing and scaling new growth levers for Airbnb. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. 
 The Strategic Finance & Analytics team sits at the intersection of finance, strategy, and the business, partnering directly with leaders to decide where Airbnb invests, how we grow, and what we do next. We expect every member of the team to bring a CFO mindset to budget management, producing actionable insights, owning our performance story, and supporting day-to-day execution.

 A seat at the table. We're advisors, not just analysts. Our work shapes real decisions, not just decks.

Because many of these programs are early-stage, the financial and analytical foundation often does not yet exist, so you will define and build it.

Support the planning cadences (annual planning, long-range planning, and monthly or quarterly forecasts).

 Airbnb a pris le jour en 2007 lorsque deux Hôtes ont accueilli trois invités dans leur maison de San Francisco, et compte depuis lors plus de 4 millions d'Hôtes qui ont accueilli plus d'un milliard d'invités dans presque tous les pays du monde. Chaque jour, les Hôtes proposent des séjours et des expériences uniques qui permettent aux invités de se connecter de manière plus authentique aux communautés.
 La communauté que vous rejoindrez :  
 L’équipe AirCover a pour mandat de concevoir, de bâtir, de lancer et de gérer les activités d’AirCover au sein d’Airbnb. Nous avons une grande responsabilité envers notre communauté d’hôtes et de voyageurs : être là lorsque les choses ne se déroulent pas exactement comme prévu avec leurs réservations. Les défis seront nombreux au cours des prochaines années, et nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne pour nous aider à coordonner nos priorités et à offrir une expérience irréprochable à notre communauté.
 L’équipe Claims Experience fait partie de l’équipe AirCover. Elle offre un soutien haut de gamme à nos utilisateurs en adaptant l’expérience et les services proposés à leurs besoins particuliers, afin que chacun puisse accueillir des voyageurs et voyager en toute confiance. Nous cultivons une compréhension et une empathie profondes envers les attentes de chacun de nos clients, et nous allons au-delà des attentes pour créer des interactions personnalisées qui laissent une impression durable tout au long du processus de réclamation, du début à la fin.
 L’équipe assure la réussite opérationnelle de l’ensemble des produits AirCover et offre une exécution sans faille grâce à la qualité et à la rapidité de nos échanges, tout en veillant à la fidélisation de la clientèle et à la croissance continue de notre communauté Airbnb.
 La différence que vous ferez : 
 Vous aurez pour mandat de comprendre les besoins uniques de nos clients et d’aller au-delà des attentes pour créer des interactions personnalisées qui laissent une impression durable tout au long du processus de réclamation, du début à la fin.
 Vous traiterez nos clients avec cohérence, équité et empathie, de sorte qu’ils se sentent écoutés et compris. Vous adapterez le soutien offert à leurs besoins particuliers afin de régler les problèmes efficacement, à la satisfaction de toutes les parties. En améliorant l’expérience client de bout en bout, vous contribuerez à accroître les taux de fidélisation et à permettre à chacun d’accueillir des voyageurs et de voyager sur Airbnb en toute confiance.
 Une journée typique :  
 Évaluer, examiner et régler les réclamations soumises pour les produits AirCover (y compris, sans s’y limiter, les réclamations liées à la protection des hôtes contre les dommages), notamment des réclamations de valeur élevée et de grande complexité qui exigent des enquêtes approfondies et des négociations pour en arriver à des résultats satisfaisants
 Surveiller de près les indices de fraude et atténuer les risques associés aux individus malveillants afin de protéger la marque Airbnb et sa communauté
 Vérifier tous les faits et éléments de preuve pertinents pour déterminer l’issue de chaque dossier, dans le respect des politiques et des processus internes
 Aller au-delà des attentes pour créer des interactions personnalisées et offrir un soutien haut de gamme exceptionnel tout au long du processus de réclamation, en adaptant l’expérience proposée et en veillant à répondre aux besoins et aux préférences de chaque utilisateur avec le plus grand soin et la plus grande attention

 Collaborer étroitement avec les parties prenantes et les administrateurs de réclamations tiers afin de s’entendre sur les stratégies de traitement des dossiers et d’assurer un règlement rapide pour nos utilisateurs

jobs.title: Supervisor - Trust and Safety Operations
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 The Community You Will Join 
 Fraud & Safety Delivery (FSD) is at the heart of keeping Airbnb safe for the millions of hosts and guests who trust our platform every day. As part of Global Operations, FSD reviews and resolves potential fraud and safety cases across the full user lifecycle, with internal and partner specialists operating 24/7 across the globe.
 You'll join Frontline Operations, the pillar that does that review and resolution work. Our specialists and the partner teams who deliver alongside us handle cases around the clock, and the leads, managers and analysts across the pillar make sure that work is fast, accurate and consistent wherever it runs.
 You'll lead a team on Fraud & Safety Review within Frontline Operations, working day to day with Policy, Product and the partner sites that carry cases alongside your team.
 The Difference You Will Make 
 You lead a team of Fraud & Safety Review specialists: you decide how their work is prioritised as volume, risk and resourcing move through the week, and you coach the judgement that makes their decisions consistent whoever handles the case.
 The difference you make is a team that performs to a high standard all the time — not only when volume is manageable. That reliability is what the rest of FSD plans around.
 Success looks like a team that consistently meets its quality, service-level and resolution-time targets, fewer repeat escalations because a change is applied the same way by everyone, and specialists who stay and grow because the path in front of them is clear.
 A Typical Day 
 Lead and develop a team of Fraud & Safety Review specialists, holding the team accountable for quality, timeliness, and service goals while championing their growth and overall team engagement.
 Adapt the team's plan and make the day-to-day decisions on case handling, escalation and coverage as volume, case mix or resourcing shifts. For example: rebalancing the queue and re-cutting coverage when a surge in account-takeover reports lands on a public holiday with half the team off.
 Coach and develop your specialists through regular 1:1s and case reviews, manage performance against targets, and model the values and belonging behaviours that make the team people stay.
 Use judgment and the operational data to resolve the technical, customer and operational problems your team raises, and recommend the process and tooling improvements the pattern points to.
 Take process, tooling and workflow changes as an input from the broader fraud and safety strategy and land them with your team, and hand off the cases that need executive escalation or new precedent to the appropriate senior stakeholder.
 Watch your team's operational metrics, report the trends and risks in your remit to leadership, and anticipate resourcing needs so you can raise a gap to your manager before it becomes a blocker.
 Your Expertise 
 8+ years in Fraud & Safety, Risk, Trust or related operations, including 4+ years leading or supervising a team in a high-volume, time-sensitive case-review environment.
 Proven ability to hold a team of specialists to consistent quality, accuracy and productivity targets, using operational data to see where performance is moving and act on it.
 Working knowledge of fraud and safety typologies, and how workflow, precedent and policy interact on escalated cases.
 People leadership at the scope named above — led a team of specialists whose decisions carried real consequence, coaching a diverse group of talent and setting team priorities and performance targets.
 Sound operational judgment when the answer is not clear — you assess the situation, decide with the information you have, and adapt the plan rather than waiting for direction.
 Clear, direct communicator — able to make operational and case reasoning legible to your specialists, to your cross-functional partners, and to the leadership tracking your team's results.
 Experience in a marketplace, travel or platform fraud and safety environment, or building SOPs, playbooks and enablement that scaled beyond one team, is a plus, not a requirement.
 Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: 
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
 How We'll Take Care of You: 
 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.  
 India Annual Pay Range
 ₹1,610,000 — ₹2,110,000 INR 
 Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 
 A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

 As a Safety Threat Investigator on the Safety Investigations team, you will primarily support Roblox’s Core Investigations capability: the operational backbone for repeatable, high-sensitivity matters that require speed, consistency, evidence discipline, and strong documentation. You will independently manage small- to medium-scope investigations from intake through resolution, with little day-to-day oversight, and produce clear, defensible work product that supports high-confidence safety decisions.
 You will recognize when a matter needs deeper attribution, network-centric analysis, cross-platform research, proactive threat hunting, or externally meaningful work product, and you will escalate to a senior investigator or to Specialized Investigations. At the CL7 level, you will own your assigned investigations end to end, apply the team’s methods with consistency, and bring back practical observations that make the next case faster and clearer. You will check in with your manager or a senior investigator when scope, risk, or the right investigative lane is unclear.
 Please note: This role may require reviewing graphic, controversial, and offensive content in accordance with Roblox’s handling policies. It may also require participation in an on-call rotation during weekends and holidays.
 You Will
 Independently manage repeatable, high-sensitivity investigations of small to medium scope, including matters involving child exploitation, violent extremism, organized fraud, compromised accounts, coordinated abuse, and other high-risk behavior.
 Apply structured investigative methods, evidence checklists, common templates, and approved data pulls to produce timely and consistent case outcomes.
 Gather, preserve, analyze, and corroborate evidence while maintaining accurate provenance, confidentiality, and auditability.
 Turn an assigned investigative question into a practical plan, including scope, evidence steps, milestones, and exit criteria, and seek review from a senior investigator when the matter is ambiguous or growing in complexity.
 Conduct focused account, entity, and timeline linkage within a case, and identify when the case needs deeper attribution, network mapping, or cross-platform investigation.
 Escalate to Specialized Investigations, or to a senior investigator, when a case develops meaningful attribution complexity, broader network risk, external actionability, or a need for deeper synthesis.
 Prepare clear case summaries and standardized downstream work product for partners such as Legal, Safety Intelligence, Trust & Safety Operations, Law Enforcement Operations, or NCMEC, as appropriate.
 Notice recurring patterns, operational pain points, and escalation trends in your caseload, and share them so they can inform Policy, Product, Engineering, Detection, Legal, and Safety Operations.
 Contribute to investigation playbooks, templates, intake guidance, and quality checks by testing them in casework and proposing specific improvements.
 Keep teammates informed with clear, timely updates, raise blockers early, and stay aligned with partners on the cases you own.
 Share practical techniques with peers, and incorporate feedback to strengthen your own investigative rigor and documentation.
 Maintain strong case hygiene, document decisions and approvals, and close investigations with clear outcomes, documented residual risk, and follow-up actions.
 You Have
 3+ years conducting investigations involving safety, abuse, fraud, security, threat, or other high-risk matters.
 Demonstrated ability to independently manage small- to medium-scope investigations end to end, including intake, evidence development, analysis, findings, and follow-through, with little day-to-day oversight.
 Working experience using SQL, spreadsheets, or similar tools, and open-source intelligence, in an investigative context.
 Sound investigative judgment and the ability to distinguish facts, inferences, allegations, unknowns, assumptions, and analytical conclusions.
 Familiarity with account or entity linkage, timelines, or open-source research, and the judgment to recognize when a case needs deeper attribution or specialist support.
 Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce concise, defensible case summaries for investigators and partner teams.
 Ability to turn a defined investigative question into a practical plan, adjust as new evidence appears, and deliver medium-scope work on time.
 A habit of connecting individual cases to policy, product, detection, and user-safety questions, and of sharing those observations with the team.
 Ability to collaborate with peers and partners, build working relationships beyond your immediate team, and take feedback from senior investigators.
 Sound judgment, discretion, curiosity, resilience, and a commitment to evidence-based, fair, and proportionate investigations.
 Success in This Role
 Within your first year, you will be expected to independently manage Core Investigations matters of small to medium scope from intake to completion, deliver consistent and defensible work product, escalate cases that need deeper or specialized handling, and contribute practical observations that help the team investigate more consistently.
 You will be successful when you:
 Deliver rigorous, timely, and consistent outcomes on the investigations you own.
 Apply sound judgment in triage, evidence development, escalation, and case closure, and ask for review when scope or risk is unclear.
 Use the team’s methods, templates, and quality standards consistently, and suggest specific improvements based on your casework.
 Surface recurring patterns from your investigations so partners can act on them.
 Communicate clearly with teammates and partner teams, and help peers by sharing what you learn in casework.
 Our Team Principles
 We follow the full story, investigate horizontally, make safety impact real, pursue accountability end-to-end, lead with mission and curiosity, collaborate with candor and respect, build leverage rather than relying on heroics, and continuously raise the bar.

 About the Role 
 The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox’s Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution. Creators are the engine of Roblox. When something breaks for them, whether it is a broken publish flow, a payout that didn't land, an asset that won't upload, how quickly and how well we resolve it directly shapes whether they keep building with us.
 You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager. The team provides support to Roblox’s global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Senior Product Support Specialist on our Safety Ops Team, you’ll own the hardest escalations end to end, drive root cause analysis with engineering and product partners, and then close the loop by turning what you learn into support content that scales for both our human agents and our automated support experiences.
 Additionally, you will serve as a product expert working closely with the Product Support Management team, providing detailed synthesis of new and existing issues our users experience to prioritize and enable engineering teams to improve the platform. You'll operate with a high degree of independence. 
You Will 
 Support health and proactive gap identification 
 Co-monitor the health of creator support: contact drivers, resolution rates, reopen and escalation rates, deflection performance, CSAT, and where creators are getting stuck.
 Mine ticket, content, and automation data for patterns: recurring issues, missing coverage, misleading documentation, product gaps and surface them proactively with a recommendation attached to the PSM.
 Independently own root cause analysis for complex, high-impact, and ambiguous creator issues including ones that cross product, platform, and policy boundaries..
 Get ahead of launches: review upcoming product and policy changes, pressure test them from a support perspective, and make sure content, tooling, and agent readiness are in place before creators feel the change. Support PSM in preparing RCA or post launch report to surface to all concerned stakeholder (engineering, product, operations etc) 
 Report clearly and regularly to support and product leadership on where creator support is strong, where it's degrading, and what you propose to do about it.
 Drive operational excellence in how creator support runs: hold the line on quality standards, tighten workflows and handoffs between support, engineering, and product, eliminate manual toil through better process and tooling, and treat every process change as something to be measured rather than assumed. Where the current way of working is the bottleneck, you name it and fix it.
 Product Feedback Loop: Partner directly with Product Managers (PMs) during alpha/beta testing phases to provide a "Supportability Scorecard" for major upcoming platform features.
Knowledge & Support Content 
 Author and maintain the authoritative internal knowledge base agents rely on which includes but is not restricted to troubleshooting guides, decision trees, macros, policy interpretations and keep it accurate as the product changes underneath it.
 Own creator support content, which includes (but is not limited to) intent-ready articles, structured resolution paths, and clear, unambiguous source material for support agents to rely on. 
 Build automation and self-service experiences, supplying the content and acting as a subject-matter judgment behind them, and flagging where automation is producing wrong or incomplete answers.
 Serve as a senior point of contact during high-severity creator-facing incidents, coordinating across support, engineering, and comms, when needed
 Raise the bar on escalation quality across the team by setting the standard for what a well-formed escalation looks like, and reduce the volume that shouldn't have escalated in the first place
You Have
 7+ years in technical support, product support, or a comparable operational role, including significant time at a senior or escalation tier.
 A demonstrated track record of independent root cause analysis on complex technical issues.
 Excellent written communication. You have the ability to explain a nuanced technical failure to an engineer and to a frustrated creator.
 Comfort with ambiguity and genuine self-direction. You choose your own problems, defend your prioritization, and close things out without being managed.
 Strong cross-functional influence without authority, you can get engineering and product to care about a support problem.
 Nice to Have 
 Experience owning support content at scale, with real evidence that your content changed outcomes (deflection, handle time, resolution quality).
 Experience writing or structuring content balancing automation driven human in the loop support, self-service, etc.
 Prior experience supporting a developer, creator, or partner audience rather than a general consumer base.
 Working knowledge of Roblox as a creation platform; Studio, Lua, the developer economy or comparable experience with a UGC platform.
 Data & Diagnostic Proficiency: Comfortable querying datasets (SQL, Tableau, or similar BI tools) and analyzing diagnostic logs to isolate bugs before routing to engineering.

They'll bring those leaders' priorities company-wide through narratives that deliver on our business objectives and further our purpose, vision, and values.
 Lyft is telling a transformation story about global growth, and we aim to deliver strategies that enable our teams to move at lightning speed. Great communications create focus and alignment, so teams spend less time resolving confusion and more time executing with clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making. To be successful in this role, this individual will allocate their efforts as follows:
 30% Strategy: Independently identify high-impact opportunities and set the communications roadmap that moves the business forward.
 40% Rhythm of the Business: Lead execution of communications strategies and programs.
 30% Unexpected: Lead rapid response, crisis communications, and change management.
 We're looking for someone who earns the trust of senior leaders quickly, brings a point of view, and isn't afraid to push back. This individual should be a strategic thinker and a strong writer, comfortable moving between the big picture and the details, and energized by ambiguity. Most importantly, Lyft is about fostering an open, inclusive, and diverse community where all team members are recognized for what they bring, and we want you to be you.
 This role will report directly to Leslie Zodikoff as a member of the Internal Communications team and part of our Team Member Experience Team, which rolls into our People organization.

 Develop and own an annual communications roadmap for designated areas of the business, connecting communications to business objectives and measuring impact against clear outcomes.

 Craft high-level, clear messaging for executive leaders and company-wide distribution.
 Lead communications response for complex, multi-stakeholder situations, including crisis and change management.
 Anticipate communications challenges and proactively develop solutions to address them before they arise.
 Use data and industry insights to inform strategy, and continuously improve how we communicate.
 Set high standards for communications quality, and support the growth of others on the team through mentorship and feedback.
 Maintain the Lyft brand and voice across all communications, written and verbal.
 Keep Lyft fun!
 Experience:
 8+ years of experience leading communications strategy and execution, with significant internal or executive communications experience
 Proven track record as a trusted advisor to senior executives
 Experience leading multi-quarter, cross-functional communications programs with measurable business impact
 Ability to fluidly navigate between strategy and execution, from developing strategic plans to producing crisp, clear communications
 Experience leading communications through crisis and significant organizational change
 Experience communicating complex business, product, or technology topics in a way that resonates with a broad audience
 Experience tailoring communications to distributed and global workforces, including full-time and hourly team members
 A clear point of view on how AI can improve communications effectiveness, and experience putting it into practice
 Experience mentoring others and raising the bar for a team's work

 Lyft user/believer

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager I, Base Pricing
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product managers who bring exceptional creative, strategic, and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry.
 Pricing is the primary economic engine of Lyft's marketplace — a high-precision, real-time system that processes millions of fare calculations per hour, balancing rider affordability, driver earnings, and Lyft's sustainable growth. The Pricing team sits at the intersection of the marketplace, mediating between rider demand and driver supply, and is a core pillar of the Rider Organization.
 The Base Pricing Team owns the systems that set the base price of a Lyft ride for every ride type, region, and ride intent. Behind these base prices is a machine-learning and optimization stack that predicts how the Lyft marketplace responds to price, translates the cost of serving a ride into a price, and recommends price changes across hundreds of markets every week. Base prices are the foundation of every fare, and they set the reference point that dynamic pricing and rider discounts build on.
 The team serves two sets of customers: riders, who should see prices that are fair, competitive, and matched to what they value; and the analysts and market managers who use our models and tools to set pricing strategy.
 Responsibilities:  
 As the Staff Product Manager for Base Pricing, you will own the vision and roadmap for how Lyft sets base prices, and define the success metrics that measure it. That includes:
 Determining the optimal granularity at which Lyft sets base prices (e.g., by time, location, and type of trip)
 Improving how our base price optimization engine works with downstream dynamic pricing systems to better respond to real-time market conditions
 Re-evaluating how costs to fulfill a ride impact prices
 Jointly optimizing prices across ride types, so that standard, alternative modes, and scheduled rides are priced as one portfolio 
 Making our impact estimation models accurate and trusted by market management teams
 Evolving base pricing to function in a hybrid network with autonomous vehicles
 Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders (engineers, scientists, analysts), and partner teams (Driver Earnings, Verticals, Market Management) to align on a shared vision, define requirements, and prioritize inbound requests.
 Communicate roadmaps, experiment results, and pricing decisions clearly to audiences from partner teams up to Lyft's executive team.
 Experience: 
 5+ years of product management or relevant experience, with significant time spent on algorithmic, data-driven, pricing, or marketplace products
 A deep technical understanding of microeconomics, and ideally a background in Operations Research, Econometrics, Machine Learning, or algorithmic systems
 Experience owning pricing, revenue management, or other economic levers with direct P&L impact; experience with price optimization, elasticity modeling, or cost modeling is a strong plus
 Experience running A/B tests and market-level experiments, using statistical and causal inference techniques to evaluate results, and developing post-launch testing strategies
 Experience with data, including querying, aggregation, analysis, and visualization; comfortable working directly in SQL and with data science partners on model design
 Ability to define and analyze metrics that inform the success of products, and excellent judgment about the dynamics of a product ecosystem
 Natural ability to make things happen around you; you manage ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies across many teams in an organized and structured way
 Strong communication skills and intuition for communication strategy at every level — within teams, within the company, and with executives
 Passion for Lyft and what we are trying to achieve in sustainable urban transportation

 Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
 Mental health benefits
 Family building benefits
 Child care and pet benefits
 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

jobs.title: Lead, Technical Services
jobs.description:
MongoDB is helping define the next era of application development as organizations modernize legacy systems, build AI-native experiences, and power mission-critical workloads across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. From MongoDB Atlas, our AI-ready developer data platform, to our industry-leading server technology and enterprise software offerings, MongoDB provides a flexible and unified software stack that helps customers build faster, scale with confidence, and support a wide range of modern application needs.
 Building on the rapid success and adoption of MongoDB, we are delivering applications and services that make it much easier to manage and scale database deployments. These next-generation systems are a growing list but currently include products such as Atlas, Cloud Manager, and Compass. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity as we scale cloud deployments for our customers.
 We’re open to speak with candidates based in Sao Paulo.
 Life in MongoDB Technical Services 
 As part of the Support organization, you will be directly interfacing with our largest customers and their most difficult problems. There will almost certainly be sweat. But don’t worry – you’ll have time to prepare before you take on your first escalation. The limits of your understanding will constantly be pushed, and you’ll be challenged to grow. Underlying it all is the fuel that drives our team: customer obsession. We keep mission-critical deployments online, recover from high-pressure incidents with grace and humility, become trusted advisors, and work so closely with our customers that they would swear we were part of their team.
 Role scope: This is a technical Team Lead role rather than a traditional people-manager role. The Lead is expected to provide day-to-day technical and operational leadership, while formal personnel decisions remain with the manager.
 As the Cloud Support Team Lead, you will:
 Lead and mentor a small, distributed team as a hands-on technical player-coach
 Spend approximately 50% of your time directly supporting customer issues, complex cases, escalations, and technical investigations
 Own frontline service quality by monitoring queue health, case and chat aging, diagnostic quality, staffing coverage, and workload allocation
 Lead high-visibility customer escalations and incidents, coordinating Engineering, Product, Support Operations, and other stakeholders
 Turn recurring customer problems and support trends into product feedback, process improvements, training, and reusable technical content
 Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, training materials, and retrospectives that improve team capability and consistency
 Represent Technical Services in cross-functional and cross-region programs, driving execution through influence
 What you need 
 The ideal candidate will have experience in most of the following areas:
 Supporting customers through cases, chats, calls, and high-severity escalations. Preferred experience with running high-severity incidents and follow-the-sun procedures
 Leading or mentoring a small team of highly technical support engineers
 Strong troubleshooting experience with MongoDB Atlas or comparable cloud database platforms, including cloud infrastructure, Linux, networking, security, storage, and performance
 A disciplined diagnostic process covering investigation, customer communication, escalation judgment, and root-cause analysis. Experience leveraging AI tools to broaden, improve and accelerate technical diagnostic processes preferred
 Coordinating customer-impacting incidents and internal technical responders
 Improving support operations through queue analysis, workload allocation, staffing coverage, training, and process improvement
 Strong communication and collaboration skills across Engineering, Product, Security, Legal, Billing, Support Operations, and global Technical Services
 Nice to Have 
 Experience with Cloud Manager, Compass, or large-scale relational or NoSQL databases
 Experience managing FIN(Intercom), chat-support, case-management, or similar customer-support workflows
 Experience leading incident reviews, RCAs, operational audits, or security/compliance improvements
 Experience creating technical training, LMS content, knowledge programs, or enablement assessments
 BONUS: Experience with DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, observability, automation, or scripting
 Success Measures 
 First 3 months: Build relationships, understand team operations and customer demand, and begin contributing to complex escalations. Learn the Atlas product and master most common customer use cases
 By 6 months: Independently lead escalations, establish recurring queue and quality reviews, improve coverage, and deliver at least one durable process or enablement improvement. Acquire Atlas Administrator certification
 By 12 months: Demonstrate measurable improvement in service quality, escalation execution, team capability, coverage, and cross-functional delivery while remaining hands-on technically
